Oh, they are not the toil of your Work nor the thoughts but only this consumes my soul! Oh, leave me – I tell him continually – that I stay like this; you tell me how I should do everything. Do not allow me to turn to others. “I start dictating and I understand nothing of what I say”

Today was a fatal day because of this anguish that had started to torment me at the moment of thanksgiving and still continues. What a strangling! It depresses me, it lashes me and I feel inebriated by something.

My meditation on the wound of the side of this morning united me to my Good // and I was fully in him. I enjoyed the delights of paradise, blessed in you my Good. Who can ever write what is felt. The right side, the hands, the feet … When I returned they were paining, but the suffering was very gentle; it produced nothing else but a taste of peace. As usual the swelling followed; it was much increased and in the time of thanksgiving of Holy Communion a fire devoured me on the right and I felt like dying. Meanwhile my mind was united to God and at the same time a Vulcan of things, regarding what I mentioned above, slowly were released from my mind. It was the intellect that reasoned with that Being who was inside my heart.

I would have stayed // a century to be able to have tasted a moment. I returned to my pains because of the thought of having to say that. No, no, he will not deny me what is necessary, when I am not able of answering or writing. I return to the right side and I say to him: My Beloved, answer me my wisest spouse, speak!

Saying this, I felt some kind of concentration and I started dictating, but I understood nothing of what I said. In order to know what I said I had to ask so that they could read for me what I dictated. In the same way my star appears to me every time. Another Daughter of St. Anne must be on her way to heaven; I could not do other than exclaim: // My God, why do you take away from me the best religious? How can I ever sustain such a burden when you remove those who help me?

In this, I find my Good dumb, because he answers me nothing; a martyrdom of penances is suggested to me with much peace which I cannot describe. How can I doubt that it was the voice of God? On the other side I feel so exhausted that I feel pity for myself and I cannot have strength. Moreover, the discipline destroys me completely; it removes my strength. Who can assure me in this? Alas, // a voice told me:

  • Turn to the one to whom I told you to.

When I find myself this way only weeping relieves me, I do not see the hour night will come. What tribulation, what torture this is! What pain my God, have mercy!

The beasts and night ghosts return

28 (…) 1873. After many months in which I did not see any more deformed beast, unfortunately this night it came. Before going to bed I prayed very much; I was disturbed by something, but not of thoughts nor of other thing but as if something sinister would happen. Enough! When I was tired, I went to bed continuing spiritual communions I tried to rest.

I had closed my eyes // and it seemed to me I was sleeping but I woke up by something sensible on my head; I opened my eyes and I saw a black beast with clutches completely black. It was far two spans higher than my person; I looked at it and it was motionless. I could not do or say anything. I started moving and I sat on the bed following it with my eyes wherever it went. When it rose towards the ceiling and was at a distance of a span, it disappeared. How I remained, I cannot describe; I prayed. I was holding tight to my Jesus but I was not able to sleep.

  • I asked - who are you? It // did not answer.

  • Wicked spirit, why do you come to disturb me? What will happen to me? The other times when you came, terrible things had happened! Bad spirit, you still have the insolence to warn me that you entered to breathe on our superiors and confuse their minds? Oh enemy of hell, why do you do this? Aren’t you tired? Can’t you be persuaded that you will never win against this Work of God? Withdraw, let human beings see clearly and have no more mist in their minds!

At the end I spent the whole night // in this way.

Alas, after many months that I was calm, it returns to disturb me; poor me! Martyrdom comes back at night. I was not mistaken because this other night it happened again, not the same as the other but I woke and with open eyes, I saw coming out close to the wall certain black shades that I did not know how to explain; I was like someone who would like to but unable. Therefore, I doubled my prayers, holding tight to the Heart Jesus. Mary! Mary! Oh, you see that for many months I have not slept // and during the day I am so weak that I feel like fainting. Oh, let this scene end!

For the past five nights I have been disturbed. Before this happened I heard sound in the room which gave me much pain; to this convulsion was added unrest that upset me the whole day. Here I was again in the immense sea of tribulations. What agony, my dear God!

“If I could write everything my Good works in me…”

Some contrasting things happen in me now and then during the day; now I feel arid and upset and another moment, unexpectedly united with God, I feel unable to manage because of such a sweet union with the fire that devours me on the side, // and a sweet pain in the hands and feet. I cannot say something else but: my Good increase in me this spasm, I desire it until death, I do not want it ever to cease, but may it stay until I have no more life.

This morning as I prepared myself for Holy Communion, I was taken by that Communion and I stayed there to listen to whatever my Beloved taught me and it was regarding St.

Anne and what I had to say. His teaching was so sublime that as I came back to myself, I did not understand many things and I was not able to understand the meaning.

Oh, my most beloved All did not delay to teach me, being dearer and opening my // intellect to the knowledge and the capacity of discernment.

Then I revised everything that I heard, word by word and I understood well what was to be done.

If I could have time to write everything my Good does in me, I would do nothing else but write because he taught me and he teaches me everything I did and I still do in his Work. In truth I could say, that when he did not make me understand what I should do and in which way I should act, I wait as an ignorant servant the order of the master.

When I speak, some people // would like to make me believe that they do this and that for our good; instead how many times it is in the contrary! Well, internally a voice instructs me what I should do and answer; a light shows me clearly such duplicity. Oh, truly there are days in which I am so much confused that I would sink since I see clearly my nothingness. In the presence of such light my ignorance is too much; it could not be described.

“I love you; I love you still more!”

After a peaceful night, this morning my Beloved consoled me. In my thanksgiving I had to weep // for the many things I asked and he granted me all. There was one which I asked him so much and is…

  • Enough – he answered – yes, you will be, I promise you.

To hear these words I was fainting and the tears were pouring because of his tenderness. How many things I told him! And I could still have much more to say while absorbed in him I only said: I love you, I love you and I still more!

What I felt! Only he could say it. My Beloved: I can only say that I enjoyed much and saw much but I can narrate nothing.

As I finished I said to him: my Good I am at the end of the month and I must satisfy what I bought for the Daughters of St. Anne; therefore send to me your providence! Eternal Father, my All, // do not delay to send me what I need, before the moment of payment, otherwise I am upset. You know that the thought runs to the examination to see if I have disgusted you. For charity’s sake have pity of the one who lives in you.

One of these days while I was doing the meditation, I hid myself in the wound of the right hand and I was completely annihilated there while I said: my Beloved, with this Blood of yours wash the soul of the one who lives for you and locked here remains. Oh, what joy I felt as I said this!

Adoring the Lord now in one and then in the other chapel of the Institute

This night of 6 June I was praying in bed; first I was very arid // and a thought about the Work disturbed my mind but I tried as I could to drive it away. Finally I was able to do a bit of adoration moving with my mind, now in one and then in the other chapel of ours, for adoration. I had a thousand things to say to my Good in those houses where providence was not active so that he may deem to provide and not punish the failures that could be found by denying providence. At the end, I was consoled. I could say that in this moving around, the union was such that it seemed to be truly there. Everything was silent in those hours // of rest and it was very easy for me to recommend their spiritual as well as temporal needs.

A very light shaking woke me. As soon as I opened my eyes which were half closed – I believed – I saw the ugly beast, but it was curious; it was much smaller than all the others I had ever seen and it was attached to a curtain I had in the room. At the moment it was stationery but it went away soon. It was not very black; it had some white points that were ash colored; it also had clutches. Even these had points and they were very short.

It moved slowly and when // it reached the end of the curtain, it disappeared. However, it did not leave me like the other times very upset and sleepless; no, I continued to pray and after some time I slept.

How she stopped the prick of certain insects during prayer

Today, Friday, I do not know how to express the many consolations God gave me, making me penetrate and discover many great things; especially all the immense things which I have in the Work and again regarding my spirit giving me great lessons to know how to act in certain circumstances.

Finally at the end of Holy Communion, I had very gracious words of instruction. The first moment of deep concentration, // I was not sensible but all absorbed in God. Then I was very disturbed by the pricking of certain insects because I have been in a dirty place. It often happens and it is a consolation to see that only saying: - In the name of God do not move, stop and do not upset me at all // with your movements and others - as soon as I say this, it is as if they were not there; they are quiet and I remain perfectly as if I have not even one.

This morning, quickly I said:

  • In the name of God leave me, be quiet!

I felt nothing more; I was very concentrated that I felt like weeping. Alas, my God, these insects obey and they submit only to your name! Obedient, they are quiet and we Christians every day are deaf to your calling and disobey your commands which are commands of your holy law. Oh, // I am the first who was disobedient to your words. What did I ever do! In this way thinking of what the human beings do, I wept; but it was a weeping of consolation that gave me relief. In this way it seemed to me to give vent to my pain and to be a bit relieved.

For two days now I have often had before my eyes a small cross, not black but white shaded; certainly it is the announcement of the death of a certain person. //

The curious thing of these insects is when the time I tell them to be quiet ends they all start to jump. I feel like laughing when my daughters say:

  • I do not know how the Mother could stay motionless, so quiet!

It is true that for sometime I feel nothing, but when I start to feel, I order them to be quiet. I do it only in the morning. At the other hours of the day I never do, fearing disrespecting them.

Burning of love on the feast of the Sacred Heart

The tribulations are very many, the thoughts and the anguishes immense but still many are the consolations that every now and then // my God gives me, especially when I suffer much humiliation. In the morning, when I present to him all my toils, humiliations and all the other things, how many times he caresses me and fortifies me!

My Good, are you pleased with this I did or with the other? Are you happy with my penances? Did they please you?

How many times he answered me and his voice inebriated me with consolation! What a rejoicing this is!

Nothing is heard, nothing thought, everything is small for this sweetest love! //

On the eve of the Sacred Heart, at midnight, I felt something towards the Sacred Heart and I directed all my affections towards him. When I was absorbed, I enjoyed paradise and now and then I returned to myself. How many words of love I said to my Beloved and again I was absorbed in my Good. In this way I spent the night, but seeing it was day and forcing myself away from such a strong union I remained breathless; there was something holding me tight in the chest that did not allow me to breathe. Oh, day that reduced me to agony!

I needed to give vent with my Beloved and tell him many things when I always need to make contrary acts: my Good, for pity’s sake move away! Oh, if you continue like this // soon they will realize; pity, my Good!

In the morning while going to the church for Holy

Communion, only God knows how much I suffered.

Moreover, passing in front of the image of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, as soon as I looked at him he started to laugh. I leave for a thought of what I felt; as I returned I prostrated myself and asked him for a grace. I clearly saw that he was laughing. Alas, if I do not rise up soon and go out, what will happen! The pain I suffered was much. My God for pity’s sake, only at night when I am alone! (Something very rare).

Order of the superior regarding a friend

I want to remember things which I had from my God. I was friendly with someone. At first // when I spoke to her, I felt something extraordinary. After sometime, one morning before going to receive Holy Communion as if I had this person before me, a voice said to me:

  • Carry her with you to be nourished by my Body; she will receive a portion of your Communion.

Immediately I was displeased and after I lamented saying:

  • Why, my Good? I am displeased!

My laments were not of use; I always saw this person next to me and interiorly it was as if he renewed the order: I understood and I followed it. The next day again and I always felt displeasure to do it. This continued always and every day I kept her near. // This was not enough: one of these mornings my God ordered me to tell her certain things that only thinking and hearing them made me shudder. They were all for her and all holy; but only the thought of having to write them made me feel bad. And yet my many prayers and cries did not help to grant me silence.

It was the first time in my life that such a thing happened. I do not say what I felt in writing because I was completely shaking and the unrest was such that I cannot describe. When I was bringing her with me to the other, something was happening; what a pain, my Good! Certainly, if she does not reciprocate to these graces // I see that she will have a serious judgment.

My Good had accepted my suffering and even this for her. What a pain! But my dear and beloved Being of my life certainly will not impose it another time because I feel in me this certainty.

A soul of purgatory awaiting her entry into heaven

One morning while I meditated, I fell into a trance and I remained out of myself for some time; I then saw a soul which died long ago and I knew nothing about it. It appeared to me pale and sad; it was tuned towards someone with whom it was speaking of certain affairs. I asked it to look at me, but fearfully because I was afraid that it might be in hell. As soon as I saw its gloomy eyes, // I asked where it was. It answered:

  • In purgatory.

It was sad; since it was not answering, I said to it:

  • Where are you, are you in heaven?

It made a big sigh.

  • Nowadays those who enter are very few! - it said –

How few do enter!

I said:

  • I hope!

Then it said something and again it said:

  • So much is required for entry!

And sighing it disappeared. It left me full of consolation and something heavenly which I cannot describe. What a joy, my God! Certainly if I think of this soul I feel pain; because it seemed to me it would stay for long time. I went to receive

Holy Communion and it was for this soul. // I asked:

Is it true what I saw? Were you the one? Do you need frequent Communion from me? Today send for me a bit of providence! She did send for me and I had a discreet day.

The night in continuous ecstasy of love

If I knew how to describe my state, it seems to me that, a month would not be enough to say everything. The right side is calm because of a great deal of bathing since I burn and in repressing the scar pains, it sends some flashes of burning that

I cannot bear. The need to stay always in the midst of many affairs of the world, the need of continuous repression and of driving away, shaking and distracting myself, I could say it is an agony for me except at night when I abandon myself fully to God. What I feel, // only he knows and could describe it.

I start saying: my Good, my All!

Having done a bit of adoration near a tabernacle, there I do not live anymore, but fully in my Being I am. Many times, the hands, the feet and the left side burn me and I find myself with my God. Outside of all creation, my mind conceives of nothing else, my intellect can see nothing but the pure God. That is how I spend my nights. In the morning certainly I have little strength and it is true that I do not remain always like that but I come back to myself; with much ardor I start to pray and I say: my Good, why do you let me live again? // Keep me with you and do not let me return to the earth! When I spend the whole night like this, in the morning I am worn out because this pig did not rest at all with sleep.

Oh, so many months have passed! I feel nothing; I see nothing that could comfort me like being with my God. Love, Love, you alone are my All!

I must force myself to drive him away; this brings me an acute breathlessness. I have no one to whom I can say a word and there are moments in which I feel like dying. Only God sees what I feel; alone I suffocate everything. Eating is a martyrdom and yet I do it because // I know it must sustain me, though I understand it is not enough. How many sufferings I am in! Every moment: my Good, stay away for charity’s sake! Oh, I am dying; only the person who experiences it could judge.

After a long time again the bright cloud

It is some time now that I expect something great that will take place; when I think, it is painful and curious, I do not know what it is or from which side it will come; I only know that it is a big providence.

Yesterday a big star appeared to me and it had a tail. Alas, who will it be! Mostly they are signals that a Daughter of St. Anne will die. But who will it be? It disappeared. The day before another one appeared to me many times, but much smaller. After a long time my cloud appeared. // How many months since I last saw it! But it left me nothing; only peace, consolation… no voice. Patience!

When I think that I could say I always saw it and I received everything from it! The union, the advice; I paused to contemplate it, I asked and a voice answered me. Now, no more; certainly they are my iniquities that drove it away.

Have pity, my God! This morning pausing for a while to think about my disgracefulness, I felt such horror that I could have destroyed myself. Unfortunately whatever takes place is because of my wickedness. I am a horror of ugliness, a monster! My Good, // do not look at me for pity’s sake;

otherwise you will certainly depart!

If I remain for sometime without finding him, I think:

alas, he finds me so deformed that he does not want to see me anymore! Oh, eyes, mouth of paradise, how much…

“My Good are you happy with my sufferings?”

For some days now I felt an unrest herald of bad news, because attached there are certain words not explained;

however, from the whole context they explain to me the future. The thought that other times I found myself in this agony should frighten me because it seemed to me to die. I say other times but I could say thousands of times.

After having suffered immensely // in a journey, I went to a church where an image of the Sacred Heart could be found. I stopped to thank him for having made a good journey. I only offered him my suffering. As soon as I looked at him he smiled to me. My Good, are you happy with my suffering and with what I did? How happy I am! I thank you because you mean it by showing yourself happy.

My Good, my only treasure, what are my pains in comparison to such consolation; they are nothing! Tread more heavily your arm; make me suffer more, for so little you give me so much.

I remained that way for some time. I would not have // moved. Unfortunately I had to be deprived by having someone who waited for me. Patience, I am not used to satisfying myself and I am always ready to walk wherever my Good sends me. Many times in the morning I am so tightly united with him that I enjoy a thousand consolations and suddenly he withdraws everything. I remain dumb and I feel something which pushes me out: my Good, I go, I go to work! Whatever it will be! In fact I always find with surprise that there was something to be done or there were people waiting for me. //

One morning, it is long time ago, I knew I had nothing to be done urgently and I wanted to remain a bit more to say certain prayers. No, a voice said:

  • Go away immediately!

I played deaf: enough, the third time I stood up and I said:

  • This morning the devil is already trying to upset me. It is enough, I go, and if there will be nothing I will return.

As soon as I reached where the sisters were, I found a serious thing to be arranged; as a result I said within me: my Good, forgive me! I feared it was the voice of the devil to make me go out not knowing that // there was something to be done; another time at your first voice, I will run immediately.

In the same way to see the smallest things that pass within the sisters, so many, that I do not say anything, otherwise they could realize.

This morning what I felt! The same was at night but much more in the Holy Communion. To say certain things to my Good, to feel intimately assured and to hear also that my All is very happy that I had to say: how dear you are, my Beloved! Yes, you desire nothing but that we beg you and you give us. // Why do not all do like that! How unfortunate they are!

“It seems to me to be working for something that will have no end”

It is now some time that everything that is earthly and human produces a certain curious effect in me; looking at it I feel compassion and I say:

  • Poor, now you vegetate and after sometime you will turn to dust and you will exist no more.

When I see people seeking beauty, putting together things for the future and in this way doing everything for the present, I say:

  • Oh, foolish human beings, you toil so much and tomorrow you have nothing!

This is continuous. Nevertheless it does not take away the possibility of work, of thought and of consolidating the //

Work of God, but this produces in me another effect. It seems to me to work for something which will have no end;

it belongs to God and is for God, for him everything is eternal. But then I had to think to prepare more things for the sisters individually; everything seems to me useless. I feel the same when I see they provide for me another pair of shoes… immediately I say:

  • My God, I am not sure of finishing these, // how can I accept another!

I feel pain to think that they will bring them. I must reproach those who did it and soon give them out. Otherwise

I suffer because my thought is always there. I could say that it seems to me that to carry them on the breast will disturb me immensely; the same is true with the clothes.

Oh, if my daughters could feel what I feel, they would not only never tease me saying that I need them, but they could let me go half dressed and with patched slippers!

My God – I always pray to him - // make them feel a bit what this unworthy servant of yours feels!

At every moment ready for the sweet passage of death

In these days when speaking, something curious happened to me. I was near someone and I made a firm resolution not to speak of certain affairs regarding the person and the community. Not at all! Could I keep quiet? I made the most difficult struggle that could be made and with all that I was not able to keep quiet. I could say words were coming out of my mouth without knowing what I said // and still more with the fear that certain people could turn against me.

And yet it is not good. If you want like this, my God, it means that you will defend me from these foxes. In this way I hope and I am even sure that you will do well in the future and you will defend your servant.

He who sees the future and knows how to arrange it with magnificence and infinite wisdom said those words which I did not want to say because of fear and he saw they were necessary for the good of his Work. I cannot explain the thing which is in me, in being at every moment // at the end of my life. It is true that the suffering, the lack of life that I feel could be the cause of this, but I have been like this for many years. It never happened to me as often as now. It seems to me that at any moment I could be in the arms of my Good and see him face to face, very calm as if it were a sweet passage; serene, I think of it and moreover it is continually before me. They could be the tribulations but I am sure they are not because I had much advantage; furthermore, I see that little by little // whatever my Good said to me and showed me in the past which seemed to me impossible to take place is happening.

Before it was something different, but now I see the Work of God consolidated and spread in the entire world; the spirit of the Institute observed by the religious and the Constitutions practiced very well. I must say that every day is a consolation. And yet every day far from being gloomy, I am even happy. This thing comes to me and I always keep it before me: every moment I will be with my Beloved. //

It might be the union that my Good always makes me enjoy, which makes me see and think like this. A thousand thoughts pass through my mind when I start thinking of the fact that the saints trembled. Then I say:

  • My God, when will I die? How sweet you are death, because soon I will see my Good!

Oh, how many times I lamented, indeed I always lament when I return after I have been enjoying with him. My Good why do you leave me to come back to life? Oh, another time keep me with you // and do not allow that I return in the midst of these miseries of the earth anymore; everything it contains makes me feel horror.

I lament for half hour periods, though I am resigned and very happy to suffer again for my Good; but I cannot fail to express these feelings. I am sure that anyone who feels what I feel could do the same; in thinking that whoever truly loves desires that the Beloved be honored and revered. And the pain that I feel when I think there is someone who offends my Good is so much, that at the thought that my // children can offend him, I offer them with much zeal and I tell him with all the strength of my soul, that he may take them as soon as possible before they become the cause of his suffering.

Alas, what I felt in these days for this fear! Only my Good knows it. I must confess that the love I have for these two children is great. I could submit myself willingly to the mortal wound of their death rather than see them evil and offenders of God, my unique All.

MS 4.2 – pp. 1-31

“The Sacred Heart always sends me to work”

11 Friday (…) 1873. How much sweetness I felt in remaining with my Beloved! He taught me various things and he instructed me on what I should do regarding his Work. But in receiving him, what happened to me for the third time, regarding that one… However, the need was that I should turn and in this way he took away everything because I desisted. I could lose everything rather than move. It was not enough. As I looked, the Holy Mother consoled me and she communicated to me something as if she said: “You will have good news and you will be consoled regarding what you asked.” Turning to the image of the Sacred Heart I told him various things but even he had something. I lamented and he became serious. I stayed weeping while kneeling and he laughed // but it was a strange laughter because he always sends me to work; as if I was pushed I felt: “Well, I go patiently!” As soon as I stood to go away, a voice said to me:

  • No, take your time!

I remained, promising to be more careful.

“My life is a continuous martyrdom”

September 1873: For many days and even some months my life has been a continuous martyrdom; I do not feel any satisfaction in the suffering. I feel indifference towards it. I meditate less, because during the day I am ill, I have a headache, and I have to be busy with the Work of God. I do not seek to concentrate because I am afraid that they may realize something; // in addition, I do my best to distract myself. Only at night can I give vent to prayer, meditation and I remain with my God.

But, alas! In these times in the morning I have a thousand doubts and many times I am overwhelmed with gloom and I do not know where to find peace in the midst of many affairs; everything seems far from taking effect and at the end even on this side I find tribulation and suffering.

In the midst of these affairs I feel a burning on the left side and not being able to bathe I feel pain. I seek fresh air and // I stroll, but this is only a bit of relief when the pain of the hands and feet is added as it is these days.

Pretending is something painful, and costs me much but the fear that they may realize is also very painful. I am in despair and when I start praying it is a torture such that I cannot describe. Am I abandoned by my God? Are my Communions sacrileges? Thinking in this way I retired in my cell. Suddenly I was absorbed. An interior voce said to me: “Rosa, remember that you received Holy Communion throughout your illness // and I always gave you strength;

you never took account of my grace. From midnight until the hour of reception I allowed a truce to your sufferings so that you did not need to take anything.”

As I recovered, full of confusion and inebriated I started to thank my Being and a thousand times I asked him for forgiveness.

I paused to consider it and I saw an abyss of graces which I received during my sickness. But after some time I relapsed in the same state in which I am still. Alas, I am without any relief and I must always pretend and conceal with all the religious so that nobody could understand my state. //

How much my bad character makes me suffer! I feel always more tortured whenever I think of saying a word of what happens to me; I do all I can to amend myself but it is useless. It is worse, for I renew a thought and then a strong pain awakens in me. In some moments I stay in peace but it is brief because temptations trouble me whispering:

  • Do you think you are well guided by yourself and are you sure that everything is from God?

It is true that when this anxiety increases to a point of despair my God comes to help me and I stay in peace. I have much fatigue for my unbelief. // Because of the weakness of mind many times I cannot remember what I see and hear. The most I can remember is when I ask for clarification regarding the Work or other things of mine.

She takes again the penances by the Lord’s order

My Being never denied me anything of what I asked of him. Now that I write because I am in peace I can say that it would be impossible that temptations of any kind make me fail in belief of what happens to me. I seek God and nothing could perturb me because I am very well assured by my Good, having received from him enough lessons on the diabolic molestation. It is // divine will that this take place; it would not affect me if after some hours I could be in a stormy sea and not know in which way to save myself from being wrecked. My God, the suffering of my soul pleases you, let it be!

After having many times told me to take again my penances, from July, when I fell sick, he started to exhort me to take them again in September. I always tried to be deaf alleging the fact that I felt very weak and I could not bear to wear a very heavy chain, but he made himself heard always more strongly. Finally one day and it was mid-October of 1873, the date was 18, of the mentioned month, he said that // I should not delay to obey, that I should wear the big chain around the belt and the small one indicating to me the left arm, that I should wear it around and over the elbow. As I came out of the church I ran to my room in order to obey; but being very exhausted by the weight of the iron, at two o’clock in the afternoon I was swollen and the chain was so tight that I had to go to bed saying that I had pain because I was fainting. In fact it was atrocious. I was unable to remove it. My strength was failing me and the swelling was tightening. The pain I had on the right because of the illness // almost prevented me from breathing.

I offered everything in peace to the author of these sufferings. My Good, do as you like, provided that no one realizes anything that I have.

In the evening I felt faint; I went to bed and I fainted.

Finally at night, I got enough strength to be able to unfasten and as I abandoned myself in bed it loosened by itself.

I carry well the one of the arm; it is now fifteen days that I have had it and I see that it will end up embodied in my flesh for it has already started. But what should I do? The

// state that I feel in this suffering is such that, if it could increase until the agony of death I could say of suffering nothing; the more pain, the greater the delight. In fact, I do my work well. I spare no toil and I go where I need to go.

On the day of St. Michael, I disciplined myself to bleeding at length in his honor for the protection of this angel who defends me, guides me and sustains me in my journeys.

As I finished, a strong melancholy overcame me seeing those instruments which I was unable to use anymore. // Prostrate on the ground I took my Crucifix and holding him tightly I wept. My Good, what do I do? I am not useful on this earth anymore! And I looked to the instruments. A voice consoled me saying: “They are as dear as if you always wore them and used them.” I kissed my Crucified God and I was very consoled. The swelling of the heart in these days was without compare; the fire devoured me and destroyed me. The suffering that I felt from so much swelling is such that I am not able to describe it; but much more is the delight that I feel because this keeps me grasping to my Good.

No pain annoys me! //

The teachings of the Lord regarding the Work.

“He dictates to me”

17 November 1873. Not having a moment of time, in these days of toil and of extreme sufferings and of agony such that it seems I am dying I did not find my Good. Submerged in suffering, I wept under his feet and I lamented much. I was in a trance and I felt nothing, I saw nothing but something heavenly kept me submerged in a peaceful drowsiness; this is how I explain it not knowing other terms. Later I went to work and again I was before my All; I came back with something joyful within me … my Good! Oh, joy!

Looking at the big picture of the Sacred Heart, I saw my Good laughing; this was enough to return to the union which I enjoyed and which I still enjoy. What nights! Always with // my God! He teaches me and fortifies me. Some times, as I return from the rapture, I say to him: my Good, do you see this and the other? This is what they do to me! How I suffer! Tell me how I should behave in order to do your divine will!

He consoles me now with a caress, then with a word telling me: “My Rosa!” As I finish I am again absorbed in him without seeing the person nor tasting him, only a Being that I do not understand when I am in this state. In these days the graces I received are immense; how can I thank my God? The teachings that he always gives me for his Work have no end. And this // has no other reason than to annihilate me. The sight of my nothingness is such that it seems to me impossible that the creatures who meet me and stay with me could respect me; instead they should despise me and drive me away.

I have letters to write; since I am an ignorant animal he dictates what I must say. I am in the presence of people who are concerned with the Work; something happens to me, it seems that there is someone inside me to speak for me, because words come out of me without my knowing what I say. I hear them and understand them knowing that they are not mine; because I would not be capable of saying them. My God, he is the one who makes the most // ignoramus of creatures like me speak and work.

In all this time I had not a moment to be able to describe the immense graces that my God gave me. I only say that as a child he led me by hand in whatever I did in his Work.

Apparition of St. Anne with sorrowful semblance

One day I saw the Holy Mother very sorrowful and a black veil covering her face. Alas, what will happen in the

Work? I asked her why she showed herself like this and what was wrong, what would happen. She only answered me generally.

What is there, my God? How is your Work the cause of your suffering? Enough! I did not delay in discovering everything.

Another time I saw her in the same manner; the veil was blacker; I wept. What is the matter, my Mother? I saw a room // where cards were moving and certain things which did not please the saint were done. They were the people from outside who brought the trouble against us; but while weeping I looked again at her and a very bright light as big as the darkness which was there before covered her. This helped nothing other than to calm me. I looked again: the light disappeared and again the black remained. A voice of my friend said: “Something serious will happen to you.”

What anguish! I pleaded with her to tell me what it was, but nothing. However, a soft voice said: “Prepare yourself to receive it with // resignation.” That was what I did. It was not long before it happened. It took only two days.

  • I went to the church and she was covered in black.

  • My Mother, did it not finish?

  • No – she answered again – many must pass.

What a wound I felt! Only my God can know what anguish I had. In fact, I could say that a day does not pass without having new ones of all kinds.

The oil for the sick. Afflictions. Sorrowful presages

On the evening of Christmas, my Eternal Father again gave me the oil for the sick and I spent the night in the church meditating very well upon the crib of Bethlehem. I remained absorbed in it, adoring the Child. I felt much consolation and the // strength to resist, to stay at the foot of the altar while I was feeling very sick. I pretended to go to bed and when I realized that all were asleep, I woke up and run to my Beloved. I remained with him for the whole night. The past came back to me when I did that. It is now a year since I was able to do so. I tried the other times but I always failed, I suffered, I agonized and I was forced to go to bed quickly. Instead this night I suffered nothing and I was able to bear it. Oh, I understand everything well when my Being // fortifies me and caresses me like this. Certainly they all announce an unhappy future and in fact the next day was like that. What humiliation and tortures I felt only God knows. These help me to be more united with my Good

Humiliation brought me close to the Child as I said to him: are you happy? Nevertheless, it cannot be compared to his humiliation, even if I am scorned in every way. What sweetness is found in suffering! What greatness is found in humiliation! I suffered another sorrow // in this days for having again a star or two before my eyes. One was small, and did not give me much thought, knowing that she was a Daughter of St. Anne, perhaps a nurse. Certainly to see another one very big that stayed always before me, which announces to me a superior, a serious melancholy took me. I went to the church and I wept disgusted. I asked the Holy Mother St. Anne to pray to God so that he may not take superiors anymore, because I am very much in need. Oh, if the Eternal Father could grant me!

For // various days I did not see the big one anymore. I lamented because he does not let me see certain things before they happen. He answered me that if I could see before they occur, I could suffer too much and I could not resist; in this way the blow is only once. To see all could cause me horrible suffering; this is why many times he leaves me in the dark. It is true that when it is something that I can put right before it happens, this I always see. Otherwise I remain //

[Blank page] completely in the dark, a proof my Jesus gave me once when I asked him this. He showed me everything that was to happen to me and he did not tell me when. What I felt my God! I always expected, today, tomorrow. At the end it was martyrdom and I asked no more. Oh, yes, you are right to say that when some misfortune is expected, the martyrdom prolonged by anxiety is too painful; it is a suffering unheard-of.

“My Good keeps me in a continuous school”

I was traveling in a certain dangerous place. I do not know but some fear came upon me as if it was of death or something else. // I was so fearful when turning my eyes up

I saw a cloud of angels.

My angel Michael said to me: what do you fear? Am I not here? What I felt I am unable to express!

Other times he showed himself in an act of defense.

How much learning I had from my Good! He comforts me, sustains me; it would take a long time if I narrated everything! I only say that it is a continuous school. First he suggests to me what I must do; later he shows me certain things hidden in the hearts of others. How much pain I felt when I had to pretend with certain people // whom I know have a heart infected by a thousand evil affections and certain commands I had to swallow for the sake of prudence. Oh, but if I could say: “Take off that habit and clothe yourselves with that of grace!”

I cannot bear to suffer duplicity and now the world is full of this spirit. On the last day of the year I felt something new: I was in one of our houses and I had found some disorder because of lack of observance of the Rule. My mind was full of thoughts regarding the Work and I felt pushed to correct those weaknesses. How can I do it my God? Yes, my Good, // I will gather the religious but certainly if you do not speak for me, I am incapable of pronouncing a word since my head is confused in a chaos of affairs. I felt a stronger spur, I stood up and I found them all gathered together. I started speaking and what did I say? My Good, I was listening to how you spoke so well; I was listening and repeating.

“Fully absorbed in him I remain nights.

Oh, vigils of love!”

For various days now the pain of the hands and of the feet increased without measure. On some night, when my Good unites me with him in such tenderness my mind has nothing in it but him alone. All // the thoughts of his Work go away from me; only my God remains; my powers rest with him, only he nourishes them. There is no more human baseness, only divine greatness; I am fully absorbed in him for nights. Oh, vigil of love! In the morning they leave me very tired because this pig of a body did not sleep. Rome! For me you are my exile, because in this house I can do none of my dear penances; I tremble when in the dark night I put this beast under the lashes of discipline and after I feel bad, much more for the anxiety than for // the strikes.

To live in common in the rooms is very painful. The fear of being discovered gives me continuous pain. I am like a thief who lives in continual unrest and does nothing other than hide her misdeeds. When I am twisted by the pains of hands and feet, then I find a pretext: I say I am sick but I do not say where and I go to bed, because I cannot stand on my feet. Yesterday, Friday, what I felt in meditation, only my God knows. I am not able to describe it. In him, my Good, I find everything, I have everything. From when I felt persecutions, the frequent diabolic apparitions ceased. The last time was two months ago. // It tried to frighten me, but seeing I made fool of it, it did not appear in that form again.

I would accept its strikes a thousand times, provided it leaves the Work at peace. At night I do not see it. Yesterday a small star was moving around me. At the end I saw it upon the head of one who was undecided to be a Daughter of St. Anne. She confirmed to me that she will be one because the star came upon her head as if she wanted to say:

“Here is another Daughter of St. Anne.” I never see this star but only when some one of these will die. //
