In Mother Rosa, the conscience of a Foundress becomes always more present in her spiritual introspections. The positive or negative behavior of the religious is reflected on her maternal sensitivity. She felt assisted in a tangible way in everything regarding the Institute. In the midst of sufferings and diabolic suggestions which put her on the edge of despair, dominates in her pages an atmosphere of serenity and optimism, fruit of her experience of faith and love. “Your love surpasses everything – she wrote on May 11 – and it is the support, the relief, the certainty of the Work. It is the anchor which sails from the deep painful sea of our tribulation.”

These expressions belong to the last note of May 11, 1874. We do not know if the long interruption of seven months and a half was caused by the circumstance of the life of Mother Rosa or perhaps we should lament the loss of an entire booklet correspondent to the months of May – December.

To judge from the letters, 1874 was a year of exacting activity in the government of the Work. We find the Foundress in Rome most of the first semester in constant communication with Sister Anne Vincenza Rampallino, her delegate, almost a vicar general. From the end of May to the end of August we find her in Piacenza; then in Nizza Monferrato, Ovada, and Genoa and again in Piacenza in the last three months of the year.

The evil of duplicity among the religious

In the night of 30 January 1874 I was very ill. I was feeling restlessness and I did not know where to find peace.

I suffered from the spasms and to these a torture was added which I cannot describe. Struggling first on one side and then on the other, I was not able to stand on my feet. I prayed but even this was toil because I had to struggle much to make spiritual communions having a crowd of thoughts or rather distraction that made me suffer. At the end tossed, exhausted, lying on my back, I looked and saw a blanket at the back of the bed and on its top there was a big beast scrambling up.

  • Oh - I then exclaimed – I understand ugly beast: you are the cause of my much // suffering! Go away from me, monster of Satan! And it disappeared. I started praying and calmly I slept a bit. But in the morning I was upset as if I was under a wheel. I understood that the one with the clutches had come but, by this time it will be driven away from this house. For three days I did not see it but I head it mooing because it is upset for not being able to remain in those souls of which it was in possession. For a second I saw the evil that still dominated in the religious; the evil is so complicated, what a horror! What confusion! // They act only out of passion! A voice said to me there have not been centuries without evil because there are general disorders in those who pretend to be good. He made me feel that it was very painful for him to find duplicity in all as if in these days sincerity had disappeared. Horror!

Therefore, my Good – I indicated this to him and the other person – they are not truthful; and yet their saying, their manner seems … How should I guard, how will I escape from these evil hands! // Oh, my Good!

He assured me that I will overcome everything and the ugly with clutches will come out of these hearts.

Concern for the spiritual state of a person

1st February 1874. The pains in the hands and feet particularly in the hands are very strong; but the same suffering gives me sweetness. They are pains of hell that I suffer in these days having to see continually suffering a person who is possessed by a spirit. I see the spirit entering to torment her through a means very hidden from the eyes of this unfortunate to be betrayed by her own heart; I do not put more.

I recommended to the Holy Mother, the Blessed Virgin and the Eternal Father // that they may instruct me on what I should do regarding this person so that she may be converted and return to him as in the past. He assured me that all this will take place, but the affair was very delicate.

One morning, in thanksgiving, something overtook me; an interior voice seemed to suggest to me what I should say. As I returned, I was thinking but I concluded to do nothing because human respect, the fear of having to face greater troubles, made me suspect that the impulse which I had could be diabolic and I put aside the thought. But I prayed more. One day as I finished praying, as someone who cannot bear it anymore, I turned to the Holy Mother and I said: what should I do?1 // I do not know anywhere to turn the head; my mind is no more capable of thinking on this matter. Every time that I ask for her removal, you oppose me. What should I do? I kissed the ground desolate and went away.

I was on the table writing and again that impulse I mentioned above took me, that is, to reveal everything; as soon as she came before me with much strength I told her everything. My God! The evil one departed, not quickly because it still resisted, but after some time, thanks to her sweet character and her innocence it could not stay and it left. I went to the church to thank God and what // a consolation I felt when the Holy Mother started laughing and with an act of joy she consoled me. Oh, my Mother, are you happy? Forgive me if I resisted doing your will fearing

I’d be mistaken.

It was the only reason that kept me from putting into execution what I was feeling. Meanwhile I offered to the Eternal Father what I suffered in telling to that person what I knew. I confess that the pain was so much that for a long time my head seemed to me empty.

The case of a sister dismissed from the Institute

To the contrary I felt much pain, for another one who was contradicted and I had to dismiss her…I went to the church: my Good, tell me, what should I do? //

A voice said to me: “Send her away!” I stopped again to understand better: “Send her away”, repeatedly. I came out more decided and soon I did what my God commanded me.

I had received many other clarifications on this person and I had no peace; I wanted my Good to convert her before reaching the execution. Why did he convert one and not the other? I should say many things if I have to write what he showed me: that as a religious she could never do any good, that the graces the Lord gave her were immense but she never corresponded, pride, the… // and he showed me many other things that surprised me.

What a gracious night I spent when I put into execution what my Good desired! I prayed but I was not in ecstasy as during the other times; now and then I made spiritual communions. Then I stayed a bit without saying anything, not even thinking. I felt something sweet that according to me was bringing me sleep; in fact, I believed that I slept. I seemed to dream that my Eternal Father kept me tightly holding to him in a paradise of sweetness and I delighted; it seemed to me that I was submerged into an immense light.

After a dream I started to distribute soup in a poor school

At a certain moment he ordered me to draw away and to

// go to save many girls who were lost here and there. I was doing it unwillingly, but seeing him going away I started weeping: my God, come with me, do not leave me alone! Yes, I will go to work, I will gather these poor girls and I will give them food!

While I said this he disappeared. Near me there was a creature that was as big as the angel I received ten or thirteen years earlier, a small angel.

But since I have my Archangel Michael, I fear nothing.

I will conclude narrating what I did with those poor creatures: I gave food to all, I helped them and I felt // inebriated with much joy.

When I woke up I was very happy and full of strength, sure of doing everything for charity. In fact I started to give soup in a poor school and I had every thing: my God, you wanted this and your slave for love, sustained by your arm, my ass went where you wanted, my Good, as you commanded. Sweetest command that inebriates and fortifies! You make very sweet and gentle every kind of work, because the essence of your saying is such that it inebriates.

How I curl in my nothingness! I see myself very wretched and less than nothing! // Confused I do my work always trembling for fear of spoiling what my Beloved had ordered and prepared. Oh, how many times I spoiled it, because I am very ignorant and not very capable of understanding his signals!

My Good, how much I could have suffered in seeing myself minimally intelligent and a monster of infamy. This is what makes me so blunt, not understanding well the delicacy of your saying. I am a stinky vase to let your purest essence penetrate me! My God, have pity on me!

Jesus: “I am your guide, your comfort”

It was curious. While I prayed // for a person so that the Holy Mother may confirm her as a true daughter of hers and make her an instrument for her Work – though I am in the most horrendous pains of the spirit and in the midst of tribulations of the Work – even in that moment the voice of my Good penetrated my soul and for a second I remained relieved of such numberless tribulations.

Today was a sorrowful day. I did not find peace and pretending strangles me. What agony, my God! I feel a thousand fears.

In a flash of light in these days I saw very many things.

I also had moments of light in prayer, lessons of my God.

He revealed to me a plot of certain people //who plotted against the Institute, but they will be brought down; the powerful hand of God will put everything to an end.

The words of my Good came true in all the plots. A good portion has been discovered in these days and many more are being discovered. I prayed for the gift of providence and at the end of the prayer, I saw how my God would have always cared for whatever I might be in need of.

How many things he told me when I complained of being alone in a Work of great importance and my poor spirit suffered much because it is without a guide and without comfort. “I am // your comfort.” That was what he made me hear.

What I felt in these sweet words! Only you my Good could say it; I am unable! But I enjoy a peace, calm without compare. You only are my All; make clear to me with the brightest light the way I should go. Animated by you, my Beloved, my foot will be able to stand in you presence.

A sister freed from a diabolic spirit

After the night of hell of 6 March, I was not able to appease my spirit. All the worst temptations were coming before me with subtle skill because wherever I turned the mind I found an abyss that wrapped me. I tried to sway myself but it was useless; if I went to the church it was worse.

// With a clear voice I heard the most obscene words that could ever be thought. At the end I turned to him: monster of hell, you will not win, because with the help of God I hope to put you to flight. In this way it departed ashamed, leaving me with my Good who did not delay to come to console me, burning me – this is how I express myself – with his love and by telling me things which will happen to me. I was to prepare myself to receive them because after I would see other great things in his Work. And yet, it was for me a great consolation to see departing a diabolic spirit from a Daughter of St. Anne, // which I saw in her and more I was able to see clearly the bad spirit, that it produced in her. As soon as what I asked unceasingly of my Beloved was granted, it departed and she was completely freed. But something has been formed in her which I do not yet understand well. I said it departed, not being able to act because this person has put herself very well on the side of God in this game. But some thing, that is, the weakness to consent to others suggestions left me a bit turbid; she would not // return in the previous form but in another manner which I would call pride. I saw that the spirit of this creature was in danger.

“For me the world seems hell. Oh, earth of tribulations!”

Alas, while I write I see passing before me a sorrowful scene. Ah, my God, what a bitter cup; sustain me, because I fear, I fear! Support me with your powerful arm! Oh, how can I resist! My God, keep this tribulation away from me; moreover if it is about the Constitutions, I cannot bear it! This suffering is such that I feel I am dying! What a cruel agony!

I have a small star // that comes before me now and then. Another Daughter of St. Anne will depart for paradise. Oh, blessed are you who already leave to see my Beloved! In this moment for me the world seems like hell because the atrocious pains which I feel twist all my nerves. Oh, earth of tribulations, I hold you because in the pains you have I know you purify me! Suffering, suffering, you are sweet to me. I love you because of my Good! If I fear that I am failing to resist, it is because I feel unable to bear it. Help me and comfort me in this cruel // agony.

Evening of 11(…) while I was lying, I was unable to rest;

I had not even that sweet union of my God. Restlessness was increasing in a way that I understood there was something which was causing me a similar disturbance. My

God, free me from this state! In this way, awake and uneasy in the whole body, I did not know where to stay. At the end,

I saw a very big black beast attached to the ceiling. I paused looking at it and for sometime it stayed motionless. It was enormous; the legs were short but very large. It started to move and run for some minutes and // then it disappeared.

I regained peace, I stayed praying united with Good and again I was with my Good.

Oh, monster – I said, when I saw it – what do you want?

Go away, ugly beast! You announce unhappy news. Well, I will prepare myself to receive it holding tight my God and with his grace I will receive it in peace.

Very grave and painful are the battles. I must sustain certain assaults of despair which suddenly disappear.

Serenity arrives to replace the despair.

Different impressions about people

In my prayer after the Holy Communion for the sake of a religious, // I saw the bad death he would have gone through and the reason for which he was stricken in that way. What a dread! I was disturbed and with all my strength I tried to turn away from such a dread monster because the sin was exposed to me under the picture of its monstrosity. Alas, what I suffered! I remained very upset that still now, while writing, I must conclude because I have some kind of fear that arouses similar things in my mind.

At this followed the sweet union of a soul that my God gave me as companion in the Holy Communion. // What takes place with this creature is curious! I always keep her on the right side and it might be a year that she always comes close while I am on the altar and she never mistakes the side; many times I make a space for her as if she were really there. I see God loves her very much and he told me the reason but I would like to know more because there are certain special things which I do not understand.

I have an ill-omened thought regarding a certain person. I fear that it may come true because looking at my Sacred Heart, I saw him dark in the face, // a sign of melancholy. Oh, my Good, no more such agonies.

“It is better to have faith than the love of God”

What a beautiful lesson I had regarding those words that a deceased person said to me, that it was better to have faith than the love of God. I wish to explain how I interpret this statement: the love of God is the greatest good that we can have but faith is certainly necessary because when we are arid and the soul is in the dark, we do not have any support but faith. This in the darkest underground guides us to find again our // Good. In the same way, in desolations it assures us that God hidden to our eyes, watches over us and that we are obliged to correspond. My dear friend, a favored soul who from heaven consoles me so well, is my comforting angel; she forewarns me when something sinister will happen to me. In the same way in afflictions that I must undergo in this affaire, she suggested to me one thing more than another. Oh, what an angel! In my aridity, fears, and anxieties she comforts me.2

What anguishes I find myself in at present! If it were not for the faith that governs me // I do not know how I would react to the afflictions caused by the Work together with those of the spirit. Many times I do not know where to lean my head.

“It seemed me damned and at the edge of hell”

On the eve of St. Joseph the tribulations, the anguishes and the temptations were without compare; in the evening

I was afflicted. They reached a certain point that I seemed to be damned and at the edge of hell. What despair, my

God!

All my faults or rather an abyss of iniquity appeared to my mind. Everything I did seemed to me evil. Oh, I am damned!

I started to pray: my God is indignant with me, I thought. I was tired of staying awake // without being able to say a word to my Good because I remained unable to speak. I found no word or tear, only a trunk and I did not see anything other than hell open for me. Everything I said of a priest to someone who could remedy certain scandals seemed to me wrong, because I failed in charity and I did not keep quiet about certain things which he said regarding the Work. Therefore, he showed me there was more than despair. Seeing this I answered: this is your infamy which torments me! But nevertheless I stated that // they were becoming stronger.

Well, trusting in my Mother, the Church, I will renew all my confessions, I will throw myself at the feet of my God!

Nothing! I was arid and the suggestions grew and grew. I went to bed worn out; it seemed to me that I slept, but I suffered so much that I could not bear it; I was fainting. A black-out made me suffer horribly; it ceased for one moment and I drowsed.

A strong shaking woke me. I opened my eyes: There on the wall was a big beast; it had long legs and was small. It climbed up and down the wall, and then it disappeared. // It left the wall dark for a while; later it became white as before.

Again I was upset; I feared fainting because I was without strength. What could I do? The foot of the bed shook; it seemed as if they moved the straw. But the shaking of the bed never went above my knees. // I do not understand it myself.

Enough! After a long shaking it left. I remained upset and depressed.

Today I have a bit of calm, more from weariness than from being healthy, because it seems that my head is incapable of thought; in the same way everything I do seems to me bad.

Oh, unfortunately, I am an abyss of iniquity and I am waiting for very painful sufferings.

On 24, eve of Our Lady of Annunciation, while I was in the church reciting the rosary, together with the others, an abyss of wickedness came before me; not only my nothingness // but that precipice was for me and I was damned. At this sight the apprehension was such that I fainted; a cold sweat permeated my whole body. I forced myself and I ran away; I do not know who supported me; certainly I was not alone because lying on the bed I questioned myself.

How did I manage to escape when it seemed that I would drown? In that moment what torture! Such trembling and fear remained upon me that I was not able to calm down. They said it was weakness and they gave me food, but I well know what that horrible spectacle was. It seems to me that I must always // return to it. My God, for me everything is finished! Finally horrible darkness!

My wickedness has brought me to this: what should I do? Am I damned? No, my Good! But I was able to say nothing; my Being had run away and I found myself in the midst of the spirits of hell. The bones themselves seemed to be chopped that still today I feel weariness.

Last evening, 25, at midnight my bones started to hurt me in such a way that I understood it was not sickness. Finally, drowsy as I was, I saw scratching over the curtain. // On my feet I had a small black beast like those I was used to seeing. When it reached the iron it disappeared. I was not able to sleep, to pray, or to think. Ugly beast! It left me so affected that I felt pity. I do not see anything else but evil; all my actions are done badly.

What I did will be for my damnation, but it is the evil and the fear I felt that I still keep in my bones, and with all my strength I am unable to drive them away. One who did not experience it cannot understand what kind of suffering one goes through in these // moments.

“An indescribable peace in the midst of much torment”

28 March 1874. I was lying down and praying; a large bunch of flowers all of the same quality appeared to me. I looked well to see their quality but I did not understand. They were clear green and over some of them there was something very dark. It stayed for some time and then it disappeared; the stem was very long and I was not able to understand what it meant. It left me peace and union with my God…

The next day I was lying down because I suffered; it was in the morning and I prayed. At a certain moment my Beloved Child was seated // as in a green bush and upon this bush there were certain things which I was not able to distinguish. Nearby there was a man seated; this is what it seemed to me but I was not able to distinguish well because

I did not see the face nor the whole person: my Beloved, what did you leave me?

I felt an indescribable peace in the midst of much torment, and horrendous pains as those in which I am now. How much you sustain me my God! The tribulations suffocate me, the pain oppresses me, what ever agony is this?

There are moments in which the anxiety is so strong that I do not know where to find peace. Have // pity on me, my God!

Pride rooted in the Daughters of St. Anne

I am unable to describe how much I suffered on Good

Friday. Deprived of my strength I was fainting and I could not stand on my feet. Another grace I received from my friend Rosa3 was that she assured me about an important affair, that everything will be all right. In these days so many things I saw regarding the Work; the thing which afflicts me most is that certain Daughters of St. Anne do not give up the vice of pride. What a pain, my God! While I pray it comes before me and I see in them how it is rooted. It is presented

// to me in all its deformity; what a dread! I cannot express the abhorrence that I feel and I am not able to explain how those creatures have love for such a monster.

Oh, if I could make them understand how sweet humility is and that there is delight in possessing it. It seems to me that I could open the breast as if it is engraved inside. I would have the courage to open it and to show them for it is difficult to explain it. I meditate upon it and I am worried thinking how a creature could // approach pride and haughtiness.

Therefore, this monster reached the point of being so wild that it did not leave the noble senses the capacity of feeling; because if only the creature could feel the taste of sweetness, kindness, and humiliation that cannot be compared! Such is the taste that it gives to the creature in being humbled. She feels something gentle and sweet which unites her to her Good. She finds him in humiliation without toil; it seems that he comes closer to her and says: “I also come to taste of this sweetest // food of paradise.”

My good, don’t you allow these unhappy souls who live deprived such experience?

I prayed for a religious who made me suffer for a certain slander which he spread against the Work. While I begged my Good to be freed, at a certain moment I stopped and I had displeasure: If I will have no more of this, my God, I could not have those humiliations and I will be deprived. What will I have? Will it mean that I will not have my Good anymore? Oh, the consolation I find in the humiliations is too much // to escape them!

A sister possessed by an “attractive spirit”

In these days, how much the devil tries to torment me with fears, uproar and much more when it shakes the bed at the back by my feet. What gave me more pain is when it was heard by the others especially by the sisters who were frightened. I saw a Daughter of St. Anne possessed and I wanted to know the name of this spirit. I saw that it kept her tied giving very subtle advice apparently religious while it made her commit the worst faults. // But she was persuaded that they are all good things though I told her differently many times; I see that she cannot free herself.

The evil one is very astute!

Having asked for its name it answered me: “An attractive spirit.” It does not only attract her to its advice but she also drags others to herself.

In fact they described to me her features, that is, the manner through which she is identified. In hearing her she seemed very reserved but then she does not practice at all what she says. The same is for the observance: // she seems the most observant and later when she is able she makes even the others transgress. And then it seems she understands nothing but later evidences a shrewd brain.

The appearance is attractive in such a way that the strongest could fall. I hope to see her one day freed and the means I hope is the one my God taught me, if I do not err.

Suggestions of despair and deceitful temptation on the Work

My sufferings are grave: the suggestions that the infernal monster whispers in my ears in these moments are suggestions of despair, that I would not be able to bear this

// Work anymore. With much strength and astuteness it suggested to me to abandon everything. In this way, evil will come on those who caused me much anguish. With this saying it united something sweet and persuasive: that God would be happy, my persecutors would have pitied me in some way and, humiliated, would beat their chest. For a moment I remained absorbed in these thoughts. Turning to my Good, always without saying anything, I drove away such a horrible temptation saying to the monster: go away from me, cursed Satan! I am already suffering enough without your adding your astute pain upon pain! Go away from me!

In this way I remained // with my God. I offered myself as a victim for his Work, so that I can pour out my blood for it to the last drop. Never till now was I able to distinguish human malice. When I had to deal with something for the Work, I see the most hidden things. What torment and anguish I feel, I cannot express! I am not able to tell what I see while they pretend to make me understand what they do not do and they do not think. If the creatures could see what I suffer in the moments when I see, they certainly would be moved to compassion. //

In the same way, in these days my agony is so painful that sometimes it drives me out of my mind. Now I am taken by an aridity that seems to me an abyss open to swallow me as I would merit. Then I feel a union with my God as if I am dying. I receive beautiful lessons and I am always alone, without being able to say a word to a creature but only to my God.

Last night at twelve, when I was going to bed hoping to take a bit of rest, the bed seemed a ship in the midst of waves. A trembling was added that made me suffer. Amidst the trembling and the shaking I was restless because I was not able // to sleep as I desired. I took myself in spirit, as usual to make adoration first in one of our chapels and then in the other, making prayers and spiritual communions. Finally I heard something of an uproar as if my bed were left by someone who was dragging it away. Casually I lifted my eyes and I saw a very black beast that was about to run away. I remained motionless but soon I was united with my eternal Good and what sweetness I felt!

At the end I remained like that for a long time and then // I came to myself when it was day: tired, worn out, so weak that I was not able to stand on my feet. But what depressed me most was my Good

Conference to the sisters under the Lord’s dictation

I cannot omit to record what the Lord does in me when I have to give a conference to the Daughters of St. Anne. It is enough for me to gather my thoughts and to stand before my crucified Good: your ignorant slave must speak on the subject of perfection; you, my Beloved Master, must tell me what to say and I will repeat it and something happens in me that, if those listening to me were to see // it they would be amazed, but my All does not allow this to happen. His promise that he will never allow to be seen what he does in me assures me that no one will realize.

He seems to come close to me; often he dictates things from the Holy Scripture to me. He tells me things I do not know and he puts other beautiful things to say in my mind.

I often appreciate the things I say myself. At other times I do not: I speak in the third person and I do not understand what I am saying. At the end, what mercy! He sees the needs of these poor creatures // and he speaks through the mouth of an ass. He does not withdraw, or rather he does not step aside seeing my ineptitude, but for the good of these poor souls he makes use of this wretched creature to speak and express his will to these brides of his. My Good, what confusion is in me to see myself so deformed and that I never reach your infinite love! For the filthiness I have what pain I feel, my God! What can I say for my friend

Rosa, and for the graces that I receive continually! //

Assisted by the Lord in the affairs of the Work

This evening though it is late, I want to note down two remembrances. My God forgive me for not being able to travel anymore for long time! The immense occupations prevent me; there is willingness but the strength and the time are missing.

Today, 4 May, I will try to remember the best I can the favors I received from God.

I say that he has always been near me in everything I did and never omitted answering me when I asked him what I should do regarding his dearest Work.

I did not know whether it was better to do one thing than the other and I asked him: my Good, should I do this, yes or no? He answered me promptly, to me who shamefully should confess // that many times I instead wanted to act according to material appearances. He indicated to me that one action would be better than the other.

I wept for disobeying and not listening to his voice. But my God! With the fear of making a mistake that it might not be the voice of my Being, my Beloved, I stop.

Today I had to go to a town for a matter related to the Work. In the church I asked my Good if I should go, yes or no because the weather was very bad and all suggested // me not to go. Three times I said: my Good, dear Jesus, should I go? And he: “Yes, go.” But looking at the weather I said: I am mistaken; and I decided not to go. And there, just the hour in which I was to go the weather was good. You only, my Good, can say what your slave felt for not having gone there on time. Many other things happened like this. It is true that many times I carry on and I am happy, but I am sorrowful when I do the contrary.

The sweetness that I felt these days I am not able to describe // and if the continuous distractions would not have diverted me a bit I could have remained immobile, submerged in that most divine union that I enjoy at night. Oh, sweetness without compare, sweetest Love, it is only you who sooth the horrible pains which are in your Work! There are moments in which in the sight of the tribulations which I have to go through I feel I cannot manage and am possessed by a melancholy of death. I find nothing that lifts me up; everything, everything is dismal. I see an enormous abyss before me, a big field entirely entrenched with cruel thorns. Oh, yes, in those // moments the soul feels as if it is in a thousand pieces!

Alas! It is the only word I am given to say. My mind is no longer capable of reasoning. My intellect has lost the capacity of formulating thoughts, right ideas. I become a trunk when I go to the feet of my God to have comfort and find a way of giving vent to my sorrow. I find nothing, I am dumb and I can say nothing. I look at an image to ask for pity, but nothing; it even afflicts me more. What a horrible state is this, my God! I cannot remember anything of your graces, // my Good!

It is impossible to describe the graces that my God gave me because I have no time to note down something as I had promised to my Being. It is toil for me to gather together the specific aspects. How much I enjoyed, even when the scars of penances were very painful! The suffering was atrocious but what I was feeling was such that it soothed everything.

The same went for the pains of the hands and feet, the swelling of the left side; the pain is much but how consoled one feels. Oh, suffering, I feel you kill my flesh but you do so much good to my soul! If once I hated this rotten // body, now I dislike it less and I would say that sometimes I am even moved to pity.

“Your love is the anchor that sails from the troubled sea of our tribulations”

11 May 1874. How much I am anguished because yesterday I was not able to note down certain small things which disturbed me and which I could explain well according to certain illustrations that I was given at that moment. The other fear I have is that of not having understood properly. This morning when I had received my God, something new happened to me and I asked for explanation. But I fear // much for not having understood well and that the diabolic spirit could enter making me believe one thing instead of another. I confess that in the midst of the Work, this tortures me, but I am full of confidence that my Good will not delay to send me lights.

Oh, who can take me out of these terrible thoughts!

The torture is cruel because I fear that my God might not be happy with what I did and that I did not understand what he wanted from me. Alas, only you my Good, could explain this anguish; the suffering is much and I try to turn aside the most // I can so that no one realize. Your love, my Good, is greater than all things and it is the support, the relief and the security of the Work. It is also the anchor that sails from the bottom of the troubled sea of our tribulations. Most loving God, when in the midst of so many afflictions, you leave us anchored to your love, we can say to our troubles: how sweet and delightful you are! And the fear of having displeased you is followed by faith in your forgiveness, the certainty that there will soon be clarity in the rest of our actions and finally the blessing of a perfect union with you which through love // that is experienced, is more or less intimate. Alas! Another very cruel torment is the torture I feel when, you my Good, run away leaving me in the pit where I fell down without being able to attach myself to climb up. Moreover, this is the maximum suffering. You do not listen to me anymore and though I struggle much searching for you I never find you.

Only my infamies are before me and they form a wall that seems to have made a division between me and my God. I am not allowed to see you anymore. The height that I see // is insurmountable; my ideas are drowsy. They do not provide the means to come out of such a state. Creation is a pain; looking back it seems that the objects and other things are of no use except to add reproach to reproach. Finally, the infernal drags me to realize that there is no other way but despair and in thousand manners suggests me to throw myself down. The worry of being deprived of the only goal for which one lives and wants to die grows. // With subtle astuteness it tries to convince me that the only relief is despair.
