MS 4.3 – pp. 1- 81

MS 4.4 – pp. 1-14

With the month of January 1875 Mother Rosa started a new notebook. But on page six, experiences lived in the months of October and May are inserted without the indication of the year, and again she returned back to the month of February 1875. Probably they are news regarding the past year.

In fact, we know that in the journeys, not having with her the notebook, provisionally she wrote her notes on loose papers which she inserted afterwards, copying them in the other notebooks. In that case the long gap of 1874 would be partially filled, with these texts inserted in the Memorie of 1875.

From February to June she wrote with certain regularity. She narrates how she had to suffer while she was in Tericciola on 28 and 29; it is not known which months. Then there is a long interruption, for which she tells the reason: “For more than two good months I did not find time to write.” In spite of this, she felt that God urged her to write.

This was the booklet where we find the most moving descriptions of those temptations or apprehensions which seem to reach the border of paranoia: the fear of becoming mad and the fixation of throwing herself out the window. Mother Rosa attributed it to the suggestions of the evil one. The need she felt to write every detail, in addition to situating the sufferings on the line of interior purification, without doubt has also the therapeutic effect of an autoconscience which can master the struggle.

MS 4. 3 – pp. 1-18

“My God, what a day of love!”

11 January 1875. My God, what a day of union! In the midst of much toil, my spirit stayed with its Good. What I felt, I cannot say; the distractions of the affairs did not distract me. I was feeling such an interior cheerfulness that I did not know what I would do. Nothing could bore me, only my Love governed me. Oh, sweetness without equal!

I felt a grace I expected approaching. I was fainting out of joy. My Good showed me certain sufferings which I went through and he said what I got from them.

“You suffered much and there are no sorrows worse than these. You are dear to me and after these you are dearest to me.” What sweet word my Good, Being of my life! //

When I woke up I found myself with him, and the union that I felt was such that I had to complain: I am dying!

He showed me what one person dear to me suffered and I was consoled very much because I desired to know about this. He assured me on various doubts I had; I was calm and I had not the least thought in my mind.

Five sweet days favored by the Eternal Father

Alas, for two days things have been very different, since interiorly I heard a voice which said to me things which will happen to me by one of the religious who would give me grave affliction. I felt a terrible // sorrow caused by the anxiety or rather by the thought that she was a creature that I esteemed.

My weakness is extreme, but when on 9 January 1875, a sister spoke to me and after a quarter of an hour of telling me what she did according to the orders I gave her, in the midst of her forehead I saw a small star which stayed for various minutes and before it left it gave a very small spark. I asked my Good and it seemed to me what he showed me is so that I may understand that she is the right person for what I was thinking; that is to appoint her a superior. The spark signified the good spirit she would // communicate to her religious. In this way on the same day, Friday, I had a great deal of news regarding the Work.

On 12, twice I heard a loud voice that assured me that the Church authorities had granted what I wanted. Finally I passed five sweet days, always favored by my Eternal Father, having my Beloved very close to me. On 13 I had him close for the whole day.

Very early in the morning when I woke up, I felt something extraordinary: I started the meditation and I was taken to ecstasy, holding tight my Good. A Host appeared to me in the midst of a great light. I looked with my eyes but I was not able to say anything // because I was absorbed in my Good and it was not given to me to say a word. It stayed before me five or six minutes; this I say by approximation when I recovered, but I cannot know the precise time because someone who is in that state has no knowledge of time or nothing of the earth.

For two days, yesterday and today, I have an unrest that makes me suffer much because it gives me immense pain not understanding what the notice could be. With my thought I go now on one side and then on the other, but in all that I think I find nothing // of what will happen to me.

Interior restlessness. Again the “sight” of the beast

The night of 14 October was sorrowful for me because I was disturbed by something that brought me restlessness and I did not know what it signified. I had consolations but then I had again the ugly sight of the beast, very black. It scrambled on the wall very quickly with such long clutches that it impressed me much since I had not seen it for a long time. What horror I felt! Moreover it was scrambling on the wall where the bed was leaning; it was so quick in scrambling that I did not have enough time to ask who it was. One must see, to be able to say // how it moves. I really saw that it was an evil spirit because many times I experienced the evil that it brings; that is, evil things take place; even the people who are affectionate to me are disturbed and with thousands of troubles they are vexed. It vexes everything.

Today 15 (…) God knows how much I suffered and this evening I had to try to turn away because the anxiety was such that I was not able to bear it and I fainted. I do not speak of my head because I cannot describe it.

A dream about the future expansion of the Institute

Night of 16 (…) after a terrible day the night was sorrowful: pains of all kinds; a slow anguish very painful that it upset my head.

Finally in the morning I had a sweet sleep or rather a weariness // of strength. I drowsed and I had a dream where a religious started telling me various prophesies which Father

Bernardo had made regarding the Work of St. Anne. At first he spoke of a superior saying that she would do her work well and would edify the sisters. Through her example she would do much good, but only for six years. She would then betray the Institute. I remember having answered:

  • I will not be alive anymore.

He answered nothing, but when I said this within me I had such a conviction as if it was to happen like that, but he did not listen to me and continued his conversation saying:

  • Father Bernardo told me to tell you that // this Work will spread throughout the whole world as far as America;

you will have great consolation.

Arid, tempted, oppressed from all sides without relief

As soon as I woke up from this dream I was again in cruel tortures; I was tormented for the whole day. Now it seems to me to be a disgraceful monster and my conviction is such that all those who come close to me should see who I am. It seems to me impossible that good creatures would like to see me and listen to me. I cannot pray, my head cannot make a thought. My intellect is empty, it seems to me to be without vocal and mental energies. Only an abyss of infamy // I seem to have.

In a moment of calm I started to recite the rosary but what happened? I seemed to be again with my Good, when suddenly the darkest temptations molested me telling me that what I was feeling was all false and diabolic action, effect of my human sensitivity; what horror! I was overcome by this atrocious thought and a strong melancholy overcame me from which I am suffering till now. I feel my breast breaking from anguish. What pains are these? It is only you my God who sees my suffering. Have pity on me!

Oh, what a night! I thought it was not yet // midnight and I had much pain without being able to pray. I cannot express what I felt. I suffered much: a painful agony that the soul seemed to be separating from the body at every moment.

I spent a painful day. In the midst of many affairs I was oppressed from all sides that I did not know where to turn to find a moment of relief. But in certain affairs of importance my Good instructed me and allowed me to see things I had to negotiate, write or speak with people. He favored me but not with his sweet presence or with his lovely words. He enlightened me on what I should do // curtly. What did I do? When I think that I am nothing else but… and I am reduced to this bad state because of my sins, certainly I am worthy of thousands of hells. I see myself much deformed! Horror!

The wounded heart, the small scar…

Longing for penances

The pains which I feel on the left side are those which give me comfort; I feel a fire devouring me inside the swelling. Oh, when I think that it is what comforts me, the pain and the suffering sustain me. I say that the stronger the pain the greater is the sweetness.

There are moments in which where the small scar is – not of my Crucifix but the other one – I feel struck as if a knife were inserted and I cannot // avoid moving, so much is the intensity of the pain. I feel pain on all sides starting from the small to the big scar; they pain and they always give me graceful company.

To see myself without strength yet to be able to do my penances at least the big ones, make me feel a strong spur to throw myself into them and then die. Oh, unknown thirst!

This language is not understood! I would say that in this moment nothing consoles me but suffering, that on the left side as well as the one which I feel from the scars and that of the two chains which I carry: one on the belt and the other on the arm. I see this to be dear // to my Good and I have never been able to understand the reason. Many times I asked him but I was not given any answer. When it is embodied I always realize that it pleases him. Oh, mystery! A skeleton as I am and yet in some moments I feel like destroying myself; if obedience would not keep me who knows what I could do!

In these moments nothing helps me except one thing: to destroy myself. And if I do not turn it aside as a temptation it is violent. Many times the pain is such that I feel restless. Oh, suffering, how sweet you are! You are very precious for human beings to // know you!

A voice: “Live in God alone, search for nothing else”

My soul, remember 17 (…) evening 1875. “Live in God alone, search for nothing else; speak to him and look for no other relief but him.”

Anguish assailed me. In that moment I started to pray to my Good and a voice said to me as it is written above; yes, my Good, in you alone.

He kept me with him and comforted me. I asked him what happened to a certain person and immediately he revealed to me everything. She knew from (…) that a religious confessed of having listened to a confession and she told it to another priest in confession. At the end in my Good I found true consolation and peace. He assured me on many doubts I had and I was calmed in conscience, I enjoyed a heavenly peace and // I still continue to.

I spent the night embracing my Good. Oh, I rejoiced! I was dying, for the love I felt was so great; not a single instant was I away from him. My eternal All, who can describe what you do and communicate to the soul and what it experiences in you? Today I live in you and you in me; I feel that I have no other life but yours. Calm, an inner peace that I cannot describe! I speak or I feel, or rather my spirit feels that there is something felt not seen with the eyes of the body but that the intellect sees completely and understands. Oh, how many promises I made to him! I asked him for indifference in feeling especially with things that come from // people who are close to me with whom I have to deal; that the cruel pangs might not disturb me. I was granted this only partially as I felt it interiorly: “I will allow you to feel that which would not disturb the peace of the soul but you will have to feel the physical pain.”

In this way today for the mercy of the Being of my life I underwent many disturbances because in certain reports I received there were biting words. If he would not have supplied me with his grace today, I could have suffered pains of hell. Oh, my Beloved, how many graces you give to this wretched // filthy creature that I am! Oh, when I think of my nothingness the annihilation is such that I cannot describe it.

“General emptying of everything of which is of creature’s”

Yesterday, 18 May, I spent a day of union; in my prayers I found comfort and I was given a certain mental illustration which comforted me much. Only you, my Beloved, you do not want me to have the least relief from the earth. For me the creatures, little by little, had become subjects to be helped and loved. Now I do not feel a sensible compassion for their evils as I felt in the past. I do not even feel obliged to love them perfectly, // to get that pleasure which charity brings.

Now I find nothing; only my Good. Not even the least of the created things I am able to consider simply, if I do not turn to him first, as I receive the news.1

In this way I have a general emptying of everything that belongs to creature; only one thing remains. In this I have the strength, and in the same strength something sweet that makes sweet the action. Certainly if my Good would have not communicated to me the grace, the suffering could have been horrendous and I would do like the other creatures.

Alas! I do not describe this because many things are coming // to my mind. I tremble for being in an intense suffering of such a cruel wound received from someone whom I never thought would do such a thing. I well know how much the soul could be perturbed, teased, at the thought of what our ugly pig does to human feeling. Yes, I believe it is our main enemy because it is always ready to receive what the diabolic spirit suggests. It takes advantage of the moments of pain, as this one which is mortal. But my Good with his many lessons communicated to me certain hidden things which absorbed me fully in him. Oh, I found everything! //

Horrible suggestions of becoming mad

Night of 4 February 1875. Before I started a bit of spiritual reading I felt something unexpectedly, a strong temptation that seemed to have dulled my mind. It is something ridiculous, and yet it became so strong that at the moment of the reading prevented me from continuing and I felt faint. I recommended myself to God and I tried to turn it away, but interiorly I was feeling that it was increasing more and more. At the end I went to the church with the others to recite the rosary. The temptation was so strong that it seemed to me there could not be a remedy and that I could become mad.

I turned and strongly recommended myself to God; // not at all! I was feeling that it was a real temptation because my mind was all right. I added: but how can it be? I am in full knowledge and my mind is very clear, nothing upsets me. No, no, it was growing stronger. It grew so much that it took away my strength and I was feeling sick. I fainted and when I recovered under a strong convulsion, I tried all I could so that they might not realize what happened. Since I was feeling very sick I took advantage of a pain I had from neck to head saying that the air // affected me badly and it was so. The air I got in coming out from a house caused me that pain; the Lord wanted that, patience! But the fright I felt left me throbbing throughout the night and a trembling which I still feel.

I seem to have come out of a bad illness; I am so exhausted that I am able to stand on my feet only with much effort. They believed it was caused by the air; I said nothing but it was something else rather than air I’ve had. My God! A thousand other temptations but this one affects so much almost kills me. // Oh, I desired death rather than to become mad! It seems to me that this is the only one which can bring an end to this unbearable torment.

Only to write briefly what I went through, I feel the convulsion increasing in me for fear it might return. Oh, what a temptation! I cannot express what it does, how it shatters everything. There are moments in which I seem to be transported to another place and the nature and everything is upset. Finally something happens in my body in such a way that I do not feel to be in control of myself and cannot resist. As someone // who is over a precipice falling down because of being unable herself to keep up and sees that if she fell she would die but if she could overcome by resisting she could become mad. What horror!

I had never felt nor experienced such a temptation.

There is no relief. I well said it is a temptation. Go, Satan, away from me! My custodian angels, Michael, Raphael archangels, chase it away and finally be moved with pity!

My Eternal Father, order that it may go, somewhere else to throw itself!

I prayed and only in prayer I found a bit // of relief. I put before me the temptations I overcame in the past and also the one of this kind which I suffered one night but was very different; the assaults were different. This one came with much violence and I had no strength to combat it. I finish because remembering much makes me feel bad. How much I suffered and I still suffer my God! For pity’s sake that it may happen no more. In a word it seemed to me to be changing nature and going mad. Alas, I do not say it, for I feel horror.2

My Love, for two days I have been in paradise! // How many beautiful lessons he gave me! There was a moment in which I was so tightly united with my Good that I do not know if I lived or if I was already in the other life.

The usual beast. A new Apprehension

The day rather the night of 23 February, I saw again the usual beast which appeared to me at the top of the wall where I was turned and to which my bed was quite near. It had exactly the shape of a big spider that is why at first sight I woke up to kill it, but I stopped because I realized it was the usual beast. As soon as I conceived this thought it disappeared; it had so much fear of being asked who it is. After I decided to do so, while I was still distant and had the desire, // it faded away and disappeared.

For various days I have been feeling a certain new apprehension. One moment I am with my God embracing him. Suddenly I am in ecstasy. Then I feel a spasm and I almost faint and remain completely without life.

When I had to speak of certain small things, it seems to me they come easily to my mind; other serious things of the Work are so clear in my mind as if I must take them out ready. Oh, when I think, I had the least thought in this Work; and I had only the material commitment to put in order what my Good // went on teaching me! Assisted by St. Michael in thanksgiving after Communion

What I felt on 21 February 1875! In the midst of suffering and joy the pain I went through was horrible. At night it was worse. One day in the month of March 1875, I felt very sick and I went to receive Communion. It seemed to me that I did not prepare myself well because I was not well. I could say very little to my Good; I only offered him my pain, but I doubted that I might be able to do the thanksgiving well. In fact, I was rather upset, but as soon as I received, I saw at my side the angel Michael giving thanks with me with his hands joined. I felt such a thrill of happiness at the sight as I embraced my Good. He stayed for quite some time; but when he disappeared after I finished my thanksgiving I began // to ponder. Alas, what unrest could have assailed me if I had not received the strength I was feeling but I did not understand where it came from. It kept me calm. Although the enemy wanted to upset me, nothing disturbed the interior peace that the sight of my angel left with me.

Hours of mortal agony under a tightening of her head

In this month the ugly beast came to my room twice:

once it was small and another time big. That is why I had a grave affliction and only with the strength of my Good was I able to resist. The pains that I suffer are terrible; I would need much time simply to mention // them. They are of all types, together with the suffering, that makes me feel faint.

What anguish, what a continuous agony!

On the night of the eve of St. Joseph, I do not start to describe the pains I suffered because I am not able. I only say that I had two hours of agony in which I thought I was dying.

I struggled to pray and make spiritual communions. I clasped my Crucifix’s side but I did not get help. After these two hours I heard a thousand sounds in the room, and then I realized it was a diabolic trick. I even made an act of contrition. For a moment I thought I was breathing my last;

after sometime I recovered and heard the noise. Then I said:

  • Certainly it is a diabolic trick.

I came down and ran to the water of Our Lady of Lourdes. As soon as I bathed my front head // the sweat left me. I kept my head and my body in water. I recommended myself to Mary that she order that ugly monster to go away from me and leave me to take a bit of rest. Worn out, I abandoned myself, but the noise did not end; to the contrary it grew stronger. As soon as I drowsed, a strong tightening of diabolic action shook me. It wanted to upset me but failed to do so. I enjoyed perfect calm accompanied with a clear reasoning that nothing could disturb me, though the ghost was horrible.

This morning again I felt horrible shakings; some moments it seemed as if everything would come to an end, that for me there was no remedy. It showed me very horrible pictures; it frightened me tightening my head as if // it wanted to take it away.

The evening of Good Friday, I believed I would succumb to such agony. At every interval a tightening that could not be explained together with diabolic suggestion that tortured me was added. I seemed to lose my mind. Immediately a total change took place in me and it was more painful than agony. I suffered, I was dying, that is I was feeling as though I was dying but nothing upset me. However, under this violent sensation, there was nothing I could hold and my mind was unable to catch anything. My God, what a torture is this cruel temptation, worse than death! What is this for me who desire nothing other than // soon to embrace my Good! The only thing which makes me desire to remain is that of suffering. Yes, suffering for you, my Good!

On Thursday at first I had a day of union with my God who delighted me. Oh, how much I received! From this day on, the suffering, tortures and pains I experienced were worse. “My Beloved, are you pleased with the pains that tie me?”

Today April 17: a terrible agony oppresses me; I do not hear anything other than an interior lament as if it were saying to me: “Prepare yourself for a new tribulation.”

Alas, it is true that this has arrived! My God, what anxiety! I do not say what happens to me because yesterday while I was alone in the church something took me which I am unable to describe; however, interiorly it seemed to me in that moment // I had something that pleased my Good: my Beloved, are you pleased with the pains that tie me?

I felt nothing which could persuade me that they were the ones. I only felt much pain caused by the chain I had on my arm, which was embodied and gave me spasms; that pain, however, was sweet since I did not think of any other but my Good in whom I was enraptured, as if that suffering united me tightly with him even more.

That was it, because as I said, while I searched for what pleased him in that moment, I felt the union with him growing always more until… He made me realize that it was the pain I had in my arm which pleased him much. With sweet words he gave me much comfort that every pain // was very sweet for me.

The devil: “It is time to stop it!”

The night of April 20, as soon as I lay down, I felt there was something all around the room, as if there were a wind that blew and brought gloomy noise. I tried to sleep while praying as usual; but soon a strong shaking, as someone trying to open the door shook me and I had to remain awake praying. Finally I resolutely said:

  • Do what you want, I will not move.

That was what I did, but my resolutions were not of help, because the monster came close to my bed and it did make like a brooding hen calling for its chicks.

I stopped and laughed // but I did not want to turn. I kept my eyes tightly closed and laughed but when it came close to my ears, with its voice, I could not bear it; I turned and loudly I said:

  • It is time to stop it!

It was furious for I did something it did not like. It was not me who was doing it but another person acted for me, so that I may discover certain… of some one not good…

When I see that the infamous wants to crush me, then the strength and the contempt grow stronger in me as if it were nothing.

I cannot describe the repulsion I feel towards myself in these days; it is something that torments me. Oh, as for me I merit nothing; // I have nothing good, whatever I do is soon covered by an abyss of disgracefulness. What a dread

I am! Oh, yes, everything that belongs to me is a true torment for me.

The crown of martyrdom on her head

Last evening while I was lying with my eyes open I prayed; two angels appeared to me who had a big crown in their hands. They kept it in two because it was big and very beautiful. It was interwoven with roses and other flowers that formed a big circle. The crown was very beautiful as if it were fresh. Whose will it be? I did not have the time to ask because they soon disappeared // and I was lost in looking at it. In this way prostrated at the feet of my Eternal Father, I mean before his image, I bowed my head and with fervour I asked for a grace: here is your slave who under the torture of pain …

I stood up and saw a crown, as a golden circle, they were placing it on my head but I was unable to distinguish who they were because they were as in a cloud. I stopped and said:

  • What does this crown mean?

A voice said to me:

  • It is the crown of martyrdom.

I saw another one, but it was for suffering, being of thousands of flowers and leaves, roses and many others; this they placed on my head. I only saw it….

She discloses the intention of a superior to kill her Today 22 April 1875. I do not know how my Good suggested to me everything that a superior intended to do. She planned in advance // to kill me, with poison or with a knife on my throat. She thought:

  • If I could kill her, I could remain with the Father alone and do what I want.

When she saw me returning, she was upset. Already when I was out, many times I felt horrid stuff within myself because of this poison. A voice said to me:

  • She is disgraceful, feigned and still worse, she is sacrilegious. At the end I discovered everything, and having called her, I said:

  • You keep in heart… - as I wrote above –

My Good showed me, what she kept in heart: that she never confessed well neither when she was a lay person nor when she became a religious. // I told her the reason for when she was a lay person, because my Good opened for me the book of her heart. I say as a book because I read clearly.

In the same way all the confessions she did while a religious, especially the last one. I told her that they were meaningless including the Communion she received.

Oh, how much it surprised me when while I spoke the spirit that had invaded her roared, because if it was allowed to tear me to pieces she would have done it; as for myself I delighted in sweetness. I was feeling such courage, nothing dismayed me for being alone, though I saw how fierce the evil spirit was in that moment. I do not say more of what I discovered. I only say that to see her // so fierce towards me daunted me greatly.

Last night when I woke a face in the midst of a bright fire, like the sun at its setting, appeared to me; that little face in its midst had open eyes which gazed at me and I said to myself:

  • It does not resemble my Vincenza at all. Who could it be?

But I did not think about asking. It stayed for quite some time. Then it rose towards the ceiling and disappeared. I slept serenely and until after the thanksgiving I stayed in peace. At the end of this a certain fear regarding the person who wanted // to kill me, caught me.

This miserable pig started to tremble; it lost courage and a moral depression came upon me. Nonetheless, my spirit ready for martyrdom overcame it. I called that person and alone I met her and I said:

  • You see that I do not fear staying alone with you; I am afraid of nothing. The demon which had possessed you I keep under my heel; for the mercy of God, you are allowed to do nothing to me. You would like but you cannot.

My Good assured me that she could do nothing to me. I therefore went ahead, and ran through her whole life again from when she was a child until that moment. Certain things she denied. // It was the devil who spoke through her. Seeing this I asked her not to heed the enemy who suggested to her to answer to those words, to refuse where she placed certain…

  • Well – I said – I will tell you, if not now, I will know it soon.

Already as I spoke with her, I had certain persuasion but the infamous, seeing I had no certainty, because my Good had not yet manifested to me, roared and with new shrewdness excused itself. But it was useless. Finally I said other things about which I was sure and the deceitful could not deny.

  • You wanted to kill me with that pointed knife // which is found in the guest-rooms; you wanted to strike me in the throat; in the same way you wanted to put poison in my drink, but you never succeeded because you were held back. You loved such a person, for a reason and that is why you wanted to kill me. After having committed such and such sins you never confessed. All these were committed while a lay lady, when you were grown up and also when you were a religious.

Disgraced in this abyss of filthiness, all the other sins were nothing; the sacrileges were repeated time after she confessed. Finally, whatever the evil spirit realized I knew made her answer yes, but when I was doubting it took courage and taught her a great deal of // astuteness.

As soon as I realized this, I said to her:

  • You listen to the evil spirit who in this moment suggests you to answer these words. Oh, finish once and for all; it is time to stop it!

How much it taught her, it cannot be said; it was a dread. The fighting lasted two hours. Poor and ugly humanity suffered much, the weariness and the unrest was such that my Good allowed me to be reduced to this state, not to have strength to bring to an end this terrible affair, though I did what he wanted me to do. For what remained he wanted that // I submit myself. Oh, yes, I do it willingly!3

When I realized it was God’s will, soon I called… How happy I am my Good when I understand you! Yes, it does not cost me because I delight much. There is no repulsion which stops me because even under repugnance at the thought of giving pleasure to the Being of my life I feel sweetness. Oh, Love! If I could make known to people the pleasure of this sweet scent, all would come after me and would love you! What pain I suffer now! I had confusion in my body, which trembles, is spasmodic and faints.

My God, you gave me much strength in the battle and now do you reduce me to this state? //

Night suggestion in relation to the previous narration

Sunday, April 25. While I was thinking what I should do in this affair a big medal appeared to me, (to tell me how it was made). Now it was on one side and then on the other side. I felt fear because I did not know who it was. It seems to me, at that moment this thought was taken away from me completely.

At night there were horrible noises that did not allow me to sleep as well as the shaking which upset me much.

Yesterday during the day it was worse, such that at half past nine in the evening when I went to bed, I was full of pains.

I forced myself // to pray in order to have some relief. But

I had everything by the furry of the battle (against the pain).

After a bit of time I felt drowsy and I slept. As soon as I fell asleep I felt something oppressing me. I woke up and I saw one of the usual beasts, black, with a little body, many clutches, and a sharp point which was straight on its little back. This sharp point was turned towards me as if to kill me. It was less than a span from my face. Immediately as I woke, I looked at it dismayed but slowly it went away from me. That point, however, was always turned towards me.

When it reached close to the wall as if // it were to climb on it, it went to the top and then it disappeared. I was never able to ask its identity. As I said in that moment this thought was taken away from me; but that thorn gave me much pain, it resembled a dagger. Alas, my Good in these days the tribulations flood me!4

In heaven she saw Sister Anne Vincenza with Sister Anne Serafina. Vision of another heart

I would not want to do anything other than stay at the feet of my Good to give vent. Instead I am always oppressed by work which does not give me peace. How much I suffered this day! What a dagger my breast received for certain news or rather for a word I was told; my sweetest Jesus wants it, let it be! //

I saw my dear Sister Vincenza near the other daughter of mine Sister Serafina. Both of them came to comfort me.5 This morning, at daybreak, while I meditated, a heart appeared to me: My Good, do you give me another heart? Alas, yours, the one I keep is enough, you make me die! In fact I was feeling the ribs rising. Alas, I am dying! Today the swelling was such that I cannot bend. Always holding him tight, united with him I stayed all the time of my meditation. Today I had other words from my Good regarding the affliction I had.

“I do not feel to live anymore, because I live in you my Good!”

For a long time I asked him for a grace; at last, just now

I received what I wanted or rather he said to me:

  • I will not grant you // because, you will certainly have it if you act in this manner.

  • Oh, my Good, I promise to be always the same and to commit myself more, knowing it is your will; furthermore, I will always be clinging to what you want. It is true that my character is such that it is inclined to be bent as you say, receiving what I asked for, but now that I make a promise,

I will not certainly be like that.

I then started to feel the effects of the grace I asked for.

In this way I hope to receive it fully.

Thinking in this way, in sweet union with him the whole day, I dealt with the affairs of the Work in peace and with strength; I do not feel living anymore // because I live in you, my Good!

The usual beast; other big and small beasts

This night, 28 April, I have also been very upset: I started to sleep but then I felt shaken and immediately, I saw on the wall towards which I was turned the usual beast: small, of faded black colour. I looked at it and it started running up on the wall; as soon as I thought of asking what it signified and who it was, it disappeared. However, I remained upset and I was unable to say a prayer. Oh, I suffered, because my poor head could not keep a thought. The anguishes that I felt for certain things of mine, which I saw gave me much pain, because it seemed they are caused by people who // …

Enough! I fear saying too much. When certain people come before me with much deceit, what a pain! My breast tightens so much that I almost lose my breath.

On the evening of 30 April, so many big and small beasts!

First came one which disappeared right away. Another one came together with some small ones and they did a mess…

My God, how many tribulations they announced to me!

How much aridity I felt in these sorrowful days! For two days now the ugly beasts tormented me! Now they are not as big as those which appeared to me // in the past. In fact, they are much smaller. One of these was leaving behind many circular black signs. It disappeared, but the signs remained. They were signs of an epidemic. As soon as I slept I was continually awakened, almost the whole night. Even last evening they stayed until two. Then they stopped.

I was comforted by a sweet word from my Child Jesus.

“Fierce temptation: could I be mad?”

Today date (…) // May. My God, I found myself in the midst of much suffering. Until an hour ago I was plunged into the cruelest despair. Horrible suffering! To have lost God, to see oneself despair, to feel only aridity and trouble in the head accompanied by a fierce temptation! Could I be mad? Alas, I was almost fainting from so much anxiety.

When it was too much even my nerves twisted. There was a moment of calm: my Good came close to me and made me die for love. Love, what I felt!

But I see clearly approaching new and cruel apprehensions. My Being, strengthen me to be able to bear them! I suffer horrid tribulations in the Work, but I delight. My God sustains me with one word of his. A caress of his makes me forget everything. For me in these moments I could say that the world and the creatures are all secondary, as if divided, I only have to gather from them the fruits to be offered // to my Good Love!

“My greatest torment: to resist being absorbed”

From 14 May, the union with God that I feel is such that my breast seems to be opening at every moment so much is the violence I must make. I do not have the fear I had in the past; in these days I received many instructions from my Good who supplied me with extraordinary lights. In certain moments he allowed me to see well the interior of the creatures that I read everything as in an open book. Oh, how much subtle malice has the creature. It frightens me and with fear of something I could be attached to, I take care. My

God, for pity’s sake, do not allow that ugly monster come to infect me. I hold tight myself to his heart and it seems that he assures me I will be exempted from this monster. //

The eve of the Holy Trinity, my God, what a night!

Unfortunately I was on a journey passing through Rome in a room together with other sisters. What a tribulation! My

Good enraptured me so tightly to him that for the fear that they might realize I had to turn aside. But it was not helpful;

there were moments that I could not bear it and I was suffocating in that union which was a relief in those moments.

At last, day came and I was very depressed because I seemed to be under pressure. I do not say what I felt during the day, because I was always embracing my Good. Oh, if in these days I could // hide myself in a cave, and enjoy my Being alone! It would certainly be of less torment since to continue to force myself not to be absorbed in him is my greatest torment.

In the evening I was caught with fever. I thought it was the result of the violence that I made. In the morning, in my Communion I was consoled by my Good. Oh, there was not time: he did not come to sooth my sufferings!

Last night, 23 (…), I was molested by the sight of an ugly beast: a big one running on the curtain which divided my bed from that of a sister. What I suffered in these days for having it in the room… I also see // that my Good has compassion on me, because when I say:

  • My Good, what a cross! – He comforts me.

Oh, have a pity on me; do not allow anything extraordinary to happen to me, that I might not have to be tortured by suffering.

Oh, yes, my God has promised me! With these reflections I felt calm; a certainty invaded me.

“I seemed to be changing my nature and becoming mad”

While I was in Terricciola, the night of 28 (…) 1875, I suffered much. There was something which made me suffer and I had no peace; as soon as I went to bed, I tried to sleep but I was upset. Finally a fatigue took me, and I did not understand what it was. I felt shaking; // there was a beast without legs, but only the black body, the same as the others. However, it had fire all around it. What does this mean? I asked, but as usual it disappeared. I could say that the whole night continued in the same way. The beasts always appeared to me in fire without my being able to see the legs. In the morning they left me in confusion in my poor room. I had horrible fears and a thousand ghosts passed before me. Enough! I thought I could rest since a bit of sleep was coming; not at all! In that half an hour I had such a diabolic dream that I woke in complete convulsion // and I did not know where to turn my mind.

I began to pray because until that moment I was not able to do it in the presence of God and I felt so ashamed and I trembled as a guilty, a condemned person. But in a flash I was absorbed in my Being; he explained to me certain things which disturbed me. When I went to the church I had a strong feeling of fear at not being able to receive Holy Communion because I had a thousand fears. But even here my Good calmed me giving me peace and union which kept me grasping to my Good.

Another night when I was in Terricciola, the second night, // the usual beast appeared to me. As usual it disturbed me much; after it left me upset. I did not understand this until the next evening when I thought I was dying. An assault of a strong unrest overtook me; I seemed to be changing my nature and going mad by the moment. What I felt in that abyss of anguish could not be described. A cold sweat and then a strong trembling that flapped me on to the bed. I saw that a terrible change was taking place in me. What I heard being suggested to me was horrible, as if I was already mad.

  • Now you will do this, now you will do that; you see, you are not even in your right mind anymore, wouldn’t it be a good idea to throw yourself out the // window? Oh, you are resisting, but in a moment you will not be able to resist

anymore.

Finally, what I felt was such that I have no words to describe it. It suggested me the most astute insinuations that I could not bear it. The convulsion was so strong that it seemed that my bones were dislocating. Calling? What could I say? And then, I felt pity to wake up the sisters. I stayed like that until morning. The worst was that I had to travel. I received Holy Communion and I had to pull up all my strength to be able to stand.

What I suffered my God! As if this was not enough, it restarted again in the vapour. Oh, what a torture! I was lucky that it was not strong enough // to awake the convulsion but I sweated a great deal. Because of the effort I was making I had a horrible headache. I would have preferred a thousand other sufferings as long as that horrible state did not return to me. Today I had an assault but it was light. This morning

I also had a very sweet union with my Good. Oh, suffering, how sweet you are! But not the torture that I felt when astutely I was told I will become mad.

Oh, a thousand tortures, but not this my Good!

“In the midst of much pain I was united with my Good”

I do not know how to express, what my Good does in me at certain moments. He clearly // shows me this or that taking place in the Work; he assures me in my doubts. For some days I see a star, but it is small. My God, who will die?

It continues to stay before me now and then. Yesterday, I had a day of paradise. In the midst of much pain I was so united with my Good, that forgetting fully myself I was absorbed in him. In Communion I had something between my Good and this side which is always swollen.

Oh, it seemed to me that my ribs rose, my Good; the same was with my hands and feet, but most of all this side, especially at night when I start praying // and my Good comes closer, it is painful. Oh, my ribs!

This night I was taken by a certain feeling of drowsiness. It seemed as though I was being pressed down on the head; before that, I saw appearing certain black shades here and there. As this dozing was finished or diminished a pain occurred on one hand. It was not on the palm but on another position between two bones. The pain was such that I felt spasms; I was not able to move the hand because I felt an invisible power pressing me strongly. When God willed, it disappeared as a slight shaking. What an infernal dragon! How many things it does to me!

In the morning I felt weary // and unable to stand on my feet.

Today, Friday, though very busy, the union with my Good was such that it was painful for me not to be able to stay in a corner alone; instead I must conceal and try to make contrary feelings appear.

God is not pleased with the prayer in the church that takes away the time of service in the Work

Today I was assaulted – but mildly – by my temptation. I was always near God, my mind fixed on the tabernacle; and even when I spoke I always had a strong desire to adore my Good closed in the tabernacle. Every moment I was feeling a spur to run to the church but I feared that, if I could remain with my Good, he could reproach me and with this fear I refrained. I was sure // that leaving the dealing with the affairs of the Institute to stay at his feet physically could deprive me before all else of the union with him; and then instead of finding comfort I could have suffered, not being able to pray, as it usually happens when he does not want me to remain a longer time in the church. He takes away from me even the capacity of saying Hail Mary. Even when there was nothing urgent, I must go out of the church in order to see what could be there; I need to be there. In fact, I always found affairs of importance to be // carried on. Well, my dear Being – I say to him – do you send me away? Soon I go to serve you; here with you I was comforted, but I am ready to leave everything to serve. Yes, your slave will be always

holding you tightly.

Obsessive temptation to throw herself out the window

Yes, the most painful temptations torture me and what afflicts me most is when I feel the enemy tightens my mind and loudly says:

  • Now I throw you out the window.

When it finds me alone writing, especially when I am near the window, it says, and again with violence, that it will throw me out the window. There was a moment it made me // even sweat:

  • Yes, I throw you down!

Oh, I must fight strongly!

  • You are alone, I will throw you down!

I was feeling pushed by a force to take that act and I was violated, feeling lost and on the edge of being dragged out the window; I was not able to cry. I united my hands in an act of supplication and with all the strength I was able to gather, I said: my Eternal Father, save me, free me from this dragon of hell!

As soon as I said this, it ran away and I remained sweating profusely. What a struggle! This temptation stayed with me the whole day; now it is not like that because I // am accompanied and it cannot come to force me anymore.

However, it torments me enough saying:

  • Look, in the next room, there is an open window. If you pass there, you will certainly feel a strong impulse to throw yourself down.

It pushed me very much to think; I felt some strength that I did not understand from where it was coming and it invaded me fully. I was feeling as if I was in the act of throwing myself down. Oh, what a torment! There are no temptations that could be compared with this. I was sweating, and almost fainting out of fear and at the same time it seemed to me that all was lost, that there was no // escape for salvation.

I tried everything as if I already committed the act; moreover I was hearing repeatedly:

  • Yes, it will take place and you will not be able to escape such execution, because you will go.

Oh, my God, if I could express what I felt, it was horrible! Oh, cruel pains! Nothing could help to free me. With much violence I tightly held my Crucifix, and I suffered horrid agony. There were moments in which I seemed to breathe my last because of the struggle I had. I felt acute pains in my head that seemed to break. In the evening when everything is closed and I remain to write, or I go to bed or I pray, there is always this temptation which worries me; furthermore // it says:

  • When you go to bed you will open the window and you will not know what you will do; you will throw yourself, yes, yes!

With certain figures it gives me these suggestions and I cannot express the suffering, the torture that it gives me. Oh, when I am able to hold my Good tightly in my spirit, what strength I feel, what encouragement! But soon I fall again, because of the affairs and also because of a certain unexpected aridity; I remain drowsy, I do not see before me other than precipices, always produced by this horrible temptation. There is much pain and there are times that // I could remain crushed down. I do not know what I could compare this tribulation with. It is as a person attached to a roof having no support: she should fall; that is what happens to me. What a torture!

Again pushing me it added:

  • Try, you will not fall, for your God will keep you in the air.

  • Disgraceful dragon, what a liar you are!

“Today I enjoy a new life”

Enough! Today I was free. My Crucifix, which I kept holding tightly, freed me and I was calm. What horrible sufferings they are! No, no! There is no greater suffering than this; it is such // torture that there is no phrase to express it.

Today I enjoyed new life, as if I came out from death to life. In Holy Communion my Good comforted me. He instructed me in many things which disturbed me; he assured me that he would always be near me. The union continued for the whole day. Oh, suffering! Yes, today I made a good provision, but since I am so hungry for this I am never satisfied.

“I cannot find time to write”

For more than two months I have not had time to write.

I always say to my God: yes, I will write! But then how can

I? // A continuous crowd of occupations take my time. I hope that my God is not displeased, but I must say that I am continually urged to write and this gives me much fear.

This promising and never doing of mine often brings me anguish that I say: My God, if I can, I will do it; I will try to put down something of what I experienced in these days, because what happened to me in these two months could take a long time to describe. The sweetness I received from my Good is much but the sufferings, the temptations of that ugly type that made me mad, tortured me.

Again the nightmare of throwing herself out the window

The day before yesterday I was in the church and I had to run away because // the temptation was so strong that it was pushing me saying:

Throw yourself out the window, now I push you!

And what took place in me! It seemed as though there was a person who pushed me and dragged me to go and I was tightly holding my God. I would have liked to reason, but I was not able. In the battle I was going through, I was sweating because of the suffering; I saw myself at the edge of an abyss from which there was no escape. My God, remove from me this spirit which torments me so much!

I was able to say this with much effort and it // cost me much labour. Oh, when in a gloomy way I hear: - Throw yourself down! – And I feel dragged; and then it says: - You will not die; moreover you will perform a miracle.

What a pain!

  • Try, try!

Meanwhile it pushes me; oh, what is it?

  • Go! Go!

And many other things that would require much time to describe. At the end it leaves me suddenly saying:

  • I will throw you when you will be in places where you will not be able to run away.

What it brings to me cannot be described; it tortures, and it kills me. Even in the midst of great occupation it comes as a flash, it drags me, it depresses me because it becomes stronger that any other thing.

Oh, an indescribable // torment!

Rapture in the church after Communion

For some days, I had before me a small star and other moments a white globe appeared to me. It does not say anything interiorly, but it leaves me something of significance, as if it contained an object which will bring me an announcement. What will it ever be?

There were moments in which my union with God was so strong that I feared people might realize it.

One morning after Holy Communion, I felt snatched and as raised up from the earth; for an instant I still had knowledge. Alas, my God, your promise! // But I cannot say that I said exactly these words. I only felt that I remained firm in my place and absorbed in God…

MS 4.4 – pp.1-14

Tormented by night beasts

Month of December 1875. The beasts which torment me these days are numberless, of every kind and I cannot sleep. I do not keep quiet about the comfort my eternal

Good gave me; and in my pain I suffered for not being able to ask those infernal beasts what they meant. As I said several other times, I am not able to ask them the moment

I see them but as soon as they move I do ask with strength.

Immediately in a flash they disappear and they leave me so disturbed that unrest comes upon me and I suffer much.

However, my Good always comes to my help with his grace.

Oh, yes, my God, your loving caresses are very many!

Sufferings on her journey to Rome.

Protected by St. Michael

How much I suffered on my journey to Rome! I do not know how // to describe it; the anger of these spirits of hell was such that only my angel Michael could master them.

When we reached a certain place, what did they do? They fell down upon the vapour enraged: I saw them, I heard them unbridled, and they tried all they could to throw it down.

What I felt at that sight was horrible; a convulsion overcame me and a gripping in my breast. I saw myself crushed by that devastation which they wanted to bring. But I was trying to control myself, though such cries oppressed me and so did the sight of what the enraged dragons of hell were doing. When they were near the coach and on the wagon, // my angel Michael with his unsheathed sword drove them away. They fell down and I did not see or hear them anymore. My dear angel assured me that he would always escort me and I would arrive safely. Then all the fainting I had ceased; however, those who were with me thought I was affected by the journey, but it was something else.

They were not yet satisfied: again they came close to me and showed me what turmoil would take place. As for themselves they could have been transformed into certain brutal men and I would suffer horrible things…

At this sight, again I started to suffer and with ugly voices they were coming close. I watched with a thousand eyes // who entered our wagon; here, it stopped. Oh, my angel for pity’s sake, save me!

  • Some six furious youth came to the door. My angel said:

  • Run away! – As soon as three of them came in, I was already on my way out and I stumbled on the fourth that was on the stairs, and I ran out. My companion remained inside with the things, but soon she came out the door and down with me. What these enraged were saying were horrible things. I made up my mind to remain in that station rather than going where there were men.

Then they wanted to put us only with one man but my angel refused. Finally they put us with ladies // and even these complained though they were not Catholics.

At last I saw my angel Michael who in an act of peace comforted me and assured me that nothing more would happen. In this way I was calmed. Moreover the same dread… those screams…

My companion saw me so much upset when I said:

  • Alas, where are we? What is happening? She thought it was fear in general that made me pronounce such words or the fear of death. If she could have seen and heard what I saw and heard, she would certainly have done no less than what I did, since the uproar they made and still more the sight of their enragement and anger was horrible.

I confess this last time // was worse than the first, because it involved the fact that they were transformed into those ugly men; seeing them in that way, what it brought about in me, what I suffered!

As I arrived such a melancholy overcame me that I needed to use all my strength to resist it, so that those near me would not realize.6

The devil threatens to throw her out the window

After three days, in the morning something came to my ears, whispering that I was lost. This stayed for the whole day. In the evening the battle was so fierce that it provoked in me a fever. Those near me understood nothing and thought it was fatigue. But I knew that it was an interior affliction; only God could see my suffering and what I felt.

// I could say that it has not yet ceased; on the third day I was unable to stand on my feet. Here is a fierce storm of a dragon that went around me and threatened to throw me out the window, saying:

  • As soon as you are alone I will throw you.

When I remained alone for an instant, I had an inexpressible torment! Almost enraged, the infernal spirit came near me saying:

  • Now you are!

In the dark of the darkest night: All the doors are closed

There are no phrases which could express what this torment could be, to be deprived of help and almost at the edge of the precipice and without knowing how to escape. One cannot turn to God because nobody knows where he went, he is nowhere. Prayer would not help because I was arid and could feel nothing // because all around was darkness of the darkest night. That cruel torture comes when I think that God is not near and that an abyss of disgracefulness has made this dear Father to remove his grace. Moments of horrible despair appear and only naming them is a dread, because in certain battles with this ugly Satan, when all sides are closed, it is impossible to find refuge. Only the picture of the darkest actions come before me, and a word said in the past as a joke seems an enormous crime and is shown in the most // detestable aspect.

I could hear a sorrowful voice which said… it is that of despair. Oh, to be able to master myself, because having people around me who understand nothing I prefer dying in a short time, rather than that they realize my state.

Oh, in the whole of my life, my God took away from me people who studied a bit and to tell the truth, they had to struggle much to understand even the smallest things; but I must confess that they were a relief to me. However, I said many prayers and if I will reach // heaven my thankfulness will be great towards these people. I hope my God give them joy. I should also say that being still a novice in the matters of God, this is not enough. Sweet, suffering how much I love you!

A Christmas under the nightmare of diabolic threats

The eve of Christmas, how much I suffered! My God only you could say it! Satan, dragon of hell, assaulted me saying that he would throw me out the window. So much was the violence and what I had to sustain that no one may realize that my bones were breaking and I was feeling pain. That was not enough; they were all tricks. There were moments that I remained alone in the room and it was worse. It seemed to me that at all // moments I was already on the edge of the window and I felt sure of what would happen. Alas, what a dread!

Only God could express what sufferings these are. I write my best, but in truth I am unable to say the least of what I felt at that moment; and such fierce beasts made me suffer.

Oh, my refuge, Blessed Mary! Finally it took away my strength because the anxiety was continuous. There was nothing that could turn me away because the monster always suggested to me that the hour had come and he would have won because I was fainting.

The anguish was such that I cannot describe and I must say that // I was deprived of spiritual help.

In silence I bore everything, because that is what pleased my God. Enough! I will say later on how I yielded.

The eve of Christmas and also during the day, what I felt in my poor head, my Jesus saw it. Today I must say that my Jesus comforted me a bit with the fire of his love. He assured me that the dragon of hell would never do the slightest evil to me, but that everything was allowed by him. Alas, my Good, it will never do such a sad action to me!

My sufferings are horrible. If I could show externally what // I suffer interiorly, I believe I would move to pity the hardest hearts.

When night approaches, I can say my humanity twists at the thought that the infamous dragon with new astutes will bring me sorrowful pains. Now it wakes me with cries in the ear as if I were burned; another time it moves around the room making every kind of noise and what it produces in my head…

It is true that my Good never delays to come to console me. On the day of the Holy Innocents my side started swelling and for the whole night the union with my Good was such that I am not able to express what I felt. The following day was the same in that I had to struggle not to let people realize.

The swelling was enormous, the ribs seemed // to be breaking. It remained like that for the whole night.
