MS 4.4 – pp. 14-90

MS 4.4 – pp. 90-142

Having started a new notebook in December 1875, she continued in January 1, 1876. Some dates of the following months are indicated. But after the month of May there is an interruption motivated by lack of time. “It is now a month and half that I have not a minute to dedicate for writing; though I often hear reproaches. But what could I do? My head is so weak and full of varied of affairs that if I delay writing what I received from my God, I will not be able to describe what took place.”

Many pages follow without date. At the end of the notebook we find two pages added to the notes of 1877, in order not to forget the sufferings she had the night of September 6, 1876 (see the year 1877). The dating appears again in the month of October and the year closes with the feast of Christmas.

The moments of intense union with God and the piercing pains of purification continue to alternate. The torture of the ugly apparitions returned so also the nightmare of the fear of becoming mad, the threats of the enemy to throw her out the window from the height of the stairs… In the depth of her spirit, however, there is security and blessed calmness. She concluded the year with an intimate consolation experienced when the Eternal Father extended his right hand on her head, a biblical image for which she wrote: “Though I am in the midst of the abyss of suffering, something keeps me in an indescribable peace.”

The year 1876 was not only a year of strong purifying sufferings for Mother Rosa; she also had moments of great consolation. In the months of January and February she was in Rome busy for the approval of the text of the Constitutions written anew by Father Tornatore, this time successfully. In fact at last on 8 April, the decree of the approval of the Institute was signed. On 26 (or 24) of the same month, the matrimony of her daughter Carlotta with Gaspare Barbiellini was celebrated in Genoa. But about these events we do not find any mention in the notes.

Light on the delusions of some sisters on the way of perfection

On 1st January 1876, my Good gave me new graces giving me instructions on the way of perfection. Oh, how I saw myself annihilated and almost lost in my nothingness!

I desired to destroy myself, to be despised. He left me and I seemed hungry. The last of the sisters seemed to me much better than me; as usual I was much persuaded. My God! How much mercy for someone who is very unworthy? Love, you destroy me inside this heart of yours which is swollen to an extent that I can resist no more. My bones, my Good!

He also gave me knowledge about a certain person whom I must direct when the devil triumphs in her // because she is deluded. The evil spirit kept her bound to what was carnal with certain illustrations. How well he revealed to me the state of this creature, I cannot describe. Among the other things I remember these words:

  • Obedience - you will tell her – is written on the road to heaven; the person, who obeys will enter through it and without much struggle will reach the kingdom of heaven.

These souls who would like to perform miracles and have extraordinary graces with a filthy vase full of their own will, tremble at the sight of crosses and sufferings; and the humiliations? Alas!

The sense, the taste of delusions is their pleasure; woe betide if they are contradicted, they want and they go to directors for advice // and then they do what they think. To those who go to search for direction, I say it is not true. They go to tell all their day-dreaming and see if they will be believed. Woe betide, if they are contradicted; they insist till they are satisfied in everything that their own will desires. Oh, in these days, how widespread is this spirit which keeps many souls wrapped in error and falsely they go through a disastrous life.1

Jesus my Good, your suffering is too sweet for me! Oh, sweetest moment! While I write the union with him is such that I stop in order to stay with him.

“God left me in such desolation that I see nothing else but being damned”

Day (…). It is sweet to stay on the cross. // From yesterday until today how many sufferings, how many tribulations I had! It seemed Vesuvius in its strength, there was no side to turn the eyes to, where terrible anguishes could not be found, but to bear everything is sweet. I do not say of what kind the sufferings of the spirit were because I am unable to explain. I only say that for hours my Good left me in desolation such that I did not see anything else but being damned as in this moment while I write.

Oh, what suffering! I have lost my All because of my sins. It seemed that for me there was no more forgiveness and a horrible abyss fell upon me that my soul was drowning. // I did not find where and how to come out of the continuous worry. All the sins, yes, in these days they are all mine, what more will I have? Oh, mortal agony! I think and in my thought it is still worse because the anxiety grows. A gloomy voice said to me:

  • For you it is the end, you are damned!

All my actions seemed to be many accusations;

everything reproached me. Therefore, am I in an infernal abyss?

My God, where are you? Why did you leave me in such a terrible state? Oh, yes, it is very true that I do not merit to be forgiven! My iniquities are many. Oh, what I felt suggested was something dreadful!

I finish // in order to give vent to the anguish.

“I felt that the side where his Heart is was raised…”

Day 9 of the current month. In these days I had suffered much for the continued state in which I was sunk in the most horrid pains. Suddenly the Being of my life came close to me with his union and I felt the side where his heart is was raised so much that I was dying. I know there were moments in which I did not know whether I was alive, but I was absorbed in God especially on Fridays. In these I found strength, peace and relief in my immense pains. What I felt in suffering! The ribs were raised up; it was sweet and could not be expressed. Yes, the union that I felt on this side // was such that I could not describe it.

However, today was not like that; there were terrible moments this morning. In my thanksgiving what that ugly did! Its suggestions were horrible:

  • You are damned, you made a sacrilege – it always continued to say.

Comforted by the Virgin Mary with the Child

Last night oppressed by sickness and exceedingly weak, I went to bed and, taken over by fear, I felt something in my head that made me suffer much.

While I was like this and I lamented, I was absorbed for an instant. I saw the Blessed Virgin with the Child in her arms and she calmed me. I was calmed and all the pains disappeared as if a balm had come down upon me. Dearest Mary and // the Child were cheerful. I had a happy night and woke up without pains; I immediately started prayer making spiritual communions. Oh, dear Child!

Neither the Blessed Virgin nor the Child said anything, but they said much with their silence because they inebriated me. Oh, my most beloved Mary! The only sight of you brings much sweetness, peace, resignation and comfort in tribulations which God in his mercy provides always for me.

The stars, notice of the death of a Daughter of St. Anne

My God, again another star! It was not as big as that for the superiors, that is, like the ones of my three first daughters because I did not see a big one for all the superiors; this one was of middle size. The last I saw was small and then the sister died. My God, you always want to give me such a beautiful gift // of showing me the kind of star for every Daughter of St. Anne who dies!

Oh, those stars of my dear Sister Anne Vincenza and Sister Anne Francesca were beautiful! In the same way the one of Sister Anne Francesca was also beautiful! What about my Sister Anne Serafina? Oh, yes, I will not say the same, but almost.2 The others were more or less the same except the last which was very, very small. In fact, she was a sister who took the habit very recently, a novice.

The instructions that my God gave me regarding what I should do for charity were beautiful. His notices were so sweet that I do not know how to // express the soothing they brought me.

Yesterday, again there was a star, bigger than the last one. My God, do you want another Daughter of St. Anne in heaven? I cannot say anything; may your will be done.

“Embracing my Good, oh, what I felt!”

Since yesterday, 1st February 1876, I have had horrible pains of the spirit and in addition tribulation that God allows the others to cause…

Oh, what a torture is felt when from whom one expects a word of comfort receives nothing else but anguish and blows! My God! How bitter this drink that I must swallow I could say daily. Always new torments and I had only my Good to sustain me.

Today, 5 February 1876, my side was so swollen that the bones seemed to be breaking, so much was the rising. I felt fire which // made me faint.

The light of my Good was much, the lessons that I received very many and love consumed me. Oh, how painful for me to stay with human beings, but it is your will my God! I will remain and I will feign much, and be careful so that nobody will realize my state of union with you. Oh, Love, you consume me, but your promise is unchangeable. No one will realize and I will always keep deceiving the world. What sweetness when I am able to make others believe that I am not so good! Oh, it is for me a true joy, Jesus; what I feel is too much! //

Embracing my Good, what I felt! Every sweetness or rather all the sweetness the most delicious of this earth could not be compared to a beauty-spot of such delicious sweetness. Love! Love! Being of my life!

I spent the whole night in my cell; I lay very close to my Good being unable to stand on my feet but embracing my Good in such a way that I cannot describe. Always united, now I woke and there in an outburst of love, a thousand lovely words, praying in adoration and always making spiritual communions and meditating. At the end I spent the whole night in sweetness. Oh, paradise, seat of my life, Jesus, // Eternal Father! How happy I am that nobody realizes the immense graces you grant me, my Treasure! Today, my side where your heart is, my Good, is swollen so much that I do not know how to master its impulses. It would always stay near your dwelling in the church united with you in the sweet union.

Violence to turn away from Jesus in order to deal with the affairs of his Work

Oh, how painful to stay with human beings! If they could see my pains and how much sacrifice it costs me, certainly no one would distract me from my Jesus. Oh, Eternal Father, how much violence to turn away and deal with your affairs in your Work! However, this I do // very willingly because working in this house I actively serve you, but the conversations of the people… What should I do? Oh, sweet

Treasure, do I serve you even in these? Yes, because when I speak I am absorbed in you and my hands keep me united with your sufferings. They are very sweet sufferings which bring me much union; the same is with the feet and your side.

Another small star is moving around me; it is not very small. Blessed are you, sister for whom the Good Jesus has prepared a place in his kingdom and who will be counted in the crowd of the Daughters of St. Anne!

Though this sight announced the death of a sister yet it did not bring me sorrow, but only the pain that is felt // in the separation from a creature for that time in which one remains before going to meet her.

Oh, goodness of my God! You want me to write everything that you do in me; but how can I do so since it is an abyss of continuous graces that you pour into me a very mean creature!

I asked for providence, and what did my Good do? He put in my drawer the sum and even more of what I needed.

Oh, infinite goodness! Oh, Love, without compare! To find such amount of money, my Good, infinite omnipotence!

When your servant thinks of this, she is moved and annihilated seeing her nothingness. Oh, poor me, I am a monster of infamy! //

The action of an evil spirit in human beings

The night of 10 February 1876, I remained absorbed in

God and in the intervals in which I returned… what sweetness in prayer, what I felt!

I asked for his mercy for the sinners that they may be converted; that he may bind the evil spirit which I saw invading the minds and inducing them to suicide.

Oh, how my Good showed me the things! He even said:

  • Do you see that spirit which came to torment you many times and seduced you so that you could throw yourself out the window and many times it pushed you itself?

I was not able to understand the reason; for me there was nothing on earth which could resemble such suffering.

Everything was sweet and yet its action was so violent without reason that I remained tightly // holding my Crucifix crying: My Good, save me, come to my help! I could see what the evil spirit could have done. Since my Good gave me a supernatural light, I reproved it and I suffered much trouble that many times brought me to agony. As for those mean creatures who are deprived of his love and live in the darkness of sin and likewise other poor souls, cold in faith and in the holy religion, it overcomes them; that is why many terrible crimes are committed. Yes, as my Good said, such is this spirit and I experienced it well. //

If I should or rather if I could describe what it does in a subtle manner putting confusion in the head that only God’s grace can save.

“A stream from the Heart of Jesus poured into my mouth”

After all these lessons attached to many others and in the union with my God who kept me absorbed, in the morning towards five I felt worn out. My God, how can I stay on my feet to work without others being aware of my state?

There I was again absorbed in him and my Jesus brought out of his Heart a stream which poured into my mouth and nourished me. As I recovered from such a vision, I felt strong and robust, as the other days; I only kept in my mind the vision of that very white… //

Oh, sweetest Love, what can I do to love you and to make others love you? I will say soon, because too much…

An alarming anxiety at night

The following night was not like this! As soon as I went to bed, I was overcome with anxiety and unrest and I did not know how to bear it. I started to pray and I suffered because

I had to force myself. I drowsed and a shaking woke me up;

a big beast was up there close to the ceiling. At its back it had something dark-white; the rest was as black as charcoal and while I fixed it and wanted to ask who it was and what it wanted, it disappeared on the wall as usual. //

I did not see any for a long time, and I was able to take the little rest much better. What a night I spent! After the disappearance of the beast, there was continuous confusion in my head and I felt worry such that I was unable either to pray or to take rest.

My mind was always waiting for some painful misfortune because it left me such anxiety that I always put it out of my mind with a struggle, not willing to accept such foreboding.

The following night I had my usual union with my God;

I spent it with my Jesus and I could say I did not take even an hour of sleep because I was always absorbed in him.

When I recovered // I stayed in prayer and told a thousand things to my Good; and then I was again absorbed in him.

Oh, sweet night, you gave me much strength to be able to bear such cruel anxieties that were very delicious for me.

Anxieties of being damned.

The usual diabolic suggestions

For two days now the ugly monster made me go through serious things. It threw me into such consternation that I saw nothing but my iniquities. In everything I found big and enormous sins. Oh, my God, what despair to see that I am damned! Oh, a thousand hells could not frighten me, but in your company, always with you. Oh, a thousand crucifixions are few // together with you, my Good, but now, where have you gone? The enormous filth of mine so putrid made you go away; for pity’s sake, take me out of such pain!

23 February 1876. The anguishes of these days were such that my little capacity could not express them. Days of hell in the moments of anxiety in which I could not go to the church; the only refuge that I could have was that of throwing myself under the most holy feet of my Crucifix and complaining, finding relief as usual.

He made me sleep in peace in the sweet union with him. I stayed entire hours and I could stay even days, if I was not always sent out because that is what my office requires. But I am resigned and I feel full of liveliness. However, I do not // delay to fall again, because the devil uses diabolic suggestions as it did some time ago. They are always the same: that it throws me out the window, it kills me, it makes me lose my mind and I will remain stupid, that my end will be despair because I live in sin and I always commit sacrileges. But it does not point out anyone of these sins. Finally the confusion that it put into my poor head is such that could not be believed. Only the fact of recalling it to memory frightens me.

“How sweet to die of love!”

Today I had a bit of respite: my side was so swollen that the ribs were breaking. They rose so much that I could not avoid // exclaiming every now and then: my Good, you are killing me! Your love is so strong, my joy, that makes me languish, but they never satisfy, never!

However, I must say: increase again, so sweet love! How sweet it is to die of love! The hands, the feet, they all pain but all these sufferings are sweeter than honey! Oh, my side!

Jesus my Love, think that now I am not in the room but in the midst of the sisters and I can be seen. For pity’s sake, my Good! Night will come, and then I will be consumed in your sweet love. Now I finish, because speaking much increases the ardor.

Desire to make amends for the sins of carnival

What I would do, about this pig of a body! Oh, I would destroy it! Yes, I promise this evening // to satisfy myself with discipline. Oh, if my blood in these days in which your heart receives much injury from such ugly amusement could console you! How many sins! Alas, my Good! Oh, if

I could have much blood to be poured for all to cancel such horrible sins! Blessed Virgin, you my dear Mother, in these days extend your mantle, before the eyes of your Son so that he may not see such horrible sights and his justice may not fall down upon them. Alas, life of my life, what pains are these that I ever suffer at the thought that they offend you! Oh, what is my poor blood in comparison to such enormousness? //

Vision of the Heart of Jesus. Anniversary of the death of Sister Anne Vincenza (3 April)

One of these nights, I am not sure of the date, I was disturbed by a beast, very different from the others because it had a new shape. When it passed I started praying and I slept praying.

A shaking woke me up. There was a beautiful heart all blazing; it had a white circle around it and this made it brighter. Behind the white circle it had a beautiful light that decorated it around the edge. The rays which came out of this light were shining and they were much extended. It stayed for some time and then it disappeared. I do not know how to express what my side was feeling; I remained in ecstasy all // the time in which it was before me. When it disappeared, it seemed I was filled with something that flooded me and it could be said I was amazed for so much delight. Oh, heart of my Good, how much sweetness you made me feel!

I also had certain illustrations and teaching that my Good was kind enough to give me. Now I am in the darkness, everything is more painful than death. I suffer much at the sight of my disgracefulness. How painful it is to see myself deprived of my God for having offended him!

Oh, I committed many infamies, an abyss of putridity that I do not know how to remove in order to come out of such deep abyss. My God, pity! But what do I say if I do not see him anymore! //

How much my poor head suffered! Yesterday at five, I had a moment of relief; a big glob of fire appeared to me, a signal of my dear Vincenza. What did she want? She announced to me her feast in heaven, since today was her anniversary.

  • Oh, dear daughter, you will now see how I loved you! Do you see if it was true what I promised you?

Today I realized that she prays for me and keeps me reminded to God because my side is so swollen that the bones are breaking. The fits I feel towards God are very strong. Oh, Love, you see, I am in the midst of many eyes; I work, I distract myself as much as I can but my side // drags me to you. My God, how much I suffer for not being able to converse with you!

I end because I fear it may become stronger.

Suggestions and night figures

Night of 4 April. As soon as I was asleep, I felt a shaking. I opened my eyes and I saw a black big beast with long legs. Alas, it was a meter tall and standing at the back of the bed. I cried: my God! It then disappeared leaving me a wretched fear, of the coming of a grave affliction which unfortunately was revealed after a day.

Last night 7 of the current (…) at one after midnight, I was awakened again by another shaking and what did // I see? One third of my room was completely full of big flies which made a mess flying one against the other. They seemed to be in a battle and it was like a cloud. They left me such unrest that I was unable to sleep. Oh, what awaits me! A melancholy devoured me! Only prayer sustained me and my poor head suffered terrible beatings.

It seemed I had one inside my head and it was now being taken out. That was why I felt strong beatings in the whole head that made it seem as if I had many bumps. Oh, what a pain! A short time later it disappeared. Alas, my God! This // tortured me.

When I woke up my Good comforted me with his union and the side of his heart was swollen. I was united with him and he made me die of love. Oh, eternal Love, Life of my life, my Being, who can describe the sweetness that you make me feel! May be a seraph with his pen could say something of your love but it could never describe it in its infinite essence, my God! Oh, suffering, how sweet you are!

Again this night of eight, an ugly beast appeared to me and it had a strange shape. // It left me very upset and I was not able to remove it from my spirit. The ugly things it formed in my mind this night of nine were horrible.

Another very big beast less black appeared to me and the body had nothing decent; it had long legs and on the back some bristling thorns. These were long like the legs, but it had many of those bristling long ones that brought horror because they were all turned towards me. I was stood for a while and then it started running because I was already forming the sentence to ask what it wanted and what it meant. As soon as I said: my God, and then, who are you? It did not give me time // because it fell, a big bird that appeared to me; it flew from one wall to another. It was so big that it terrified me because when it flew from the wall where it was attached, it seemed to me it would come upon me and in these five or six days the beasts continued and were always of new types. Then I had a respite of two or three days and again they restarted.

The usual anxieties. Suggestions of an evil one

Yesterday, Friday, what a horrible day! I was with my mother but I suffered horribly and I had the strong feeling that I would be thrown out the window.

I sweat of anguish because the feeling was so strong that I felt I was fainting. It seemed to me to have been already thrown down. Satan truly pushed me towards all the windows that I saw. // I was feeling a tightening and being strongly torn. Oh, my God, who could express what is felt for what the enemy of hell does to a creature! What I felt was horrible, sweat of anguish. Oh, my God, how many pains they did announce to me!

Last evening, after having suffered horribly, I lay down. Beasts of every kind started to stroll: big and small in different shapes. They left me with such a pain that I was not able to be calm. Now there is one which is passing; it is the first I have seen during daytime. It passed quickly when I started to write; it was black, ugly, and a bit bigger than a bird. What unrest! // I cannot understand the meaning.

This morning, while I prayed to my Eternal Father that he might grant me to understand what will happen to me and to order the beasts to answer me, or that I might understand their meaning, this infamous beast started saying:

  • Turn to me, give yourself to me; I will tell you everything which will happen to you; you will find yourself informed on everything.

Oh, what horror gave me this voice!

My God, have pity, save me! Yes, I renounce to know anything; I want to stay with you my Good even in the dark, if that is what you like. Therefore, my Good, do not allow // that this infamous ugly beast come to torment me. Oh, dread! How dreadful the voice of this monster! Enough! My Good entered in all the darkness; only him and for him, Jesus, life of my life, living of my living. I also see that the battle that hell had waged against me is horrible but my sovereign keeps under his heel all the forces. It can do nothing, neither to me nor to the Work.

  • Ugly beast, you have nothing other than horrible stench; you are detestable, your scarecrows will not do anything but consolidate the Work of the Lord. Courage stinking, uglier than the same tomb! //

How much Satan tormented me whispering to me that without my being aware it would throw me out the window or it would throw me in other places. The violence it brings me is such that my poor head suffers much.

  • You are damned – it said yesterday – there is nothing that could save you. It would be better if you turned to me;

if not you will despair.

  • Horrible beast, go away from me – I said, when it pressed.

But I remained so depressed and I did not know where to lean my head to have relief. I started praying, but the headache became so strong that I was obliged // to stop and to be satisfied saying only: my God, you have abandoned me; what did I do? Oh unhappy, my infamies have reduced me to this!

But nothing comforted me. Only today in Holy

Communion he comforted me and assured me that…

“There were moments in which I feared losing my mind”

My God! On some days I cannot describe what my head suffers. From all sides I find an abyss of horrible diabolic suggestions. For three nights this enemy of hell beat me on the head in such a way that it seemed all the nerves were upset; crossing them one over the other, they gave me horrid spasms. I calmed a bit when in the // name of God

I drove away the enemy that caused me a strong pain in the arm which I could not move; again I was depressed but calm. The anxiety that a certain affair gave me brought me agony. Oh, who could see what a battle I was engaged in!

It showed me that I was already on the edge of hell, and there was nothing that could help to save me and everything

I did was material work, but there was nothing belonging to

God.

It said that my actions were all wasted and if I did not think of retreating I would be lost. It fascinated // my poor mind, such that there were moments in which I feared of losing it.

The beast which caused this pain of mine added another greater one where it showed me that my mind was no longer capable of reasoning: it was already damaged so badly that I could lose it completely without realizing. In the small things that I did not care to observe well, it whispered strongly and confusedly:

  • There, for you it is the end!

Otherwise it dragged me – and this at night – into certain despair to the point that I would cry, if I did not think they would realize, since I had another sister close to me. //

On the day of confession it took me and said that I was certainly going to commit a sacrilege. Instead I thought of going to confession and I threw myself at the feet of the Crucifix. What I felt in that moment was so great that I hardly spoke. The beast wanted to interrupt me strongly saying:

  • Keep quiet and go. Otherwise this confessor will put you upside down; for a very small imperfection you see what a skinning he undertakes! Do not say anything, keep quiet!

Oh, my Good, in that moment I saw very clearly that it was the ugly Satan! Afterwards when I thought, what fear I felt! And even in that moment what a // dread!

“Oh, Mary, thanks to you I am safe, for you I am a nun!”

By God’s grace I regained peace; however, my soul was tortured by pain not understanding what the Lord wanted from me in an affair and also in certain things in which the beast had whispered to me that I would never get out from that affair without asking Satan for help. Alas, the violence it provoked was such that I struggled not to allow others to realize during the day and at night that I could weep continually. In this way my head suffered, the pain in the lungs and in the stomach was almost daily. If someone could penetrate my state, she could certainly be moved to pity. // In despair, I threw myself at the feet of Mary, refuge of the poor. After weeping, I entrusted to her my soul and the two very important affairs. I felt a dew of balm coming down into my soul and slowly I gained assurance. An interior voice said to me:

  • I will take care of these affairs.

My tears dried and I did not feel the slightest affliction;

I remained as if everything was organized and that I had the means to face my duties.

I also recommended providence for // this house and I did not delay to see that the dear Sovereign already cared for her servants, daughters of her beloved mother. Oh, Mary, thanks to you I am safe, for you I am a nun! The fire of love for your Son, Mary, with your hands you lit it many times in this heart. Oh, yes, Love, why do you not make me die of this? Alas, my side, Jesus, most beloved, it is already swollen more than usual. Oh, if I could give vent to what I feel!

Night will come, and then I will throw myself to the ground that this side may give vent to the entire ardor. Alas, the ribs are raised and I fear they may surprise me.

Oh, joy, why do you not consume me? Love, // why do you burn and do not consume me? Oh, sweet Spouse, why do you not satisfy my longing? Oh, sweetest beloved, why do you not melt me in this love? Oh, consume me, for pity’s sake; I do not want any other payment but your love! Oh, dear Spouse, the other day, you consoled me so much when I feared you were angered by my infamies; while receiving you the priest gave me a particle and another one escaped from his fingers to enter into this very unclean mouth of mine. I felt so much comforted in the oppression I suffered;

I felt my soul soothing that // all my suffering was changed to sweetness. Oh, sufferings and pains, how sweet you are!

“Oh, Love, you make me die, Being of my life!”

Night of 20 May. After some hours of sleep I felt shaken and I woke. Near the wall on the right side where I was turned, I saw a bright light, a big flame of fire. In the middle it was a bit darker and it was so beautiful that I was enraptured; it stayed stationary for some minutes and then it moved and came on my head. What I felt while it approached I cannot express but it was like gentle nectar that inebriated me. When it reached my head it disappeared because I did not see the light that it issued and came back to myself. But I remained united with God in such a way that I was // dying and my side was raised so much that I was obliged to cry: alas, my God, you are killing me! Oh sweet death!

The following night again, my Good did the same. He let me sleep for some time in order to regain strength. Then he woke me up shaking and holding me tightly to himself: oh, Love – I cried, unable of doing otherwise – you are killing me, Being of my life!

My bones and my side were much raised, but when it seemed that I was dying, I calmed. He gave me a few moments of peace and again I was united to him. Oh, what I felt! Oh, why do you not consume me, my sweet Love? Tell me, is it you who make me feel // pleasure in suffering? What did you hide in this sweetest nectar of suffering, my Good?

I spent the rest of the night in this way. The hour of meditation came but I was so worn out that I was not able to stand on my feet, and lying as I was, I started meditating. Again I was enraptured; I stayed in a sweet union, I would not say of any other thing but of love and the whole day I did not think of any other thing but my Good. In comparison to much grace only my poverty frightens me.

My Eternal God, what if I could have a tongue capable of giving you thanks! //

Resistance in obeying to reveal a certain matter

On 21 May 1876, I spent a nice day always in union with my God and I felt very gentle sweetness when I enjoyed clasped in union with him. Oh, sweet Love!

I convinced myself to reveal a certain matter which I had made a resolution not to tell out of shame.

Oh, how much it costs me to reveal what my Good accomplishes in me! Oh, a thousand times I would tell in public the horrible sins I committed, but not the graces which he granted me; for me this is the greatest pain that I could have! It does nothing else than make me desire to go and lock myself on a mountain, never again // to see creatures. But then the thought that I will have no longer my Good for Holy Communion in the morning stops me; I then go repeating within myself:

  • If the command is very demanding now that it does not make me live, without surrendering myself to tell what he wants; certainly even in a remote cave, as I desire, it will be the same and I will have no peace until I will have obeyed my God.

I was so battled that my mind was worn out in thinking;

now it seemed I was able to follow my plan and to obey // as well as I could what the Lord wanted.

The devil: “It is the end for you, I have won; you are mad!”

The day before yesterday I felt a deadly melancholy. The torture my soul was feeling was such that nothing could raise me up.

It is already a good month and a half that I had no time to dedicate to writing, though I have had frequent reproaches; but what can I do? My head is very weak and full of such a multitude of affairs that if I delay writing what I received from my God, I am not able to describe it.

The painful assaults that the evil one gave me some days ago could make one go crazy. They were such that I cannot express them.

One night I woke up towards two o’clock; I had taken little sleep // and my mind was in such utter confusion that I was not able at all to make a firm correct thought. A voice strongly insisted:

  • It is the end for you, I have won; you are mad!

What a dread! I already seemed worn out and could not resist. I jumped out of the bed to entrust myself to God but I did not meet him anymore for he had abandoned me. I could say neither the Our Father nor the Hail Mary. Calling for her was a great toil and she seemed she was nowhere for me. Jesus, alas, I could not even call to him for help.

At the end the battle was increasing and I was strongly told:

  • I will throw you out the window! //

At last I was exhausted and I abandoned myself on the ground. When I recovered a bit, my God, why did you abandon me? What did I do?

Finally I was not able to stand on my feet. I lay down worn out and struggling, but I already felt an invisible hand sustaining me. My God, have pity on me! This was what I said because I was unable to say other prayers. I stayed in this state until Communion and in that moment I regained peace.

However, at the end of thanksgiving it whispered again…but interiorly I was assured that it will never happen, // and I would never be assailed strongly like this anymore. I therefore embraced my God who had come back to me, beloved Spouse. Oh, what kind and of what nature this tribulation was could not be described for it was worse than death itself.

Again the nightmare of being mad, and throwing herself out the window

How many and what graces I received from my God in this period of time I am unable to describe, because it would demand too much to put it together. In this way I will only say that I suffered much but the consolations I received were also many. For several days I have been in a painful aridity and I have suffered much; I fear that my infamies // merited this for me.

During these days many things happened and having no time to write them down I do not remember them anymore and that is why I thought of keeping quiet, writing only what took place these last days starting from 8 August 1876.

In the evening, after having taken an hour of sleep I woke up startled; I jumped from the bed: my God! But a voice and much power overcame me:

  • You are mad!

My mind was so confused; I did not know whether I was able to have a right thought. Everything was an abyss of dread, for me it was the end.

What I suffered could not be described; I did not // know how to come out of it. My mind was capable of nothing. At the end of such a cruel battle, my mind became a bit broad and I was dragged violently by another temptation:

  • You will be thrown out the window!

Alas, Jesus, save me! I threw myself on the bed and I gave vent, calling, pleading with my God to free me; I was left without strength but with a headache and still worse with confusion that stayed for more than two hours.

Oh, Satan, ugliest monster, how many things you make me undergo!

The Eternal Father:

“The roads which lead to me are many”

In the morning I was really worn out; in Holy Communion

I found strength but not caresses. // The following evening I went to bed while I was united with my God and I spent the night in his heart. In the morning after concluding my thanksgiving, I turned my attention to the Eternal Father. It saw as though he had a bundle of ropes in his hand, but he did not; being separated one from the other, they all ended in him. I asked him for the meaning; an interior voice said to me:

  • The roads which lead to me are many; and a sweet balm…

Yes, it filled my soul. The whole day I was joyful and always // so united with my God that I cannot express what I felt.

Shaking and night figures

At night I have been upset by shakings; the enemy tried, but my Jesus did not allow it. The next morning it was not like that; in all my actions I was fearful. I did not feel other than a continuous unrest that prepared me for the night. I was well aware.

In fact, as I lay,- and I had delayed going to bed as long as I could – my room was covered with black here and there; I had difficulty to finding words or prayers. I was dry, arid, colder than a marble.

In this way it seemed to me I could take a bit of rest. // Not at all! A shaking woke me up and there was a Crucifix a meter and half distant; the cross was black and seemed to be made of fire rather than anything else and inside it had a small naked creature that was bending. I remained as usual motionless. I could not even speak but fixing at it aroused in me fear and fright.

As soon as I was freed when I wanted to ask who it was and call my God for help, persuaded that it was the devil, it started moving away. I was almost to say the first // word that it fell over a door I have near the bed. I remained trembling so much that I was not able to calm down. I thought and thought again but I got nothing. After a long time I seemed to need sleep again; but it was not to come. I was shaken again and a new mixture of various monsters united together appeared to me in the same position. They did the same as the first. I had hardly opened my mouth when they ran away and fell into the same place as the first.

I did not rest anymore, because the shakings left me trembling and // an unrest that kept me awake. In this way in the morning I was exhausted.

The devil threatens to throw her down the stairs

I cannot write everything that happened to me in this period because the events were many and so tormenting that I could say I had sufferings of every kind.

One day, I happened to be at the top of the stairs; this monster with violence said to me:

  • I will throw you down!

I felt as if a person were coming close and I could not be free anymore. Oh, how much I had to resist! Mary, my Eternal Father, free me! I was able to release myself but I cannot say how much unrest it caused me; every type of beast went around the room, one in one way //and another one with another meaning. I cannot describe how much pain they caused me.

Apparition of father St. Francis. The wounds of the feet not those of the hands are open

Finally, Monday night, my God comforted me. First I saw a sister who left me something of peace; after my dear father St. Francis appeared to me and left me strengthened with a desire to suffer and resignation. He said nothing but it was enough to calm me down.

The following evening having suffered horrible pains the whole day, before I lay down I felt acute wounds on my feet, on my hands, and on the side that I could hardly bear.

Looking at my feet, because on these I felt very acute spasms and burning, I found them open! My God, // that no one may realize!

I have always prayed to him that he may see to it that the hands do not open and that is what happened; only the feet were open and for some days I had to carry the spasm. I thank my God for he had always granted me that nobody realized anything. Even now, they are only the feet that opened and I feel pain but I hope they will be closed before

I start to travel.3

Apparition of a Bishop comforting her.

The bright cloud returns

The next day (…) while I was giving thanks, a Bishop appeared to me who told me various things of my conscience because I had certain doubts. //

While he spoke to me I was so assured that my God loved me. He said to me:

  • You are his beloved.

Oh, what sweetness he made me feel! I would have liked to know who he was, but he did not tell me; however, a thought came to me that it could be Satan who came to delude me. He opened the clothes on his breast and he showed me a big cross that was printed on it.

  • Do not doubt – he said – I have many things still to tell you.

After this, he started telling me something and then he disappeared. He left me a unique consolation and resignation to receive news of grave and ill-omen. However, I remained in this state of sweetness for two days and two nights; one I spent with my Good // in an intimate union.

At four in the morning I saw my old cloud: when I saw it I felt flooded with consolation and cheerfulness as when – if it could be compared – someone very dear, who was lost for a long time, arrives. The cloud already contained at its center my Good, though he did not reveal himself to me openly. But for whatever I felt I understood that he was the one; a light brightened it more. Yes, you are my Beloved. Oh, you came to strengthen me so that I may sustain the difficult and violent attacks! // Yes, the strength fruit of your love to resist everything: the worst deaths, the cruelest afflictions are nothing.

Oh, suffering, where are you? When will I be satisfied? I am too hungry to be satisfied!

When the pains arrive I say: my Good, you had already announced them, so that there is nothing new for me!

An angel winding up a skein of silk into a ball

This night, 2 October 1876, I was visited by very ugly beasts, all different one from the other but very strange because they had few legs and were very big. Patience! Other new pains! I say patience because these always announce trouble and for this my Eternal Father is offended. Oh, if I would prevent it, I could do it at the cost of // my blood!

Even my Good consoled me during Communion. I had hardly received him when my side was swollen and a fire was burning so much that it burned me. Oh, Love, why do you not consume me once in this way?

On 22 October 1876, while I was concluding my thanksgiving for Holy Communion, an angel appeared to me with a big ball of silk in hand as if winding up a skein. After having picked some amount on the ball he paused to untie a knot which was there but he was unable because it was so tight that he could never untie or unravel it. //

When I saw him winding up and the silk coming nicely I felt much consolation but when he stopped on the knot I felt some kind of melancholy and I had a certain pain which I cannot explain renewed in me.

However, before he left, this good angel had already unraveled a good amount of it; I did not see it fully untied, only partially. Oh, what a thought!

Presage of unhappy events

This night before I was able to sleep a beast of a new shape strolled in my room. This morning while I prepared myself for Holy Communion, I heard being suggested what would happen to me; it was similar to the knot of yesterday and // in my thanksgiving for Holy Communion he told me everything that would happen to me. I felt immense suffering as if I were already in the sad state; I felt a cruel torture.

I therefore await the day of such unhappy event. My God, give me the strength to bear everything resigned; grant me your grace, my God, and I will bear everything!

If I could be able to explain, I would like to say many things that I continually feel and see; but it is impossible to do it because my ignorance does not allow me. I will only say that for God’s mercy, the pains are very many and the // desire of being satiated of suffering grows more and more and the graces of my Good are without compare.

On some nights the beasts did not allow me to rest. When I am almost asleep a shaking and a beast strolling from one side to the other of the room could be seen. Horrible monsters, I well know you announce turmoil and suffering, I know it is all your doing and for this I am not upset with anything. My God, look at your poor creature and protect me from such horrible monsters.

Anxieties and various sufferings

One of these evenings, first oppressed by spasms in the whole body it seemed to me // that I was breathing my last; after the whole room was filled with black plates, what dread I felt! Oppressed by such vision, not being able to utter a word, as usual I stayed as if tied, without the faculty of either motion or of speech. Oh, what pain I felt!

But in the morning it was more painful because in receiving Communion I had suffered much for the discussion that I was hearing and I was told what I would have suffered. It was so very painful and torturing that I felt like fainting.

At the end I was so afflicted and tortured by suffering that I did not find peace. Finally the moment of undergoing the terrible torture came. //

Oh, how much I suffered on the third of December 1876! In the evening I thought I was dying! Recovered from the pain I remained entangled as if I were tightened by a knot on all sides.

I was in a place where I had to open a house. There I was visited by very big beasts and of a new type that seeing them I cried: my God, pity!

Having said this, they disappeared. Oh, how many very nice suggestions I received on this affair! The first evening

I saw that lady there was a beast moving around her.

Superior light on the cause of unrest in a community

I went into one of our houses and I received from the confessor many complaints regarding the superior; he knew certain internal things of the house and I could not know how // and who could have told him.

It could be doubted of the sisters, but of certain other people it could not be because they loved her much and she was very good. She had few small weaknesses but surely not serious enough: that he should inform the Archbishop… He knew so much that one could never imagine from where the information came. From the first evening they showed me a young lady who wanted to become a sister. The superior thought of her as an angel and suffered to see I discharged her from all the duties that she was carrying on // with the sisters.

On the same morning I was leaving, immediately after

Communion my God told me clearly that it was this young lady who put together all the bad things and carried them to the confessor slandering the superior and the girls. As soon as I came out of the church, we tried to make amends for such monstrosity.

The truth was discovered: that she did the same thing in another place and the superior had to be admonished by the Archbishop. Oh, goodness of a God, who can ever discover such mysterious mess if not your uncreated wisdom? You who see // in the remotest hidings of the human heart!

“I saw my Eternal Father spreading his right hand upon my head”

Christmas day 1876. Oh, my side seemed furious. Love, how sweet you are, but your strength is such that it makes me die.

This morning, 28 December, I had hardly received my Love when I was absorbed in a great light. I saw my Eternal Father spreading his right hand upon my head. I must say that I had suffered much throughout the night. My poor head seemed as if it had been beaten by dogs. Oh, what pain, what suffering! But I have always been with my Crucifix meditating on the crowning of thorns.

I was very weak and feared // fainting and being unable of receiving but my dear Jesus gave me strength and I managed. So exhausted, as soon as the Eternal Father spread his right hand, I gained strength and I was able to kneel down for more than three quarters of an hour.

After, I remained in the church seated; as soon as I came out, I took my work and continued until evening without interruption. Oh, goodness of a God, how can I do so that people may love you!

Though I am in the abyss of suffering, something keeps my interior peace, which cannot be expressed. //
