MS 4.5 – pp. 1-23

The year 1877, would seem to have been a relatively calm year for Mother Rosa regarding the habitual night battles. However, violent apprehensions and temptations, especially those which incited her to suicide were not missing. At least if she could have had someone from whom she could get help and orientation; but since 1869 she had been without a spiritual guide and she continued to repeat: “Alone, without someone to whom I can say a word to give vent!” She heard Jesus telling her: “I am your guide.” But what should she do when he hides himself? Mother Rosa felt the need of a spiritual director mostly when she wanted to see clearly the plan of God in her own interior life, including the penances; instead in carrying out her responsibilities as a Foundress she felt amply helped by the Lord. She herself is amazed at the gift of interior penetration to people and of the disposition of the spirit of the sisters which helped her to proceed with shrewdness and success.

The chronological indications are not many and they appear to be gathered in a disorganized way. For example, after April 9, she goes back to March 18. Already among the notes of the month of June we find an experience of September 6, 1876. The explanation of this interposition could be the one hinted above: they were papers written provisionally during her journeys; afterwards she copied them in the notebook of the Memorie, wherever it occurred. In fact the writing dated September 6, 1876 was added in the last two pages of the exercise book.

Again she complained of not being able to write whatever she wanted: “I experienced many things in these days, but because of lack of time I never wrote; in this way I am afraid that I am not able to say or to write precisely what I saw and felt.”

MS 4.4 – pp. 90 – 142

“My Good, I am dying, but consume me quickly!”

Oh, what I felt on the first day of the year 1877! My side was so high and the ribs were very much raised. Oh, Love! While one feels like dying one never desires it to cease, but that it may increase. The torture was strong, so deep that I feared, but I could not do anything. I only repeated to my Beloved: consume me for pity’s sake!

It lasted for two days; there were few hours in which he gave me peace. But at night, when I was alone with my Good, I abandoned myself to be taken up by him and lamenting I said to him: my Good, I am dying, but consume me quickly! Oh, if this could be the night in which // I could be consumed by your love! When will it be my Good that I will never come out of this sweet dying?

Early in the morning I was again fresh and ready to restart to work. I had not yet received Holy Communion, but united with Jesus… Oh, Being of my life!

The night of Epiphany, what I felt! Again my side was high and it stayed for the whole day and the following night until after Communion.

Lights and reproaches of the Lord regarding the Work

I needed to choose a superior for one house and before going out of the church I said: tell me, my Beloved, whom should I choose? I am waiting for you, would you like to tell me?

Finally I heard an interior voice that told me // what I should do and whom I should choose.

In the same way, in these days I received a continued rebuke for not having gone to visit a house since I was already in that area and I had a strong impulse, but as usual the laziness overcame me and I turned aside the thought returning to Florence without passing. Oh, how much I regret now! Oh, yes, there was much need.

“My Love is strong and it overcame me”

Today, Friday, until yesterday my side did not allow me to rest. It was big and all the ribs were raised; alas I had to say: my Good you are killing me!

This state remained throughout the night and also in the morning in Holy Communion. Oh, sweet love! // What I felt! It always continued; I did not know how to keep myself. I tried to master myself as much as I could and I am always concerned about the affairs of the Work. But my Love is strong and he overcame me. How he made me fear that they might realize! You, my sweetest Good, you could say what you are able to do in such a cowardly and abject creature. Oh, infinite goodness, incomprehensible love!

How much my hidden suffering and what I suffer in my pains please him! Oh, if I could say how much pain, I could well say that there are hours in which I feel tortured!

Rebuke of Jesus for not being so discreet towards the sisters

I had a gentle inner rebuke from my Good, because these last few days I allowed myself // in front of several other sisters, to scold one who was rude. When I spoke it seemed to me that I was doing it for the right reason to shake them up and make them become quick, so that they would be able to do good.

Unfortunately, my Good admonished me, and I promised him that I would not do it again and took the blame with the most intense guilt. Oh, how good it was for me to see the fault I had committed!

  • Charity! – He repeated to me, while I said – charity!

Jesus, my Good, what a pain! For pity’s sake, forgive me!

He made me see the ugliness of this imperfection; how much I suffered!

Another time when a priest spoke badly of a // Cardinal, seeing that the soul of this priest was more filthy than of the one of whom he spoke badly and the damage it could bring, I was furious! I could not control myself and I had to speak:

  • Infamous tongue that brings much damage, for pity’s sake, my God do not allow these bad speeches to reach the hearing of the Pope!

Raptures and fire of love. Corporal penances

For two Fridays now after midnight, my side has risen very much and where does it turn? To the tabernacle of our chapel; inside there –Love – what I felt cannot be described! Submerged in that open sea, what sweetness! Enraptured in this way I stayed, and as I recovered it seemed to me more than one hour and half had passed. I remained serene, but the union did not delay and later it was stronger. // What did my side do? It was as high as my ribs; I was all on fire. I went to the church. Oh, Love are you preparing me for greater sufferings? In this way, first you gave great thirst for suffering. My dear Good, you filled me with resignation. I understand well my dear Beloved! The times you had a similar behavior towards your slave are infinite.

  • Yes, assist me – I go on saying this when I am treated in that manner. While fearful of suffering, this humanity makes itself felt and at every movement it feels frightened. I mock it continually, it fears! There are moments in which I feel // compassion for it, and if it were not for the hatred I have for it, I could be moved by pity, especially when burdened by sufferings.

When the weather is bad, the scars seem like many daggers that pierce me, especially in the arms; the pains are such that many times they make me move giving me shocks.

What I feel is something that consoles me, that I can suffer something for my God. In the past I scourged this pig with pleasure, now I can no longer renew these penances. Jesus does not allow it. Many times I asked him to order me to do so but he does not want to. He leaves me thirsty, but then…

Now he does not allow me much more than a certain discipline // until bleeding, the chain and nothing more.

Cardinal Protector, great gift for the Institute

At various times, when I am in the presence of my dear

Protector, I feel some certainty; I do not know how to express myself, but a voice tells me:

  • He has been chosen by me.

The impression which I received in my vision many years ago when I saw that a Cardinal would have come to be our Protector and he would have done much good for the Work of the Lord, was renewed in me. I saw him when I was enraptured, and as soon as I saw him, what I felt! He is the one who would protect us! Oh, infinite goodness!

May this unworthy servant of yours, // working badly, not become unworthy, my God! Oh, providence of my God.1

Palpable assistance of Divine Providence

Today I was very bitter for I had to pay another rent and

I had not even 10 francs in the house. I have been sued for this. Oh, what a pain! I prayed and I said: How is it my God, I cannot even feel the pain and I suffer. I feel such indifference within me which does not allow me to feel anything. I recommended to God that thing and I did the same to the protector saints and to my Serafina.

  • Look, what a disgrace! They will come to collect the money and I am without any!

One sued me for 308 francs and the other for 150, and I had nothing. I started to write, // a very interesting letter, and I was told the mailman was here with insured letters. Inside there were precisely the three hundred francs. Oh, goodness of my Being, my Beloved!

I was missing the others; however, later on an insured letter arrived and inside there were the others. Oh, loving Father, what bounty this is! In this way nobody realized anything.

This was not enough; towards the evening with the last mail another letter from a pious person arrived inviting me on the 21st of the current month and enclosed 2,000 francs.

Yes, my God, suffering for you is sweet delight.

The following day, I had again, another 500 francs. I certainly felt so touched I cannot describe it.//

Sufferings for the accusations against the confessor

Oh, how much I suffered in these days, my God! It was for a person who tried all the ways of condemning our confessor. Oh, what tortures! The speech I made to that unfortunate person was only but for the good of her/his soul!

They wanted to accuse him for false zeal. At the end there were moments in which I felt like tearing the soul because of such false slanders.

Astuteness and ill-treatment of the infamous dragon

The infamous dragon took advantage of this circumstance and some other still sorrowful ones that accompanied it to throw upon me the most horrible temptation that could be given, that I became mad.

Oh, my God! Such // astuteness, that very often it shows me my mind fails understanding, my memory stops, my tongue is so tied that I mess up in speaking. At last its evils and astuteness are numberless. I can only say that it enervates me and there are moments in which it exhausts me to a point that seems I have no life. From head to toe I find myself as a person who has lost her vitality. Oh, what suffering!

There was a moment it wanted to drown me, suddenly removing my breath. Luckily it was only for a little while, but the fear was such that I suffered and I was // upset as if I came out of a faint.

Oh, wicked serpent, how many things you do to me, but you will always be under my heel.

“On the side where your heart is, it seemed to me my bones were breaking”

Today I had such melancholy that I could have stayed only at the feet of my Jesus in the tabernacle. Oh, I said it well that something bad was to come on me.

For three mornings in my meditation I was near the tabernacle; not only the side, the bones were raised, I was enraptured and it seemed that on the side where his heart2 is found the bones were breaking. Oh, what I felt!

Fainting and agonies of death

Friday, 2 February 1877. This night the Blessed Virgin had already granted me the gift of staying always //with my

Good, with the Father and with his dearest Son. I must say that at two after midnight, I had certain shadows which brought me something dark in my mind and the thought always went to a cross I saw the day before, a very big and long one. On the same day I suffered an agony of death and this stayed another day. I had to struggle to stay on my feet. How much I suffered! My God, only you could say it!

If I did not know that such fainting or rather agonies of death will cease I could not have borne it even one hour, such is the pain I feel. In spite of this I go on reasoning within me: //

  • You know well, since it happened to you a thousand times. Therefore you should not fear.

But it is so strong that it always seems like my last hour. My God, how much is suffered in agony!

When it is for someone who died it is very painful and when something will happen in the Work it is difficult, but Lord I suffer much!

  • Oh, what a prolonged martyrdom – I go on saying many times.

Yes, my Good, I suffer very willingly since I cannot tell you to take it away. No it is enough that it pleases you.

And when I offer him such miserable pains, he makes me feel an indescribable peace.

“I seemed to be nourished by my Jesus”

Today, as I said above, 2 February, what Mary made me feel on // my side! It was very much raised up.

During the whole night three times I seemed to be nourished by my Jesus. What I felt was very great!

Oh, my Good – I said for the third time – how can I ever receive you for the third time!

It was not a priest who gave me, no, rather an angel, from the shape. Oh, sweetest Love!

Now and then I continue to see a star not very big but not small. Who could be my God? Why do you always hide it? In this day there were moments especially now while I write – Love – that my side… Woe betide me if I gather myself to pray! Even if I turn aside // it is not enough; it becomes stronger.

How much I suffer at not being able to hide myself at least for an hour. Instead I must wait for the night. Then, yes, I give vent and am full of ardent desire, with the fire that destroys me. I give vent to my love until I remain in him.

Oh, may it never become day, my Good – I go on exclaiming - for pity’s sake, that no one may realize my position, of what goes on between me and you. Yes, only the night, my Good, I sacrifice everything willingly and more than willingly. The pleasure and the consolations or anything else that you give me do in a way that human beings may not realize what you give me but that they may always // believe me the most disgraceful of this earth. Oh, yes, only you, life of my life, Being of my life. Mary, sweetest and dearest mother, I was and I am yours! Keep me tightly to Jesus to die in him!

The most terrible pains that a soul could suffer

One of these nights I suffered much and after much pain a soul appeared to me; as soon as I saw it, it disappeared, but it was as if tied. I asked for the meaning but I got nothing. After some days I heard of the death of a sister;

what I suffered in that agony only my Good could say.

Even this night I suffered terrible tortures and at every moment it seemed I would no longer be able to reason, that I could lose my memory and become mad.

Oh, my God, these are the most terrible // pains that a soul could suffer. Submerged in desolation, tossed and shaken on all sides, it finds every way blocked as the poor souls of hell who have no more hope of coming out from such deep abyss.

Oh, terrible pains! Everything came before me as if of someone without her mind. I only felt a gloomy suggestion that pointed me out as being already fallen in such a cruel state.

Horrible monster! Cruel torture!

I made an effort to meditate but the struggle was so much that it caused me a strong headache. With such a headache one is always more congested and understands nothing, and many other subtle and intense things which are of great torment for me. Most horrible monster! // My God, how painful my state is!

Full of anguish for certain extraordinary things that the Lord does in me, and not having someone to whom I could turn to, I wept at the feet of my God so that he may make clearly known what he wants in what I am feeling. Interiorly he gave me lively impulses to make me believe that he is and all the time he instructed me.

Instead this time, though I destroy myself by weeping, I do not feel him, see him, nor hear his voice. My Good, have I become an object of suffering for you? Do you not love me anymore? Where are you, my dear God, and where are your caresses? Where are you hiding? Do you not want to see me anymore?

Oh, only the seraphim could // explain what in this painful state could be suffered! The tortures of every kind could not be imagined. The hatred I feel towards my body is such that if I could be allowed I could make it into pieces in order to satisfy and to expiate with such suffering this terrible punishment. Oh, no pain could satisfy the thirst I have for suffering! My Jesus, have pity!

The enemy is furious for the zeal of preventing the non-compliance of the sisters

For many days now, the enemy has tortured me upsetting me and saying:

  • Your mind is spoiled and after some time you will not be able to reason because I will take it away.

  • Dragon of hell, go away!

But there are moments in which it takes away all my strength and I have such atrocious suffering that one of these nights I thought I was dying; my poor // bones were twisting in pain. That was not enough; in all my bones the nerves were tightened and brought me agony. Oh, suffering, you are sweet to me!

But this ugly monster became more furious and threatened me. It was enraged and threw upon me a certain sickness. And more so, this soon turned into a strong pain.

I laughed at it because I saw the work of this monster; I suffered but I always was victorious.

It was angered because it realized that I was aware of certain non-compliances and of the hypocrisy of a sister who kept hiding while eating, making others believe she did not eat. In addition she did not have a good heart towards the superiors and towards those she had to care for. //

  • Oh, monster! – I exclaimed.

When my God made known to me why much noncompliance happened, that the hearts of the poor sisters were already ugly and much coldness reigned for the works of mercy that were without equal… enough. I hope to have made it. But the monster made me go through such horrible tortures that in the morning I was upset and tired.

The pain I felt to stand on my feet only God could know; I had torments of all kinds.

And yet my Love did not stop assisting me uniting me with him and my side rose so much that when I went to the table, pity, what I felt, because the ribs suffered. It was delight without compare // but when I recovered I felt very sad.

This morning, it wanted to disturb me in meditation with terrible suggestions but my Good allowed me to hide in his side and I stayed at length. I leave my side for consideration…

Love, if I speak and remember your caresses and unite myself to you during the day, I fear they could realize. In this way I always live in pain. Oh, infinite sweetness!

Sweet rest in union with Jesus after Communion

I woke up and I found myself so united with my God adoring him in the Blessed Sacrament, in the tabernacle of the sweetest love. Oh, infinite beauty, you are killing me! The union was so sweet that I did not know if I lived or my Love lived for me.

I stood and, eager to receive him quickly, // I threw myself at his divine feet. But as soon as I received him: my Love, why do I receive you only once in twenty-four hours? Why are you not with me always as in this instant? I told him a Vesuvius of thoughts and affectionate words, disconnected phrases because of my eagerness to speak to him and the breathlessness I was feeling. It was very sweet, a kind of rest in union with him.

“A thousand deaths would not be as hard as having lost you”

Ah, life of my life, yes, in the abyss of my nothingness in which I find myself submerged in these days of sorrow, if people would realize my torment they could feel dread. Wherever I turn my mind, in all my actions, I do not see other than an abyss of disorder, and since it is infinite it cannot be expiated. //

I do not find my God anymore. I am dry, arid and my mind is cloudy and seems hardened. I cannot have a profound thought but only superficial ones.

I have some ideas of the Passion, but immediately a crowd of other immense thoughts come to tire me, and are stronger than others; they exhaust me and leave me with my head very tired because of the effort that I put to drive them away. My God, where am I?- I go on saying – in an abyss of infamy? Oh, an open hell is under my feet!

Wherever I turn my eyes, I see only the precipice. Therefore, am I lost? Where am I? Alone without someone to whom to say a word; Jesus, you are the one // who placed me here and you hold me. You do not want me to turn to anyone, and therefore?

The most deplorable state is that of having to conceal… It is true that when I think I am able to carry it well, I say: my God, it is your stuff, because certainly I would not be able to do it without a greater help. Therefore, my Good, why did you leave me so disgraceful? Will I have no more shares in your love? My disgracefulness has reduced me to this state.

A thousand deaths could not be as hard as having lost you. Oh, the worst of tortures, the most cruel; a thousand

// martyrdoms would be more bearable.

My discipline until bleeding does not satisfy me; I have no strength to bear it; when I do a good deal of it I am exhausted and I cannot be satisfied. My God!

“Lord, make everyone know who I am”

I have had a deadly melancholy for two days now. If I could only reveal what I am feeling of melancholy it would be a dread. I feel compassion for myself! If someone helps me and praise is given to the Institute, and they attribute it to me, what horror! I feel in torment!

The nothing that I am appears before my eyes and I feel unworthy, and I would throw myself to the ground as I do at night crying: my God, such an abyss is believed to be good and thought capable of accomplishing something; it is impossible! // Let everyone know who I am, just as you give me the grace of seeing myself in all my vile ugliness. Alas!

Never allow these poor creatures to be betrayed by the appearances they see, but let them see all the wretchedness and infamy that I see. Oh, earth, why don’t you swallow me alive! Yes, I am a monster! Oh, a thousand hells but with you, with you, Jesus, in the boiling basins, with you on the hard millstone! But if I am so horrible and filthy I cannot possess you!

Longing for penances. “But I am bound”

Oh, what a torment! I seek for him in the suffering that I have and at the end I do not find him. Oh, monster of a creature! With your infamy you had lost the Being of your life! If I could express of what type is this suffering! I am incapable of saying it, a thousand deaths are nothing. // I could always stay alone, I could be tortured by weeping and by dint of hooks I would satisfy my burning desire of tearing this infamous humanity. But I am bound I can do nothing more than a small chain, a discipline until bleeding and some hours flat on my face or lying on the cross weeping. But these small acts do nothing other than to increase the burning thirst for suffering.

I remember my room, my bed, my crosses, the iron pieces with which I satisfied myself. It is now three months since I rested for one hour. When oppressed by such an unhappy sight I threw myself first on one and then on the other cross, because I had no more strength // and I remained exhausted; but I was relieved.

  • Infamous blood, how much I saw flowing! – Finally you are out and you will be used to wash where you yourself did much evil!

This beast was so worn out that I felt like laughing and I was sending a thousand kisses to my Crucifix.

“I feel torn without a soul to whom I can say a word of vent: my Good alone”

Oh, I am here, I have nothing of comfort; I have a longing thirst and must remain thirsty. Patience! It is hard for me and I feel torn without a soul to whom I can say a word of vent: only my Good! But when he throws me in such a horrible state it torments and agonizes me. When he is with me, he certainly instructs me, comforts me, directs me, and when oppressed I go and tell him my sufferings. He comforts me with sweet words and comes with me to relieve me. Oh, if // all the sufferings of the earth could be loaded upon my back I would not feel them at all. The entire burden, all the tortures, the consolations, the praises which afflict me so much now, they could do nothing to me; everything would be pleasing to me. But in such profound abyss as I am, it is a horrid hell.

For the mercy of my Jesus, I asked for a bit of light or rather a bit of rest from the horrible turmoil I suffered in these days.

My poor soul was always in an abyss of darkness; now, though I did not yet find my Good, I am calm. I feel him deep in my soul because though his sight is not sensible, what I feel makes me sure that it is he. //

When I found him in the abyss of suffering I said:

  • Alas where am I? Oh, hell of the worst suffering is having lost my Good!

Oh, with you I could be submitted to undergo a thousand hells, but you my God, stay with me and do not move away. If in hell instead of the torments, there could be the most pleasing things and no sufferings, the deprivation of you, my God, could overcome all the pains even the most horrible put together.

Compassion for the sinners and the unbelievers

If I could express what I feel when I hear about an obstinate sinner, to think that he/she is at risk of being damned! Oh, unequalled suffering! To think that he/she will never see the one who shaped all the delights of heaven and earth… Yes, my Good, even down here, when one possesses you, // one is blessed even in this valley of tears;

nothing more could be desired. Creatures, why do you all run away, to give yourselves to such inferior and temporary things of this lowly earth and leave an infinite treasure!

How can I make you known my Good? How can I convert so many people who do not believe to this day? If thousand of lives of mine would be needed to be consumed drop by drop, yes, in slow fire I could be burned to obtain it. But I see myself so miserable in an abyss of infamy. Oh, Goodness of God!

The assaults and the threats of the evil one are already ended

In these days the evil serpent gave me assaults to make me fear or rather to frighten me. It said that it would take away my mind so that // I could think less and it could throw me out the window. It came with much strength.

  • Sorcerer, this time you have lost the battle!

Nothing could upset me, as it did in the past. For a long time it did not come to assault me and I thought I was free from such cruel torture. But I can say that I felt nothing. I had only laughed at its face:

  • Laughing stock, go to throw yourself in the abyss of your astuteness and leave me!

Oh, how much it sneers when I make fun of it! Go and plot another torment but my God will find the means to make me always overcome the dirty and filthy monster. In fact it did nothing other than laugh and it left me.

Oh, my dear // Good, do not ever allow me to meet such a horrible temptation!

If I remember when it fiercely assailed me, it seems I could never overcome it and many times it dragged me near a window and with a great deal of strength it pushed me! However, my Good soon came to my help and the monster left me. What a torment when it terrorized me! It was such that I do not even dare to recall it because I suffer just thinking of it even though it was long ago. If those who saw me suffer // could have realized while I said:

  • Alas, I faint! Or when I tried to stand up and I was unable. There was nothing!

My Love, you hide yourself and you were coming only when I was just at the edge of the precipice.

In these days it came when some mysterious thing was happening to me and only the eternal God and my Jesus could enlighten me. I was already calmed about something. Oh, this monster, while in that way it suggested:

  • You are damned!

At the end it took advantage of my hesitation because the things which came to me from God were very mysterious and the ugly monster put very horrible things before me and always frightened me // and upset me very much.

Today I am calm because Jesus…

Good Friday of a loving flame and of intimate union

On Good Friday, how much I suffered! But more than any suffering and torment the melancholy that came upon me was more grievous, such that I saw it was impossible for me not to be noticed. Early in the morning I went to a church where I stayed for four good hours. I was able to give vent or at least nobody could realize my state; I suffered for I needed to lie down. Not at all! I thought that was the only way to hide myself. I prayed and I strongly pleaded with my Good: listen to me for I cannot bear anymore such a cruel state!

Then I recommended an affair of mine pleading // him to take away certain very strong impulses from the side where the ribs rose such that they were breaking. The side rose and I could not stand to feel that sweet torture. Yes, it is very sweet to suffer! While I pleaded with him to take it away from me, I could not help telling him: consume me, my Good! Oh, sweetness of love, sweet and holy, indescribable All, destroy in me whatever does not please you. You are the Master, remove everything you do not like, everything!

But in the union, I felt the sweetest torture!

Reassured on what I asked for, I felt a bit relieved but as if a nail has been fixed on me // I had to make much violence in order to be able to pray so that they could not realize. It was too strong, but by the help of God I obtained everything.

“Oh, death of love, how sweet and delicious you are!”

The night of 9 April 1877, as soon as I was in my room

I turned off the big lamp and as usual I remained with the smaller one and I prepared myself to go to bed. I saw a small lamp or rather a fire moving around on one side of the room. It stayed for a while moving around and then it disappeared; other small sparks continued to move around.

I must say that some earlier evenings I saw an ugly monster, keeping in hand a kind of a spear which was coming towards me in order to kill me. Half body // (…) and the other half was in a form of a fish; it frightened me, but it did nothing to me.

I went on hoping to discover the reason for which it was so enraged.

Another night I felt much union with my God to a point that my ribs were so high that I thought I was dying under such a fierce torture:

  • Love, how strong you are! – I went on saying, when I felt such a thing and nothing more.

Yes, it is strong to a point that if my Lover would not sustain me I could die. In addition I already feel like dying when I experience this. Oh, death of love, how sweet and delicious you are!

Yes, in such a sweet union if there was a person who had the faculty to consent to our desires, if // she/he could ask what my enjoyment is I could reply: - Death!

It seems that having undergone this, one should be united with the sweetest lover from whom this pig of body keeps us separated. Oh, Love, consume me and drive away from me everything which does not please you!

How sweet it is! If the whole world could come with me to love Jesus! And if to obtain this I should give all my blood drop by drop and every drop should cost me a torment, yes, I would get to drink in order to satisfy my great desire. Love, you are my parching thirst, // because I never get satisfied, and when, when! Oh, sweetness!

Trust in the intercession of Sister Anne Vincenza

18 March 1877. In the evening, while I was alone in the church, I prayed warmly to my dear daughter Sister Anne Vincenza that she may earnestly obtain for me the grace that I desired for a long time. I placed under her protection this very interesting affair.

  • Will I get it? I asked.

She appeared to me and with her right hand she made for me a sign that it was doubtful.

  • Therefore, would anything be obtained?

But soon she made me understand that it could be obtained in a certain manner that is without restriction and in a wonderful way. She left me much consoled with a certainty that I would obtain everything, as if it was assured.

The reason she did that act was that // it would have not been obtained in that way in which I thought but it would be obtained in another way. Oh, dear daughter, you always think of your poor mother.3

A net, sign of a good wish.

Light on the mystery of the Incarnation

Night of 26 April 1877. At midnight I felt being shaken while I was sleeping. I woke up and near the ceiling a big net tied all together the way the fishermen tie it when it is dry. It was shining and it was of the same color as the white light that was reflecting upon it; it was new and very big because the volume was large:

  • Alas, my God – within me I said.

A voice said to me:

  • With this you will catch many creatures.

  • It stayed still for some minutes and then it disappeared.

Today, when I believed I was free // of any diabolic worry, what I had, my God! What a dread!

How much Satan did to tempt me fiercely, that I would lose my mind and that I was already on the way to becoming mad…

Oh, if I could express with words what torment I experienced in a subtle way until I reached the edge of fainting! What indescribable pains! Though I went through it millions of times, I still see that the way it tempts me is always different.

From a response I had on the mystery of the Incarnation, I was very upset, I remained very thoughtful and within me I said:

  • If they could explain something to me, it seems that I could understand, but as usual I answered that I am ignorant and I do not understand // anything.

However, I continued to have a great desire to know and be instructed. The next morning, absorbed in God, I started hearing:

  • Here is what you desire to know.

Oh, eternal goodness, what I heard! He explained to me the mystery of the Incarnation in such a way that certainly a human being could not express; an earthly creature could never be able either to understand or to explain; only a divine mind could do it.

While I listened everything seemed simple and easy to explain, but it was not like that. When I recovered from such sweet ecstasy I was unable to repeat what I had heard, while in my mind everything was very clear. Oh, mystery! My God satisfied my curiosity and then everything remained closed in // my mind.4

The consolation I felt was extreme and I would always remain very busy with that sweet thought and I had to struggle to distract myself so that no one could realize.

“My God, what a very sweet torment you are for me!”

While I was reading the life of my Jesus, I felt like fainting. I raised my eyes to distract myself and I saw a small star that went around the room and announced to me the death of a sister; then it disappeared.

While I write I suffer because it certainly announces to me a great affliction. What a pain, my God! He assured me that I should fear nothing. Only in him I would overcome and I would challenge the world though I have an interior suffering which I cannot explain and it seemed to me I would breathe my last at any moment.

Oh, Love, what should I say of what you make me experience? // Who would not come with you to be burned and consumed? If my bones could be of use, being consumed to make all the creatures love you! How can I do it?

Today my ribs - yes, by my Jesus – alas! They were raised much! The swelling of the side is such that I cannot stand anymore. My God, what a sweet torture you are! Embracing my Good, the Being of my life, how many beautiful instructions I receive on what I should do! Oh, my Guide, my Master! The unrest in which I found myself was such that I spent a terrible night because it seemed to me // that I had displeased my Love; I did not find peace anymore.

Horrible temptations of suicide

In the morning of the feast of the Sacred Heart, as soon as I received my Good, I remained absorbed in him and I am unable to explain what he made me feel. I remained serene, since he assured me that there was nothing bad about what I feared much. I had sustained a lively discussion for the interest of the Work, and I feared having failed because I so strongly supported my ideas. I had horrible temptations of suicide; it seemed that the monster dragged me to the precipice and I could be freed no more.5 //

How much I suffered today! Only my Good could say how intense my sufferings were; in the morning, it was the same. How willingly I could stay at his feet! Instead, he sent me away; and I was so displeased that I said: why do you send me away? You are very cruel! Yes, I obey, I go to work.

In this, yes, my Good, I could say that I had strong help; I realized it from what was being done in so little time. Only God could do that; as for myself, I am ignorant and without any knowledge.

Oh, my God, consume me soon; I am your slave!

The soul engulfed in darkness

// Date: 6 September 1876. What a night of suffering you had been for me! It is the second night in which my soul suffered sunk in darkness. I experienced the agony of death: the night was not enough; even during the day I suffered. I suffered in the midst of the affairs of every kind. My God!

I agonized for the impossibility of weeping, but I could say that I had hardly a drop of tear that wet my eyes; the headache was so strong that I thought my head would explode. Oh, torture! How much it costs me to conceal the strong melancholy: only the headache saved me so that nobody could realize the going around of the ugly beasts; on various night // they tormented me taking away my sleep. Alas, they presented themselves always in new shapes, so ugly, frightful, presage of bad events. My God, how painful to know they announce sad things, painful afflictions and not to know what they are!

This is what pleases my God, having told me more than once the reason for which he does not allow it; he only wants me to be happy to know that those ugly spirits stand for what they plot to make me suffer and to oppress and trouble the Work of the Lord.

MS 4.5 – 1 – 23

Vision of Jesus carrying the Cross

21 June 1877. At nine in the evening, after having suffered for the whole day and being exhausted I was lying on my back on my poor bed. Jesus of Nazareth appeared to me with his cross on his shoulders, crowned with thorns and with his hands bound.

He looked at me as he hardly took some steps as he did when he climbed on Calvary; I remained amazed. Alas, he disappeared quickly and I exclaimed:

  • What could this mean?

I got nothing and I remained in between cheerfulness and sadness, but I felt much more strength.

My God, unfortunately crosses are not missing in your Work. I feel the cross for my children heavy and painful;

although that of your Work is certainly heavier. //

Vision of Our Lady: “I came from the Vatican”

July 1877. Before midnight, while asleep I was shaken and as I opened my eyes I saw a lady clothed all in white. I knew her immediately from the light that emanated: she was Mary, my Mother. She had a white veil that covered her head, face, and the upper body.

I heard an interior voice saying this:

  • I came from the Vatican.

I understood well but I cannot write anything else.

Seeing her covered in that way I felt pain and as she left I thought and I said:

  • What would she mean?

Oh, my Mother, are my sins which prevent me from seeing you unveiled in your face? //

But not! In these days I saw clearly what my God ordered to be done by his slave. Oh, Love! How much the bones of my ribs rose! My God, for charity’s sake!

A Sister freed from an evil spirit

I saw clearly, I could say as if I had in my hands a spirit that dominated one of our sisters and my God freed her through an order of the spiritual father. In this way she was freed from her illness. Oh, how that evil spirit roared! But my Good told me that she was still tormented in different ways and to tell the priest to order that evil one to let her free. It had no power to hide from me. This was what I did and after she suffered for // some hours she was completely free. Oh, how it tormented her!

I who saw clearly what it was doing felt pity. I cannot be silent on what it did to me out of anger; for two nights it seemed to throttle me. Oh, what pains! It seemed to me that I would drown, my God!

A sister with the crown of martyrdom of her own will

The night of the eight of August, while I rested serenely, I felt shaken and as I opened my eyes I saw the soul of a sister that had just breathed her last in that moment; she flew to heaven and she had a crown of martyrdom. Soon I was given to understand what kind of martyrdom she suffered, that of her own will, to a point of sacrificing // her own life not to manifest her suffering, fearing her capacity to sacrifice herself for God.

Beautiful soul, you are now blessed in your spouse! I asked her for a grace as a proof of what I saw and I was granted it.

Yesterday afternoon I was feeling so worn out that I had to lie down and while I was in the room, thousands of clouds crossed around me. When this ended – and they were spirits of hell – certain small beasts appeared to me so disemboweled that their bodies were loosened. My God, whatever // might signify! I already presage a bad and grave affliction.

A deceased holy Cardinal, “protector of providence”

In these days I experienced many things, but because of lack of time I was never able to write and that is why I fear not saying or writing correctly what I saw and felt.

Since some days have passed, I will say only what happened to me in these days because of a soul which stayed always before me and it was that of a Cardinal. I had promised to make Communion for him fifteen times if he would obtain for me large providence; I was in much need.

I asked for a sum and I obtained it but not being satisfied I asked for another one // promising that I would receive

Holy Communion for him for the whole month; and I was granted again. I promised to say rosaries for another one and again, and I obtained it. He was a saint and I took him as a protector for providence.

I felt arid and I suffered much for having my Good no longer with me. I searched for him, but I felt only horrible sufferings.

She was caught in ecstasy as she received sacramental absolution

On 12, while I confessed, I wanted to be tightly united with my Good while he washed me with his blood. I thought that for many years, during this gesture of absolution I was always obliged to distract myself // so that they might not realize that I remain absorbed; because I do not feel and I remain in ecstasy.

There I remained in him, but for the Lord’s mercy it was for a minute and I soon turned away and I understood nothing; I did not hear even the penance. I shook while the priest closed the door and I went away very confused. I felt much consolation after being for many days under the burning iron of tribulations. I always found myself before an abyss of despair as if there was nothing for me, // nothing that could save me. Oh, a thousand hells would not seem as sorrowful as having lost my Good. Oh, suffering, you are nothing in comparison to the remoteness of my God!

A rain of half-lit lamps

For two evenings I had a thousand disturbances in my room. On one side big and small beasts started strolling; I saw a small green one. I felt like laughing; what would that mean?

For some days I have been so sad that within me I feel // an agony of death.

Date: 20 October 1877. After some time in the church, a rain of half-lit lamps came around my face, a span far from my eyes. Immediately I felt so much consolation that it seemed to me they came to relieve me of the affliction in which I was plunged. I seemed to be in a precipice and there was no remedy for me.

What these dear small lamps left in me I do not know; but I was left serene and all the fears disappeared.

“My Good, acts in a way that no human person ever realizes anything”

I continue on the same date: 20-21 October. As I continued, the side of my heart was // more swollen and frightened me that it stayed swollen for entire days; my ribs seemed of rubber. Alas, if creatures could see what I suffer, even those inhuman could feel pity. There are moments in which, if I do not turn away with struggle, going around and speaking of uninteresting things, it could take me to infatuation; maybe I could not hide as I do but I would need to stay for hours and hours in the room and certainly I could not do the affairs of the Work.

My Good, you have always kept the agreement because you are the only // unchangeable Being, and made in a way that no person could realize. I am sure of obtaining all the caresses and that sweet union which is something of paradise; but he promised me that the world would never realize. I always felt obliged to make everything so that they would not realize. What I feel when my ribs rise, Love!

Notice of the deadly sickness of her son

Date: 3 November 1877. While I meditated in bed I drowsed, and in the spirit I saw a friar of St. Francis of

Assisi telling me:

  • Your son is sick and he will die; your prayer will be granted. It was true // that many times I prayed that the

Lord would take him rather than his leading a bad life, since the suffering would be very much if he would continue to offend my God.

  • A holy man and a Christian or take him – I had said.

The words: - He will die – made me cry – I also die!

The sorrow was such that I cannot express; I opened my eyes: - Alas! - I exclaimed.

Before me, I saw a bright star, half-moon shaped. In the middle there were many small lamps which seemed to have a dark body, and from the same light came out.

  • Alas, therefore, will he die? // Is that his star? Oh, pity, my God! If you had much charity in granting my request, change the sentence so that he lives and is holy in the faith.

My reception of Communion was all for him and I always prayed my Good that he may change the judgment.

  • Cancel it, make of him a saint! Alas, what did I do!6

I returned to the previous decision:

  • You had better take him rather than letting him offend you!

However, I feared much that star would not be his but…

  • Alas, your Work, my God!

I had nothing certain but I had // much fear.

Anxieties and figures of night

They are many nights that the ugly monster does not let me sleep: it appears first with noises, and then with a thousand jokes. It comes in one shape, then in another. Finally it tries to frighten me in many ways; it shakes me and there it is, a span away from my person in a 40 cm. high column of wood. It was seated crouching on the top. I could not help laughing and then it stood straight always on that wood. I hardly wanted to order it to leave in the name of the Lord, but first I had in mind to ask as usual who it was and what it wanted. As soon as it realized that I had that thought it fell down // and it was not seen anymore.

Another time it came before me in a shape of a buffalo with two very long horns. It would be very tedious if I had to describe all the shapes of these ugly, filthy animals. My God!

Mortal agony for every sister who dies

One night, towards half past three, I was shaken and what was it? A big light, very beautiful, stayed for a few minutes and then disappeared. I suffered much for the death of a Sister. Oh, if they could feel what I feel; it is a true agony!

It seems as if my soul is cut off from the body; how many agonies I suffered for every one who died! // I am obliged to suffer agony for my bad example and my infamies. How painful that moment, in which the soul separates from the body! It is an indescribable torment.

A beautiful white bird, carrier of peace

While I prayed in the church, after the sisters went out following the rosary, I saw passing before my eyes a beautiful bird; it had meat-colored wings and a white body.

It left peace and much serenity within me. I must say that I was much upset by some doubts of conscience and more so for the aridity in which I was; I feared it was caused by something that I had committed. Although I did a great deal of examination, I did not find anything. //

I say nothing, though I am an abyss of infamy, but the darkness in which I was did not allow me to discern my iniquity.

I had another vision in my room: while I prepared myself to go to bed, I saw before me a flame, as a fire which disappeared.

Every night it really tries to torment me, first in one way and then in another way. But my Good never stops consoling me.

“Mary, Mary! You are my life!”

For many years I did not see the Blood in the exposed

Host, in the Venerable; but in the novena of the

Immaculate on the fourth day, how abundant and in big drops I saw it. // What I felt, I cannot express; the joy was so much that I had to be careful not to be noticed.

On the night of the feast of the Immaculate or rather the eve before the feast, Mary, what a sweet night! I spent it completely with her. My meditation was so beautiful… I had such insight on her Immaculate Conception that I was feeling inebriated; I delighted as do the hearts of the blessed. Oh, who could explain and put them into writing?

I am unable, though I keep them all one by one engraved in my intellect.

Mary! Mary! You are my life; ask your servant, for she will //always, always obey you!

Beasts and night ghosts

In those nights I had many beasts: one was of a various colors and it seemed to have a beautiful cloth but without light. This one stayed longer, maybe to deceive me and make me think that it was something from God. But soon, for the mercy of my God, I realized that the beast was dark. Satan, what do you intend to do?

As soon as I said this it fell out the window; then two more black as charcoal and furious threw themselves down the precipice through a door.

Towards four in the morning I saw a // serpent over a stove near the bed; it jumped and it was like a fire. While it jumped I mocked it and it disappeared. Oh, it was so enraged.

Jesus opens his side for her and pours the honey of his love

I feared having committed a fault, for a thought I had, and not being able to confess immediately I suffered much, though what I did was not something dishonest. In the same way I had concern about another affair that it might not be the will of God, but illusion. My Good did not delay to comfort me and he gave me much sweetness opening his side for me and it seemed to me inside this heart of his // the sweetest honey of love was pouring.

Oh, my side, how it has swollen! My ribs! Oh, Love, why do you pour so many graces into such a perverse creature? Oh, yes, I am disgraceful but you are my master. Do and undo in your servant as it pleases you. I have no more tastes, no more pleasures. I have only you and for you I live; for you and in you I desire to die.

He showed and made me feel certain small things which did not please him and by his help I did away with them immediately. Oh, sweet and loving reproaches of a // delicate and loving spouse!
