MS 4.5 – pp. 23-77

The first grace of the year 1878 that Mother Rosa entrusted to the notebook was the news she had from superior light or by telepathic captivation, the death of Pius IX which took place on February 7 of that year. “Oh, dear saint – she exclaimed – it was only you who gave life to your poor daughter in the holy Institute!”

An interior climate of optimism and of trust in the future of the Work of God pervades the notes of 1878. The Lord favored her with a series of symbolic visions which strengthened her hope in spite of a certain foreboding of the proximity of her death. A first vision predicts on the future triumph of the Church; a second one regards the beautiful gathering of the flowers and fruits which the Institute will produce. In another one the Virgin Mary spread her arms on the head of the Foundress to console her. The vision of a young handsome gardener, who cultivated majestic cypresses, was meaningful. She asked him for some but she was given this answer: “I will give you another time, because these have grown very quickly and they are not for you; they must grow slowly; I do not have them yet.” This was a clear allusion to the rapid growth of the Institute, about the solidity of which some doubted. This is to be connected with the remark of a “pastor” which Mother Rosa put in the book of Travagli e comforti (p. 393): “You are going too fast; I compare these fields to the pumpkin plant…” Interesting also was the vision of a slip knot of rings tied together, the meaning of which she understands some days later from St. Anne. On August 23, not in a vision but in a communication during an ecstasy, Jesus showed her the joyful future of the Institute.

Though Mother Rosa did not hint anything, the repeated theme of the rapid expansion of the Institute was connected with the expansion of the Daughters of St. Anne towards the American continent. On 20 November 1878 the first expedition of 16 missionaries left for Bolivia. But it could be said that as usual she ignores such an event; when she took the notebook again, she narrated more the happenings of the experiences of her life hidden in God. Oh, if she could put on paper all that she experienced in the divine communications! But she did not find time to write and every now and then on this account she received a sweet reproach from the Lord.

Infused news of the death of Pius IX

The evening in which Pius IX died, I was in Spello. At half past five, I was in the church; I felt a tightening in my breast:

  • My God – I exclaimed – who is dying?

But the matter was brief. At the end of the supper I was in my room with two sisters and I started to feel the pain again:

  • Alas, my God, who is dying? Who could be?

I knew there were sick sisters; in my mind I thought about each one of them and I did not understand anything. I stopped and I was already seeing some small stars passing before me but when I lay down, I saw a big one; it disappeared and then a big light and in its midst there was a person. The light was not white but like a fire or something similar. //

It stayed stationary for a while and it communicated to me something of paradise; I started praying and meditating.

  • Oh, soul dear to God, tell me: who are you?

But I understood nothing; only the act of rising left me something which cannot be expressed.

The next day they told me:

  • Pope Pius IX is dead.1

Oh, dear saint! Even departing from this world you wanted to give the last farewell to you poor daughter! It was only you who gave her life in the holy Institute.

I cannot describe what these days left in me. The small stars are still around me // but this is a clear sign that they announce to me the death of the sisters.

“It Always seems to me that everyday should be the last of my life”

Today Friday, how much pain I felt in my hands! My side was very swollen, my God! Oh, everyday I could say with truth that this donkey is subjected to new torments; it seems to me every day should be the last of my life but suffering for my Love is sweet.

I am alive; I go on saying this many times when I feel tortured the whole night. In the morning I repeat: - I am alive!

That I am alive seems to me unbelievable. After being assailed by certain pains, I am still alive. //

Notice of the death of a priest

It is now a long time since I have seen the ugly beasts.

Having no time to write, I cannot be precise on many things. For this reason I leave them aside.

This morning, 17 February 1878, while I was giving thanks for the Holy Communion, a skeleton appeared to me; on its head it had a circular cape of a priest which was uncovered but I was unable to identify him. He seemed to be someone very interesting to me but though I asked who he was I never got a reply. He stayed for a long time and came close to me:

  • Who are you, dear soul?

He replied nothing. At first I did not feel sorrow // but later on, at the thought that he could be the person hinted at above, I felt very sad and I did not know where to find peace. My God, this is too strong!

I prayed and I was very united to my Good. I asked him whose that soul was, but I got no answer. What a pain!

A badly advised superior wants to pass to another institute

The night of 22 February 1878: as soon as I lay down, after some minutes a beast with long legs and almost without a body strolled at the back of the bed on the iron. What could this be, my God? It was a long time since I had seen such a beast; who could it be?

Upset in this way, it seemed I could sleep a bit. // But I was shaken again and another beast bigger and with fewer legs was at the back of the bed in the air. I had hardly formed the thought to ask who it was, that it fell down on the same side in which the other one went. It left me badly upset and I was disturbed; a dark presage came to my mind, something grave seemed to be taking place and in fact I was not mistaken.

Whom did I see the next day? A superior, who after receiving much good, was seduced by a priest, disrupted the school and // wanted to retire immediately to another Institute. Later she realized that it was a diabolic seduction. After some minutes in this situation – I mean after the beasts had passed – slowly I felt united with my God and I remained fully absorbed in him.

Prevision of the future triumph of the Church

I saw and – in order to explain I will say this – it seemed to be a large and dark tunnel and a gallery that seemed to have no end; it was very dark. Outside the opening, seated on the ground with its legs crossed, I saw a devil and a multitude of people who as soon as they reached the opening of this precipice seemed to be // swallowed. It was a flash for those who were thrown down and I felt tightening in my soul. As soon as this vision vanished I found myself at the entrance of a beautiful garden where a great many flowers were found.

On the right side there was a big basket with numberless beautiful flowers and I had never seen such gracious and bright ones.

Just looking at them delighted me and what I was feeling was such that I was shaken and I remained inebriated…

  • My God, tell me, what does this mean?

  • The dark passage is hell, // but it was not enough; that passing from one place to another which was heaven was not meant to show you first one and then the other, no, but it will be like that. The abyss in which the world is found now will be changed in a moment and the triumph of the

Church will come.

Everything ceased and I remained very happy; after some time I slept. But in the morning, when I woke up, a dark melancholy took control of me so that I had to make much effort in order not to be realized and this cost me much.

A beautiful basket full of magnificent flowers held in the air

I could say I spent the day in this way, but I was able to retire a bit in the church and with this I was relieved. //

After lunch, when I was in the church, I was upset. I was feeling not only melancholy but I was seeing there was something preventing me from being united. My God, what will it be?

There was a small beast strolling on the banisters; what does it mean, my Good?

As usual I understood nothing. I prayed and I could say that I spent the night in that way. I slept a bit but a slight shaking woke me up. There was a beautiful basket in the air full of every type of magnificent flowers, // so beautiful that I cannot describe the colors.

There were so many flowers that they were falling all around and hanging down on the basket. Oh, it was beautiful, graceful! The basket stayed for a while so that I was able to observe it well, and then it rose and vanished. What would it mean? Perhaps I had finished gathering those flowers which Jesus wanted and it is time for me to rest? I understood nothing, neither about the garden I saw nor of the basket which was near the entrance of the garden, which was so beautiful. It also had many beautiful flowers, some hanging down // even outside the basket.

Dear Good, why don’t you ever give me an explanation? It is true that you told me the reason, but I am not satisfied. I would like to know something. My side is very swollen and the poor ribs… Love! Love, you are killing me! How sweet to suffer for you, my Good!

It is true that in these days my suffering has reached its peak, but I will never say enough.

“My dear loving spouse, only you, only for you to suffer and to love”

Yesterday night, as soon as I lay down, it seemed to me that a very strong man pressed my head on // the pillow and it was so forceful that I felt pain. I was obliged to wake up because I could not bear it.

  • Oh, enemy of hell, how you bring me so many disruptions to oppress me and to frighten me!

This is one of those very hard strong troubles that truly has some effect on the body; someone that has no experience of this astuteness of hell could certainly say:

  • I have some kind of illness that makes breathing difficult.

But for God’s mercy, I know this dragon well; therefore, // tired of suffering, I signed myself and started to pray. It then disappeared.

Oh, my Savour Jesus, my dear loving spouse, you only, only for you to suffer and to love!

If I should speak of the suffering I undergo from morning to evening, my God! Starting from my hands, especially the one with which I write, that swells and the pain many times oblige me not to continue. Even one arm torments me, the // one on which I have the big scar.

Vision of Mary who extends her arms in a consoling manner

Night of 28 February 1878. I was very afflicted because of a certain ugly affair that I saw. I was suffering much but I still waited for another consequence and I could suffer much more, as it actually happened. While I struggled to pray, though I struggled much, I was unable to gather myself.

But suddenly something came upon me and I was out of myself. Mary appeared to me. Oh, sweet Mother! She extended her arms in a consoling manner:

  • Mary - this was what I said - // What does this mean?

Do you not tell me anything?

I hardly said this when she disappeared. She left me very strengthened.

  • Oh, I well understand. You, my dearest Mother, have come to give me strength to be able to sustain the many and painful tribulations that torment me!

Oh, yes, the help of my dearest Mother did not delay. If

I was not fortified by such a powerful hand, I could have not resisted other tribulations.

One day I had some kind of respite. I say respite // and not without tribulations but tribulations that were less strong and atrocious.

A vision of a garden: the trees “must grow slowly”

For two days, especially yesterday evening there has been a small star moving around the room. That is another notice of a dead sister.

I do not remember having written this beautiful vision which I will put concisely without narrating the details but only what remained engraved in my mind.

There was a handsome young man cultivating a beautiful garden where there were cypresses already a meter high. I asked for some and he agreed but // seeing that I was never given any, I returned to ask again. He then said:

  • I will give you another time, because these grew very quickly and they are not yet for you; they must grow slowly.2

Later he made me understand what they symbolized and what they meant.

“Oh, loved Cross, you are the bed of my Good!”

How many tribulations I have had on these days! Oh, my God, This pig of my body wanted to throw me to the ground! Oh, loved cross, you are the bed of my Good where he left his fresh blood! Oh, Love, who are in it!

My Jesus // gave me much strength to carry it tight on my breast.

Today, 28 March 1878, my side was so big! I suffered much in writing the whole day. My hand which is swollen from the pain, gave me spasms to a point that there were moments in which I struggled to keep the pen in my hand. Jesus, it is for you!

I was in a location where I feared I could have certain demonstrations. I entrusted myself to the Holy Mother St. Anne that she might not allow it because I suffered much. Oh, good Mother, what did she do? She arranged for // a secretary to be brought for me. What a consolation I felt!

My God, you promised me that everything that you place and do in me would be hidden. Yes, my Good, I suffer too much! I have no consolation other than when they believe I am not so good. Oh, yes, I am an infamy and whatever I have that is beautiful is yours, my Good, dear object of my life.

“To suffer and not to die would be my choice”

For several days a shade dark as charcoal has appeared to me; it stays for a while and then it vanishes. // The first times

I did not bother but later I asked my Good to let me understand who it was and what it meant since I was thinking of someone who lived a bad life. Instead he made me understand that I would have certain shades towards someone for certain things which belonged to my spirit. In fact, what sufferings I went through for certain things which

I did not understand! Oh, what I suffered! After a long pain my Good consoled me and I remained serene. My God, so much goodness for such a miserable // creature!

Other small stars continued to appear moving around me and even this year it seems that many sisters will die; perhaps not like last year but who knows because if the small stars continue to appear certainly the Holy Mother wants many.

Today I had more news of my death. Oh, what a sweet life dying is! But to suffer and not to die would be my choice because I would be sad not to suffer anymore, but you are too beautiful, death!

I feel something in me as if great and beautiful things will take place in the Work. //

In a soul I saw that the sickness was caused by that ugly rag of hell and I hope to see her/him soon liberated.

In these days I was much comforted and I found myself fully with God. Now I know whose that skull of the dead is which I saw a month ago, while I received Holy Communion from the hands of our Cardinal. Now I saw on the breast of P. A. a stripe of fire large as a hand but I did not understand anything.

Vision of a group of rings knotted together

Date: 9 April 1878. Yesterday evening, at eleven, I felt shaken; at the back of my bed half a meter high from the iron, there was a group of rings. The first ring // was big and joined together with many others with a small thread which reached the ceiling; everything even the rings were all white alabaster. Seeing that they did not move I woke up and sat on the bed and tried to take them. While I was extending my hand the rings were raised up and vanished. I lay down and started thinking; certainly I was not to give any meaning other than that the affairs of the Work were to be entangled.

In fact I slept with much difficulty. // I did not understand the tangle. I must say that I prayed much to my Jesus, that he may let me know the meaning and I said:

  • My God, I plead you not to send me anymore visions without revealing to me their meaning, because I suffer much.

Immediately a voice said to me:

  • Remember what I told you: if I could show you clearly the meaning of these apparitions you would not be able to sustain the suffering. In this way you are prepared and ready to face them.

Always, uncertain, what a night // my God!

Night of 9 April 1878. As soon as I went to bed, I wanted to resist strongly certain orders, fearing they might not come from God. I battled for many days and nights. The visions of nine April struck me so strongly that I suffered tribulations and horrible sufferings. I struggled until morning and at the end I had to call and soon receive Holy Communion because I was dying from the anxiety. But immediately after receiving Holy Communion, alas, I could not stand anymore; then I said to my Good that I would submit myself to do what he wanted. //

“I started praying for my persecutors”

May 1878. I can say that from the first day until today 27 has been a continuous martyrdom. The afflictions of Florence were so entangled3 and in addition to that I was feeling held tight by something which I do not know, I had difficulty in praying, and was without any comfort. One night while I was lying down there was a big beast but I hardly saw it before it disappeared in the wall. I felt terrible shaking; when I was oppressed and wherever I turned my head I was feeling terrible pricking. One evening I threw myself with my face down to the ground and I prayed:

Eternal Father, come to my help!

A voice said to me:

  • Soon all the // persecutions will end.

Oh, Father, my love, command Satan to retire!

I heard it roaring as a lion and falling down; I took courage and I said:

  • Everything will be overcome.

I started to pray for my persecutors and this pleased

God and Blessed Mary very much. This act of mine assured me that I would be victorious.

Today I have been taken by a melancholy of death; my side was very swollen and from that day, Friday 24 of the current month, I was freed from aridity.

Though very tired I did not have any scruple about staying face down on the ground; the union was so much that when standing up I felt my side very swollen as it is still. //

However, I always have some hours in which the swelling goes down. My God, if it could continue without interruption I would surely die. My ribs! Love!

My Good assured me regarding a doubt I had and gave me peace. In these days I have seen the head of a dead person. My God, who could it be? I also had other terrible afflictions caused by the sisters, but I had hardly turned my eyes to Jesus and to the Eternal Father than I was feeling such resignation that I remained absorbed.

Oh, you the only Being of my life! Beloved love, I could say

I am at the peak of every tribulation but the most torturing ones are those caused by the sisters. Oh, how much Judas made you suffer, my God! //

St. Anne explained to her the vision of 9 April 1878

Yesterday evening, 28 of the current, while I was reciting the rosary, I was caught by something towards the Holy Mother St. Anne, my Mother.

While I was very absorbed a voice said to me:

  • Remember what you saw that night; that loop which had many knots which was hard to untie. It seemed totally entangled, but later the knots were all loosened. Only the last ones remained semi-tied and then everything vanished.

  • Oh, my Mother – I exclaimed – unfortunately…

As she said this, it seemed to me she spread out in my mind that vision but for the last which I did not see untied:

  • What will it be? – I asked.

  • God will loose those ones. //

I cannot explain what those words brought to me, while I was sure that everything would end up well.

My God, to such a base and abject creature, much mercy!

“For me everything is finished! I do not find my God”

While I was in the church I saw many small lamps and it seemed as if they were coming to me to ask for something.

I said:

  • Beloved souls, what do you want? I will offer my poor prayer to relieve you

As I said this they disappeared. Oh, how much light I received these days! This morning the noise they made in my room was such that I had to wake up because they were knocking down the wall. They started at three o’clock, a strong beating and then…

For eight days I have been under a terrible trial; for me everything is finished, I do not find // my God anymore.

An agony of death continued for me in the midst of the sisters and the outsiders. I had to make terrible violence so that they might not realize my state. Only when I let slip something with my secretary, what pain for the noise that I make! But I try to speak of other things because I feel griped under two big loads. Alas, I am damned! In another moment I am no longer able to stand on my feet; I run to the room and I throw myself on the cross. The day before yesterday I stayed on it for two hours but how much I suffered! My God is not pleased even with these sufferings.

// Therefore I am lost, will I see him anymore?

Temptation to give up receiving Holy Communion

I feel nothing except a dark oppression which announces to me a sad event. In this way I have a restlessness that drives away sleep and I eat with such difficulty that it is a real martyrdom to think of the hour of food. At night, I pray but

I am arid and dry which consume me; it seems like centuries because daytime never comes. Now I wake up and I stroll. I search for the one I do not find, but as soon as I discipline myself until bleeding, I remain exhausted not able to stand on my feet. I fear that I may faint and then // I would not be able to receive Holy Communion in the morning.

In this anguish the devil whispered to me saying that I am committing sacrileges, that it would be better that I leave it.

For 26 or 27 years I have received it, every day. In long journeys I could fast up to three days. Jesus in his mercy sustained me and I was able to receive my Communion, my only comfort.

Between one Communion and the next I remained without food, because I was not able to stop, and what my companion had was meat. Feeling // satisfied I said:

  • I do not need food now, this evening when we reach such a place I will eat.

But we arrived at midnight and in this way: Jesus, what consolation I was feeling! Oh, what sweet conversation I had!

But now I am an abyss of infamy, because I have nothing but continuous tortures and I am strongly tempted not to receive Communion anymore. Does it mean that I have been good for 21 years and was able to receive him even if unworthily but without sacrilege? What about now? Alas! When this thought takes over at night I would destroy myself with beating this rotten body. It seems to me that I would cut it into pieces. //

What spasms this ass carries! It seems as if the lungs are detached and in the morning I drag myself; these poor creatures who see me so swollen believe it is all physical illness. In reality it is because the flesh swells and the lungs… Oh, what pains I carry, I drag myself with difficulty! And yet I do not please my Good; I have displeased him. What did I do? What if I have always been disgraceful and never good?

“Jesus tells me nothing; I am in a deep dark abyss”

Today, for having written much, my hand pains; the sufferings I felt were new.

Alone on this earth // I go on studying the reason on my own; I throw myself face down to the ground and I cry as a girl. Oh, dear Beloved, tell me what I should do? I do not know how to bear the afflictions which are now in your Work and I am abandoned by all. Under the cruelest martyrdom you also leave me and at the end there are such moments of despair that I cannot do other than give vent with penances. The side of my heart is so dull and my bones feel so strange that I throw myself to the ground. Oh, when I stand up it seems that I have broken them all! //

Every now and then certain things appear whose meaning I do not understand. Jesus tells me nothing. I am in a deep dark abyss, in darkness.

The day before yesterday in the evening after midnight, it might have been a quarter of an hour after I fell asleep, I felt shaken; at the back of the bed. I saw a bottomless basket, but made in a new shape. The top seemed not yet finished but it was dark. It started moving and it reached near my head. // It stopped and I was able to see the dark interior side because it had a prolonged shape. It oppressed me to such a point that I was not able to say anything; as soon as it moved, I asked my God for the meaning but I got nothing. From the sufferings and the anxiety I understood it must be something serious that will happen in such a way that it will oppress me. I was not able to sleep anymore and the melancholy was increasing and an oppression of death.

How much I felt and still feel tormented by anxiety! I do not know what to say for they were pains of hell, the most terrible, not finding the only object // of my life and having lost him because of my dark infamy. I am alone! Alone! He who led me was my Good, Jesus. Oh, Eternal Father!

Where are you, my Jesus?

Night anxieties. Vision of two vines full of bunches of grapes

Night of 15 current month. Oh, how many beasts!

Everyone was different from the other. At the beginning there was one at the back of the bed, a big one, rather all legs – it had a good number of them – it fell from the top of the wall of the room. After some minutes, there was another beast, black with short and few legs but big, darker and heavier. It rose with difficulty.

And yet I know the meaning. The other one had an improper shape that made a horrible impression and I was upset // in mind even the following day. It rose a bit and it disappeared inside the wall.

My God, will it finish? In this way praying I hoped to sleep, when other small ones appeared again. All were together like bees and they threw themselves out the window. Therefore, within me I said – this night will it not end? I slept a bit, then woke up oppressed by a sad melancholy of death. I remained that way until morning.

Oh, suffering, you are very dear to me, but torturing to a point that I recommended my soul. I woke up because I was no longer able to stay in bed; // I went to the church. Meditation started after some time. I was arid, dry as a trunk; therefore I was lost!

Finally the hour of Holy Communion arrived. Being very sad, I almost threw myself to receive my God. Oh, I am not worthy, alas! But after some minutes I found myself so united to my Jesus and I was absorbed in him.

He showed me two trees: one was very big and it had many big bunches of grapes. Then there was the other one, with branches which were twisted around the tree which had big grapes. Even the branches of this had grapes. I came to my senses, after staying for a while to observe such beautiful trees and the interweaving of such magnificent grapes which I always keep before my eyes. Jesus consoled me and I remained serene. //

Oppressed by the thought of being damned

July 1878.Who could ever describe what I felt and suffered! To have lost God, to be damned! The discouragement I felt was such that there were hours in which the tribulations submerged me. Ah, what a sad sea where I found myself!

My only comfort was to throw myself to the ground. My God, pity! If those who are with me could see my state, they would be frightened.

What are the slanders, the persecutions, and the unrest! Oh, nothing in comparison to the fact of not having God!

The abyss of my wickedness is such that I do not know which creature… //

Reproach of the Lord for not having written

Having been very busy I was not able to write for a long time. Every now and then I felt a sweet reproach but it did not bring me pain because I replied with a long lament. He kept me oppressed in the affairs of his Work. With an indescribable anxiety, I could say that my lament is continuous:

  • Oh, my Good, why am I always under a very heavy yoke? It is enough, dear Jesus!

It is better I do not speak of this because a thousand fears and an abyss // of thoughts crowd my mind putting me in such anguish that I feel strangled and many times I cannot bear it.

Much suffering for the lack of good spirit of some superiors

What agony and horrible torture I felt five days ago! At the end the suffering was such that I agonized. Most of the suffering was as a result of realizing little good spirit in certain superiors who were present here in the Spiritual

Exercises. Oh, their hearts were too much anchored to their obstinate bad habits; in addition to this it seems that at the moment they realized their shortcomings, but soon they fell again because they did not put an effort // to remove from their hearts that much confirmed pride, murmuring and selfishness. Oh, what I felt when I saw one clothed with a white veil and inside the heart there was black and filth!

Oh, most beloved Jesus, how many wounds you receive! If

I suffered so much what could have been your suffering!

What might your offended heart suffered!

I will not speak at length about the beasts since more or less they are always the same. For two months, they have tormented me // and they do not have bad shapes. They have big or small bodies with long clutches and they do not even annoy me with fears or strong din as in the past.

In an ecstasy the Lord showed her the happy future of the Work

Night of 23 August 1878. Oh, what I felt! I slept after prayer and I woke up after some time, at least that was what it seemed to me; and half-asleep I prayed. I felt so united with my Good that I woke up and it was an ecstasy. Oh, what paradise I experienced! My Good took away the anguish in which I was for anxieties I felt for having done bad // things. He gave me peace and he instructed me on many beautiful things giving me lights to lead and to send sisters from one part to another, sisters who were able to handle different offices. He showed me beautiful things on the future of the Work. He was much pleased by my suffering. I do not speak of my side because it rose up in such a way that, my bones!

For three days it is swollen and I feel something which I cannot describe.

During the meditation and at Holy Communion, I had much union. Oh, // Love, you make me languish! You are sweet to me but this sweetness of yours frightens me because of the pain you have prepared for me. Enough! Give me strength to bear everything that I may not lose even a sip of suffering but that I may swallow without losing a drop. Suffering, you torture me but your essence is very sweet.

Afflictions and fears; given peace by Jesus

28 November 1878. After a long period of time in which I did not write – because of the immense occupations today I have just a minute // to dedicate to my Good. The afflictions, the tribulations of every kind seem now to be about to drown me. Oh, in what kind of melancholy was my soul sunk! There were moments in which it was in agony.

At night beasts of every kind in a thousand shapes woke me up. One appeared on one side. As it vanished another one appeared in a new shape and it threw itself on the other side of the room. I heard roaring and another shaking. I seemed to be dying and immediately I grasped my Good and with acts of contrition // I entrusted my soul to him.

I feared a great deal regarding an affair which made me suffer much. I started praying but no light came that could explain to me what I wanted.

I started weeping though I was without tears and I said to my Good: why do you leave me so much in the dark? I cannot bear it, help me! Oh, sweet Jesus, my beloved Love!

Soon he said to me:

  • Do not be afflicted, because it is like this.

He told me everything about the affair. Oh, how happy

I was and he left me serene that I thought no more about that affair. I was certain // that it happened the way he said.

Vision of a lamp with unlighted wick

The other evening, rather the other night, while I was lying down it seemed to me that I was already sleeping. I was shaken and as I opened my eyes I saw a lamp which was on high and it had a big wick but unlighted. Oh, what would it mean? For five minutes it remained stationary; then it rose and vanished. It left me very thoughtful: my God, tell me what it means. Perhaps is it me who let my lamp go out?

A thousand thoughts went through my mind. I did not know what to say. But in the morning when I had my Good within me, how much pleading // I made so that he might deign to reveal it to me. I only heard a word:

  • It remained without oil and it went out.

  • Did it burn much? - I added – oh, my Good, is it mine?

  • No – he answered.

He gave me enlightenment and I understood to whom it belonged. I was serene.

For 15 days I did not see beasts, but my strong, concern that I am the obstacle for the betterment of the Work of God made me to be controlled by an extraordinary and violent power.

I was told:

  • Run away in the desert; go where nobody can find you.

And it told me the means; in addition it tried many ways to discourage me and it tightened my soul.

  • Look, you will become like that lamp you saw; retire and with your // scourging consume you life. If you will do that, you will have great things. *

If I could write what it did and said to me, it would need months and months, but for the mercy of my Beloved when I find myself in certain fierce moments, then he comes to my help and in this way I have been serene for some days.

But in this novena in honor of dear Mary, the temptations reached such a point that there were moments in which I felt I had put them into execution already.

In addition to this I was deprived of any spiritual relief. // Everything was an abyss of sufferings and of pain; without light, in the dark; I had not a word of comfort.

My Beloved has gone, I said like the bride of the Sacred Canticle.

The tribulations of the Work were without compare and then my son… Oh, what a torment I experienced! Only my quiet room was - I do not say of relief but of refuge - to gather my tears and give vent.

The torments I lived I am not able to express, the cross of iron which I carry holding tightly in my breast… My God!

MS 4.5 – pp. 77-150

A year of journeys and of much activity, it does not allow Mother Rosa to update her intimate notes. Once she said to have taken them again after an interruption of forty days. Earlier she wrote: “For two months I have not had a minute to write and now, how could I ever speak about all the graces and sufferings and about what I saw?” She referred to putting into writing what took place in her hidden life, because the greatest part of her day was dedicated to the correspondence with the Daughters of St. Anne, in spite of the continued pain in her right hand: “ If the creatures could feel how much I suffer and spasm in writing! And yet, my Good, by now it is my duty…”

Everything that she experiences secretly is more or less what we already know: nights of sweet union with God followed by fearful suggestions in which she felt “damned” without remedy; comforting visions, signs of notice of the death of a sister of the Institute, burnings of love which provoked the swelling on the side of her heart, night ghosts, violent intimate battles and terrible experiences of losing God: a torment superior to any other…

As Foundress she had the consolation of receiving the decree of definitive approval of the Institute, signed on April 21, 1879.

A sweet night of union. Presages and hopes

The night of 12 January 1879 was sweet. I spent it fully with my Jesus. The union I felt was such that, when the dear

Child came closer to the side of my heart, // my bones were raised so much that in the sweetness I had to say: alas, my Good, you make me die! I see well that you prepare me for a certain cruel torment. In these days, you made me experience terrible agonies and diabolic torments.

Oh, how many things this monster did to me! The other evening it was raising the chair on which I was seated in the church; that was not enough! Something was added to my poor humanity. It seemed to me that my soul was breathing its last and I remained unconscious. But I know well that it was the ugly monster.

Before 11 January, how many beasts came to torment me! They were of every type and they took horrible shapes but I am already // used to them.

In these days many stars were moving around me. Oh, I understood well that many sisters would die and someone very soon.

This star gives me a distinct signal: it rose increasing in length; it was circular and it became long.

I lamented for providence which I was in need of but a voice assured me that I would have whatever I needed and this year I would have much. It would be the year of providence. Oh, goodness of my God, who listens to our miserable prayers and provides for us in spite of our merits!

Yesterday in early evening the head of a dead person was moving around my small cupboard, a skull, but I was not able to know who it was. //

It just brought me much pain, as for a dear person:

  • Oh, my God! – Soon within me I exclaimed – who could it be?

I felt an interior trembling, but I cannot express how I felt: the soul cut off.

The thought that he could be a person who lived in idleness and perhaps was in hell, and I could know nothing was a torment. Mary, this person was entrusted to you while a child; will you leave him to be lost? Certainly I feel it is only the grace of God which gives me strength; otherwise I could not react. The suffering is such that I do not find phrases to // express it.

Diabolic suggestions: “You are damned!”

Oh, my God, how can I describe everything I went through in these forty days!

I have been almost always traveling; when I stopped, I was so oppressed by work that I could not be occupied by anything else. Now I have a minute for writing and immediately I fulfill my duty. My Beloved, suggest to me because you made me experience many things; certainly my poor mind was unable to keep them all.

First I will speak of a very strong battle which I faced towards the end of January 1879. I had to struggle with certain ghosts who struck my mind; instead of being shaped as beasts they were transformed into ghosts. // What they left me regarding the sight was horrible; only for God’s mercy they did not molest me, but they suggested horrible things in my mind, the most tormenting like:

  • You are damned! You are already on the precipice and you live deluded! After much toil your place will be the abyss of pains.

Alas, the anguish was such that I could not but make examination over examination and when I was feeling my poor head was upset and could not bear more, what did I do? I stopped. Oh, // my God, but what will I say? He came to my help with his right hand and seemed to pass it on my head removing whatever bothered me. I remained as someone who comes out of a delirium and who does not remember where she had been and what she felt. She finds herself recovered, freed and does not know how; this was what happened to me.

Other times my Good gave me the strength to take refuge in his heart and held me tightly as someone who runs away from a danger and takes refuge in the bosom of someone who can defend and save her; as a child who runs

// to the mother.

“I seem to have changed character; that is what the others tell me”

I had to suffer cruel torments for a soul which belonged to me that was… what will I say?

For a month nothing could be known and I had to force myself so that nobody could realize my suffering. It seems that I have changed character; I did not realize it but the others say so.

And yet my God gave me indescribable strength while reading or giving a report of whatever was related to me and it was tormenting me to the point that within me I was feeling as if I were // twisting out of violence. Meanwhile I was seen as indifferent because all those who came close to me did not realize my state.

Oh, tell me my Good, of what type was such suffering that you gave me the strength to bear it and not to faint?

What will I say of the night? I was finally alone and it was certainly a moment in which I could have given vent to the suffering, but not, I posed to think. My God, what will be of that soul? Saying this, darkness came down on my mind and a tightening in my breast such that I could not describe. I passed hours and hours // in that way without praying, without being able to reason. Tired sleep overtook me but after a quarter of an hour I woke up completely upset. I give up describing this because I would have much to say and I feel that my poor mind cannot bear it.

There is nothing good, everything is engulfed. Oh, what a torture my soul feels! Only you, the Being of my life, can relieve me from this abyss.

It was not enough; another very cruel torment was added // to it… enough. Oh, what agonies are these?

Though my Good had assured that everything I do is according to his will, yet I feel my soul under a press.

Vision of the Virgin Mary with the Child and nearby a friar

Now I will say partially what I remember of the graces that my God gave me. Oftentimes he appeared to me to reassure me. He would take care of what I did not know so that I might not displease him, especially for certain tribulations only he could remedy.

Another time I was traveling and I was very much upset about Holy Communion. // I was upset thinking I was not in God’s grace and had lost the Being of my life. Oh, Love, how can I live without you! I was very absorbed in this thought throughout the journey in the coach; meanwhile I never missed suffering and there the Blessed Virgin with the Child in her arm appeared to me. A meter away there was a friar to whom I spoke a few days ago. In this way both seemed to have come to accompany me. Oh, how much joy they left me with! This sovereign had filled me with delight // assuring me in this way in my temptations; in that moment I could have challenged the whole world. Oh, goodness of a Mother so dear and tender towards us miserable sinners, especially towards me, the most infamous of all!

I had suffered much worry for certain failures of observance of a Daughter of St. Anne, but mostly it was the unrest for another thing to a point that I really felt torn the soul. My God, what will it be?

Towards nine in the evening while I was in bed lying on my back, a bad beast of the color of chocolate appeared to me; it had big legs and it was huge. It rose up to the ceiling and then it disappeared. My God, how much // I suffered! Interiorly it left me something which I cannot express.

Presage of the death of a superior

How much I suffered in these days is unbelievable. Just Friday, 4 of the current month, I was in the church and for some minutes I had union with my God. My side rose for a short time, then I lapsed into the same aridity and worse, because not having my Good with me, it seemed to me I was being damned. Oh, certainly they are my infamies!

While I lay on the cross and suffered much, I wanted to resist in order to feel a bit of the agony of the Lord; in fact it was a real torture. //

I was looking on one side in which there was a star and what did I see? I saw one beautiful and big.

  • Alas – I exclaimed – who is that superior who will die?

Oh, what a pain! She is old in vocation, a dearest daughter of mine; why do you take her my God? Why do you take away from me those who do much good and leave those who make me suffer much?

Alas, I suffer much! It was a continuous torture to think of it. The star was very big in merits; beautiful and big like the one I saw for my dear Vincenza; but two months before she died I saw a similar one. // What a pain! The same vision was for some other superior.

The next day again, while I was resting a beast appeared to me and immediately I said:

  • Who are you? It disappeared quickly.

  • My God, what will happen to me? Alas!

On the Crucifix she saw two wounds. “My Good, do not take away from me the wounds!”

Date: 18 April 1879. What I had suffered was pains of hell; such an affliction and sorrow which I received from certain persons who wounded me in such a way that I would not be able to resist if I did not run promptly to the arms of my Crucifix. I embraced him, stayed in my room, and gave vent through weeping. My Good give me // strength! Without this, you see, I cannot bear it! The blow would have been mortal if you had not supplied me your strength! Oh, yes, my Good, you experienced ingratitude of your disciple; I who have done … for this person! Alas, perhaps worse monstrosity? No, no! My Beloved, if you willed that and I suffered much to adhere to your will! I who am jealous of your gifts, and yet because of your will… Oh, dear Eternal Father!

In this way I went on giving vent, when suddenly I felt flooded by such serenity, much interior peace and calm of paradise. //

My eyes were dry and I felt strong with extraordinary strength. In this way, I remained enraptured for a good hour. Recovered I looked around everywhere, I looked at the Crucifix where my tears had dropped and I saw it was all wet.

Where I kept leaning my head, on his side there were two fresh and open wounds. Oh, Love, is it me who made them? No, they are the ones you had received! Oh, my Good, why did you not leave them to me? Oh, give me strength to carry out the suffering but do not take away the wounds; I cannot resist you, and think that I am // unable to carry them on. Oh, you have many of them, my Good!

I pleaded so much that the sign disappeared or rather the two signs, but a painful sadness returned upon me, although in the spirit I felt I endured well. Oh, my Crucifix, in you I find everything and through you I find everything. Jesus, my Good, how much affection; tell me what a torture this is.

I was feeling something gloomy, worse than sadness and it seemed to invade me again. I remained in this way for some time and then at a certain moment I became calm and courageous: Yes, my Good, I will drink all the gall, // I will not remove it from my lips and I will drink all till the last dregs.

Victory over herself in overcoming a feeling of grudge

I stood up and full of vigor I returned to work. Oh, sweet Love! But the following morning, having to face another torture, while I received injections, alas, this pig twisted. As soon as I was able to run to my Crucifix I went and after kissing him I embraced him and I lay on the cross. I made a thousand recommendations to the Eternal Father, that he may not allow this pig, to remain poisoned by the sense of grudge which I felt strongly // battling inside me. I had to keep quiet about something of which I was innocent.

I was ill-treated in bitter and poisonous ways. Oh, monster of humanity! It wanted to rebel, but not because you will bring full victory. Oh, Eternal Father, from you I have everything, and for you I do everything; you are my Being.

In order to tame this beast, I stood up and disciplined myself at length till bleeding. Not at all! My God, I have no more blood! Once the points hardly entered in the flesh that blood came out immediately; // now I beat myself for the duration of two “Miserere” and a “De profundis”, what happens? Just a small drop of blood and then cloudy water flows and nothing more! Oh, what a pig! It has nothing good, not even to be given to my Beloved.

Spasms of agony for the swelling of the side of her heart

While I was lying on the cross a big and beautiful star appeared to me on the other cross which was standing straight. My God, who will die? I know that he never lies and it is always a Daughter of St. Anne and a superior, a good one. It is of no use that I think because I see well that you do not want to tell me my God.

For two days now // my side has been very swollen. Not always but when I pray.

Today my ribs, even now while I write! Oh, sweetness!

It is still a spasm of agony when my bones rise so high!

Today even the hands were paining and the one with which I write is not only swollen but when I move it the spasm is much. The day before yesterday, when I wrote the whole day, at the end I felt like fainting because of the pain I felt.

The same is now as I write. I do not speak of the pain because it is very strong but very sweet. It animates me and I always keep holding my Good tightly. //

Oh, Love, how sweet is suffering! I feel such sweetness that what I suffer seems to be nothing.

Jerks and night figures

I continue to see certain beasts of every shape and all have their meaning.

In addition the night of 5 of the current month, at three I felt sick because I was disturbed the whole night by continued shaking; I felt a new spasm. First I heard a noise as if someone came close; it shot at me with a gun in the head. However, it was all pretence because the strong blow // seemed to come from the side of the head and it was such that at the same time I felt as if it broke down. Oh, what I felt! The sensation was so strong that it remained in me for the whole day and seemed to be always open. What a feeling, my God, for the whole day! I will not speak of that moment in which I felt the blow. I was so frightened that I jumped from the bed and I looked around to see it I could find something. Not at all! Out of fear, seeing myself sane and no body around me I realized it was the ugly monster. Oh, what a pain! I do not find // phrases to explain it.

The beasts continue their passage and if I should describe the make-up of everyone it would take too much time.

Last night I was sleeping fairly well when a shaking woke me up. Soon after, maybe half a meter high and distant from my face, was a big beast with very long clutches and a body black as a firebrand with a tail almost half a meter long. Oh, my God! Slowly it went to the top of the door which was near the bed and it disappeared. What a feeling // it left with! Though I tried to be quick to ask who it was and what it wanted, I had hardly formulated the thought that it had run away. My God!

“My Jesus, you gave me and you took her away”

For almost two months, I have not had a minute of time to write; how can I now tell about all the graces and the sufferings and what I saw? I will just say what happened to me in these last days because in this way, it is easy to remember.

I saw two stars and then another small one. Alas, the big ones announced the death of a good superior; it is sure because it always happened that way: when there is a good and clever superior that is her notice. What a pain, my God! // For pity’s sake, who will be next?

Alas, today I had the news of a dear and good sister, a superior Sister Anne… what a day! I confess, having suffered very much and I still feel an indescribable pain;

patience, my Jesus, you gave me and you took her away. It is not enough; I expect another bigger one and it is because five evenings ago, while I was sleeping, I was shaken and I woke up. Before me I saw a beautiful lamp but it had no oil.

It also lacked the container for oil but it was beautiful, snow-white. // It had a certain white trimming that made it very beautiful. I observed it for a while and within myself I said:

  • What is its meaning, dear Jesus?

It was raised up slowly by a rope that seemed the one with which it was lowered down; the same pulled it up in the air, then it reached one half meter from the ceiling and vanished. I remained thoughtful and within me I thought and I said:

  • Who will die?

I slept again and I was shaken; who shook me? I saw another lamp in the same place as the first, // a third of a meter from my bed or rather from me who was lying on the bed. However, this one was ugly and seemed to be a skeleton. It had only the appearance of a lamp but was neither the recipient for oil nor the oil.

In addition it was so ugly that I felt bad. It remained stationary for a longer time than the other and after it was raised up by a small rope which was visible, as if it was pulled by someone and it reached the height of the other and then it disappeared.

This sight kept me awake // and upset; I was not able to calm myself thinking of the ugliness and to whom it belonged. Alas, it might be mine! I am very disgraceful and I do not merit anything else. My God, forgive me!

“Oh, my Love, you are the only winner!”

The next evening I was again awakened by another beast; it was so big and frightening. My God, for a long time I did not see them and I thought their passage had ended. Not at all! They still come around. It is true, these are times of real tribulations and // I can say that I have them to my satisfaction. I have always had great thirst and hunger of suffering these fourteen years and I go on being nourished.

I thank you my Love, Jesus, for being so merciful towards this thankless creature. Infinite goodness, towards someone thankless like me!

My eyes are closing. It is very late and I am exhausted from the toil of today and my poor head cannot bear anymore. How many beasts came // to disturb me these nights! I have shakings and there are one or two beasts.

I was in a hospital for a visit and as soon as I went to bed I saw one or two beasts running one after the other as if to catch each other. They left me with my head so upset that I did not know what to think. However, the meaning did not delay to come. The next day, I heard so many unpleasant things regarding the interest of the Institute that I was very afflicted. //

In addition, the affair was very clear because there were two people who one after the other, accused each other.

One said: - Not me -

The other one seemed to be guilty but she was not. At the end I said within myself:

  • Here is the confusion of the liar of hell, who will win nothing because it is always mocked and it must lose. In fact, the truth soon came out. Both were mortified and they had to bow their heads and say:

  • It is very true that they are all lies.

Oh, my Love, you are always // the only winner, because you are the life and the truth, my Love!

At night another very filthy beast came that filled me with unbelievable horror, but I did not understand anything.

Prayer for the health of a superior

Very many stars appeared to me always announcing the death of the sisters. I had the news of one good superior who was sick.

Oh, my God, is this creature for you? Alas, she is so good and she does her duty very well! My God // why do you take away the good creatures who have fully the spirit of the Institute?

What a pain to know that she and the others are deceived and instead she will die; what a pain this is for me! I have only one refuge, to make a fervent recourse to my Crucifix that he may change the sentence and he may give her back to me healthy. This is the only hope, yes, he can do everything and many times he granted me the grace but not always.

My Good, you do // everything par-excellence. I am only a miserable creature, nothing and less than nothing.

“By now writing is really my duty”

How much anguish I have in these days, my God! I cannot explain what kind my suffering is; I do not stay a second or a minute without suffering and there are moments in which it is so strong that it is agony. If I write I am always under the spasm of suffering because of my hand; how much it pains today!

If the creatures could feel how much I suffer in writing!

And yet, // my Good, by now it is really my duty though I confess to be truly incapable because I am ignorant and I do not know anything. I tell to you the sufferings I feel.

It is he who writes and through him what I write will not be to the detriment of the poor Institute. My pain is only this:

to see myself ignorant.

Jesus is faithful to his promise that no one will realize the spasms of love

I suffer, my Good, for my side. When it is swollen like this I often feel in fit // of union with you. Oh, my sweet Spouse, how many times I tell you to turn away. Otherwise I must leave writing and go to the room, throw myself on the bed of the holy cross and give vent to my poor side!

My bones! How many times I find myself on the edge of yielding when the ribs rise fiercely and I am out of myself, but before I am out, the spasm I feel is such that I cannot but say:

  • Oh, you are killing me!

// My God, only you could say what you make me feel. But yes, he is faithful in his promise that no one will realize. I have to say that he catches me at night almost always. Infinite goodness, Love without compare!

There are days that I must resist the impulses which I feel in the prayer of union. The effort I must make is such that I feel compassion // for myself. But with the help of my Crucifix I always want to overcome and I feel strong in everything that I have to face. Yes, my Good, I receive everything from you and I live only for you.

Oh, how much sweetness and also of spasm of death I feel when the ribs of my side rise! Oh, how much swelling, my God!

“In the journeys, for every bell tower that I see, I make a spiritual communion”

In these days the union is such that I cannot describe it. My sweet Love, I cannot even express what knowledge my God gives me. Every time // I see a bell tower I cannot avoid expressing:

  • Dwelling place of my Good, come my Spouse, come!

As soon as I unite myself to him, I have to study so that nobody may realize. Before, this happened only when I traveled. How many spiritual communions I make while in journey! For every bell tower that I see, I make a spiritual communion and some times when it is in big cities, many of them can be seen.

Well, for everyone I say: Our Father – Hail Mary – Glory, an act of love // and a lively desire.

I invite my Good with a strong impulse:

  • Oh, come, come inside my heart, come my Love, come! Then I pass to the other.

What I feel is such that I cannot explain; many times it seems that he just comes to me and I receive him. I only have to be very careful so that nobody may realize my state.

Who loves God desires nothing other than to be despised by the world

Oh, Love, it is really true that one who loves you desires nothing else other than to be despised by the world and considers nothing, only you, my Good.

Oh, yes, I can really say that the world despises me; I delight much// in the slanders I suffer, but even in the suffering I found consolation for the thirst Jesus gave me to suffer. Oh, if my Good would have not given me such grace of finding pleasure in suffering to a point that I feel burning thirst, I certainly could yield for the continuous pains that I feel.

Strong anxiety between dream and watch

Yesterday night, after I slept a bit, a shaking woke me up. I saw a big sign, // as a black plate in the air close to the wall and it had many white round signs. I had hardly said: -

My God what could it be – when it rose up and fell down.

I am unable to describe what I felt, because it left me an anxiety such that I was unable to be calm. I signed myself and I prayed, and I slept again; but within a short time I was strongly shaken again and when I woke up the same figure was there but on another side. Then I was much more // disturbed:

  • Alas, what can it be?

In this way I spent the rest of the night in much anguish.

A strong anxiety caught me for the fear of losing my head.

Oh, what pain! It seemed me that I could not be ready for the prayer. Oh, what pains of death I felt! It seemed to me // I could breathe my last at any moment; well I said within me:

  • Don’t you know that you have been caught millions of times?

I understood well it was a signal that in the Work something was spoiled because of my being worried or for other things or there was a daughter in agony. How much I suffer!

“You are my all and you are whatever I do not have:

cover the ugly with your beauty”

It is something I cannot express, a real agony. My head remained so dull that I cannot say how sick I felt; it is a continuous spasm when I am like this // and yet my meditation is a complete union and with tears I could destroy myself while my mind is at the feet of my Saviour. It was Magdalene who stayed at his feet and anointed him with the ointment while she was still a sinner. That is what I said to him in my union with him. My Good, what ointment could I give you and find in order to anoint the wounds I made on you! – I held tightly his open feet especially the right foot. Oh, if my // sufferings, toils, tortures and pains and everything I do could be for you!

Oh, here yes, I found true consolation and my soul gave vent in sweet affections and seemed that my Good accepted everything, whatever I offered to him. Oh, Love, you have consoled me but it is not enough! Deep in my soul I feel something dark, sad which announces to me the coming of much tribulation. Yes, my Good, I prepare myself, so that everything may be for you // and to give you pleasure. If I did not master myself, how much I could be overcome by melancholy till desolation! But with the strength of my Good I forced myself. It is true that it costs me much, but I am happy. It is enough that I am able to overcome and that the world knows nothing of me. I am the most disgraceful creature of the earth, my Beloved; tell me what would happen if you take away whatever you gave me! //

Oh, what an abyss of misery of hell! Alas, when I think and I see who I am, I fear in such a way that immediately I take refuge in my Good and I say to him: you are my All and you are whatever I do not have; cover the ugly with your beauty. Oh, Love, what can I do to make you loved!

“Oh, to have lost my Being, my Life, my All!”

Friday 24 November 1879. I woke up after having taken a bit of sleep and interiorly I felt something sweet. My

Good! There a strong union raised // my ribs. Oh, Love, you are killing me! I remained absorbed in him. In this way an interior voice assured me that providence will come. In fact it did not delay. My God, how much goodness you do for this miserable creature!

I did not delay to have such an interior melancholy that gave me much pain and if I did not master myself, I could have developed a bad mood. It was strong and sometimes it seemed that I was // damned. I started praying and my mind was turning away pulled by a force. Although I struggled I was not able to overcome. Arid, I did not find either my Good or peace. Oh, what days! How much I suffered!

There are neither sufferings nor tortures which could be compared to this. Oh, to have lost my Being, my Life, my All! I cannot remember him because I feel wakening in me such a trembling that death is nothing in comparison to this suffering. I would have cut myself into pieces // and going to my room I would finish the beating… If there were no obedience, I would have reduced myself to a bad state. I do not know how much relief the beating gave me and what I did seemed me very little. Such was the desire of suffering because I had nothing else which could relieve me. Oh, sweet suffering, you give life to those who love you, that sweet and dear love for which one lives. Mary hold me tightly to Jesus and consume me in him.

Unrest and headache, effect of the mysterious “visits”

While I was giving thanks for Holy Communion, // the face of a dead person, one of our Sisters of America appeared to me. Though it was already in a state of rotting, I was able to recognize her well and it vanished. But after sometime another skull of a dead person appeared to me; it was big and seemed to be of a man. One side of the face was partially hidden; though I tried I was unable to see who he was. Alas, what a pain he left me with! I woke up with a thousand fears: who could it be?

I can say that these visits afflict me not a little and leave me with such fears because // they bring so much unrest… My (now I can say it) continuous headache, these days is so strong that I do not know where to find a moment of relief. This afternoon it was a bit less but in the morning it seemed as strong as in the past days, especially yesterday.

What a torture, my God! I went to the room and before the Crucifix // I promised to our Lady the Blessed Immaculate Mary, if she could stop for me the headache so that I may work without spasms (otherwise when it is very strong I am obliged to lie down). I could have disciplined myself until bleeding on the eve. Oh, Mary!

There is no torment that could be compared to being deprived of the supreme Good

Today, I can say I live and write without spasms; the suffering is very sweet if only it does not prevent me from working for my Good. I do not feel upset, but I see there is much need of working. Do with me // what you wish, sweet Love!

I had to suffer much and I was really feeling tortured in my soul because this body not only suffered atrociously – and for this I felt much delight – but the most cruel suffering was that of the soul, because my Jesus had left me in such darkness that I cannot describe. Even prayer was painful; to be in the church without being able to say a word, I only saw an abyss and I said:

  • I am damned, for me there is nothing more; everything

// is ended and hell must be ready only for me.

Alas, what pains! I turned everywhere and I could not find anything, only desolation. Therefore have I fallen into disgrace from God? What did I do my Good, my only treasure, Being of my life?

The suffering I felt was much. It seemed that I was dying. Oh, what a torment to be deprived of my Being!

There is no hell that could be compared to this pain.

After the 13th day in this sad state, fearful, I went to bed

// to rest always trembling at the thought that unexpectedly the torture which I felt the other nights when I was in agony could come back. But it was the contrary. As usual I signed myself and started praying; my God, I already began to say:

I love you!

In this way I fell asleep; after I woke up and was signing myself when the Venerable appeared to me in the monstrance. It stayed for a very long time, always before my eyes. Meanwhile a voice was telling me beautiful things and among these it suggested // what I should tell to a certain person regarding certain writings. Oh, sweet Love, how much you comforted me!

This was enough to make me serene and again have union with my God. I started meditating and I did it with much union. In addition I felt revived. Every fear ceased and it seemed to me I returned to live. Oh, I would have challenged the whole world and always for the mercy of God this state continues.

Struggle not to give into rapture

What will I say of my side today? Oh, there were moments in which it became so swollen and the ribs rose to such an extent that I had to force // myself to turn away so that I may not abandon myself and cry as I do when I am alone, I remain in him enraptured, my sweet Good. My ribs become like wax. When I return to live – if I can express it like this – it seems to me very sad, because with every small movement, what I feel my God! I am unable to express what I feel // when I see my misery and my nothingness. Oh, it is because of such that I feel ashamed of myself. Oh, an abyss of infamy! A miserable creature full of wickedness! Only you my Good, with your mercy, can sustain me, your mercy being without compare. How many graces and favors and me always thankless! There are moments in which I would destroy myself so that in some way I can demonstrate what I experience. As for you, I know you see everything. //

“I saw Providence increasing in my hands”

How can I ever write everything that my Good does against my unworthiness? I confess that these are numberless and especially the great grace that he grants me, his divine providence. Every time I am in need, I weep at his feet and soon he provides for me in an extraordinary way.

I had a strong desire of helping the poor with soup; he suggested how I should do so. Oh, infinite goodness! I got // everything and even more. As a reward he helped me help the community; even the sisters enjoyed of the fruits. I saw providence increasing in my hands. What Love you are, you who are my life! Oh, sweetness!

Perfect union with God

In the midst of much toil, my Good did not forget relieving me with his sweet and loving caresses. I do not speak of what my side feels when my Good unites me with him; how much my ribs rise and when I am not able to bear it I groan and // I cannot avoid lamenting strongly: alas, my Good, I am dying! If it does not cease I will surely breathe my last; I do not regret dying, no; on the contrary, when I find myself like this I always tell him: Oh, my Love, let this be my death and nothing else!

But if I say: - Alas I am dying – it is because this lament comes out for relief.

Certainly there are times that the pain becomes very strong. Then I lose my senses and I feel // nothing but a perfect union and in him my spirit delights in the highest knowledge of his Work.

My mind is so enlightened that am able to do things that I could not normally have even thought of.

Tangible protection of St. Anne

My star St. Anne every morning announces my day, because if I am to have tribulations she appears pale and wan; if there is to be death or things the sisters do that are wrong // or against the rule, she is covered by a black veil.

And if I pray for the health of one of our benefactors, if he has to die, she immediately makes me aware.

In fact, I prayed for one of our benefactors, that she may regain health. The next day after Holy Communion I insisted saying:

  • Obtain for me this grace: that this benefactor of ours may be healed. What a beautiful miracle! Yes, my dear

Mother, it will redound to your glory // and light to your Institute.

She answered me:

  • If she heals, it would never be attributed to me and the

Institute would not benefit.

I remained amazed and I kept quiet. I was no longer able to pray for such a grace, as if some coldness came down upon me.

I concluded my prayer saying:

  • My Mother, obtain for me the resignation and the patience and free her from suffering.

In fact, it could be said she had the least suffering with cancer, and she died without realizing that she was dying, without suffering. She had the most // beautiful death there could be. As soon as she died, she seemed to be smiling; she was so well prepared that she seemed to be sleeping.

Apparitions and different signs

It is now some time since I have seen the black beasts. I saw only two: a small one but it was as red as charcoal in fire and the other one a bit bigger. One evening I saw a great light as a globe; it was red in the middle and had a dark sign. Again I had to say that being on the bedside of the dying person I mentioned above, while I prayed, // on high I saw two beautiful empty balances in the air. It seemed there was someone keeping them but I was not able to see. An interior voice was telling me:

  • She went to heaven without having to pass through these; she does not need them, they are empty.

One morning while I was doing my thanksgiving for Holy Communion, a skeleton appeared to me whose head belonged to a sister. After some days I saw this appearing at the door of the sacristy. She had hardly put her head out, when she ran away but I recognized her well.

External afflictions and interior anguishes

I will not speak about the pain I felt for a certain affair. At night // I saw clearly the intrigue of that person and how she/he cheated me. At the end, what I experienced was such that I can never convince myself that there could be no deception in what she/he is doing now. What a pain! Although I was well advised, I struggled to turn away myself from suspicion.

What a pain! I am so troubled in the spirit because of an affliction which keeps me disturbed, // and there are days in which only my God could say the pains, the anguish and the fears. Only one thing sustained me and that is what I feel within me; as if it was something profound, far away, that assured me. It is as a strong support that prevented me despairing of my salvation. I see something which I do not know how to express. With all that it was not enough to say to myself:

  • Be sure, it is willed by God.

This really happens to me when I am sunk in aridity.

Everything becomes black and certain pains of being deprived of my Being suddenly come upon me… Oh, my Love! //

All the crosses, all the tribulations, but you stay always close to me!
